Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 4:
Muttar lizroa shete shurot zo betzad zo shel kishshuin ushete shurot betziddan shel deluin. ushete shurot shel pol hammitzri. vetelem ben kol min vamin. aval lo yizra shura achat shel kishshuin veshura achat shel deluin veshura achat shel pol hammitzri af al pi shehattelem mavdil ben kol min vamin mippene shemminin ellu alim shellahen arukkin venimshachin umistabbechin. veim zeraan shura betzad shura yitarev hakkol veniru kenizrain beirbuveya: 
Hayta sadehu zerua min mimmine yerakot uvikkesh lizroa betochah shurot shurot shel deluin oker min hayyarak makom shezzorea bo shura shel deluin umavdil benah uven hayyarak betelem umanniach min hayyarak rochav shetem esre amma veose shura sheniyya shel deluin umavdil benah uven hayyarak betelem. vechen ad makom sheyyirtze. shennimtza ben kol shete shurot shel deluin shetem esre amma. aval pachot mikkan asur mippene healin shemmistabbechin mikkan umikkan bayyarak shebbenehem venire hakkol keillu nizra beirbuveya: 
Hayta shura shel delaat zerua afillu delaat yechidit uva lizroa betziddah tevua. marchik bet rova. shehare nimshechu aleha vehechezika makom gadol. vechol davar sheyyihye betoch bet rova shemmarchikin ben shene hamminin ole min hammidda kegon hakkever vehassela vechayyotze bahen: 
Hattelem o ammat hammayim shehen amukkim tefach zorin letocho shelosha mine zeraim echad al sefat hattelem mikkan veechad mikkan veechad baemtza: 
Umuttar lintoa shene minin betoch gumma achat. vaafillu kishut udelaat. vehu sheyyihye min ze note meal sefat haggumma lechan vehammin haacher note latztzad hashsheni veyerau nivdalin ze mizze. vechen im nata arbaa minin betoch haggumma vahafachan learba ruchoteha hare ze muttar: 
Harotze lizroa sadehu meshshar meshshar mikkol min vamin marchik ben kol meshshar umeshshar shete ammot al shete ammot umetzer veholech ad shello yishshaer benehen besof hameshshar ella kol shehu. shehare hen nirin shello nizreu beirbuveya: 
Ratza laasot sadehu karachat karachat mikkol min vamin lo yaase betoch kol bet sea yeter al tesha karachot kol karachat mehen bet rova venimtza rachok ben karachat vekarachat karov leeser ammot pachot revia. shekkol bet sea chamishshim al chamishshim: 
Uma ben hameshshar lakkarachat shehameshshar aroch vehakkarachat merubbaat: 
Mine yerakot sheen derech bene adam lizroa mehem ella meat meat kemo shebbearnu muttar lizroa mehem afillu chamishsha minin betoch aruga achat shehi shishsha tefachim al shishsha tefachim. vehu sheyyizra arbaa minin bearba ruchot haaruga veechad baemtza. veyarchik ben kol min vamin kemo tefach umechetza kede shello yinku ze mizze. aval yoter al chamishsha minin lo yizra af al pi shemmerachek benehem lefi shemminin harebe baaruga kazo hare hen kintuin beirbuveya: 
Bamme devarim amurim baaruga shehi bechurba veen sham zera chutza lah. aval aruga ben arugot asur lizroa bah chamishsha minin. sheim yizra bechol ruach mearuga zo uvechol ruach mearugoteha shessevivoteha yerae hakkol kimorav. veim hitta alin shebbaaruga zo lechan vealin shebbaaruga shebbetziddah mikkan ad sheyyerau muvdalim muttar. vechen im asa telem ben kol aruga vaaruga muttar: 
Veasur lizroa chutz laaruga belo telem uvelo netiyya vaafillu keneged hakkeranot shel aruga sheen bahen zera. gezera shemma yizra arbaat hamminin bearba zaviyyot aruga veyizra minin acherim chutza lah keneged hazzaviyyot venimtza hakkol kimorav: 
Hayta haaruga shishsha al shishsha vehaya lah gevul gavoah tefach verachav tefach saviv muttar lizroa bah afillu shemona asar minin shelosha al kol gevul ugevul veshishsha baemtza. veyarchik ben kol min vamin tefach umechetza. velo yizra rosh hallefet betoch haggevul shemma yemalleehu. yoter al ze lo yizra: 
Veasur lizroa baaruga mine zeraim beinyan ze mippene shehen nirin kilayim. aval mine yerakot hoil veen derech bene adam lizroa mehen ella meat meat hare ze muttar kemo shebbearnu: 
Gevul shehaya gavoah tefach vezaru bo minin harebe kemo shebbearnu venitmaet mittefach meachar shennizra bo kasher shehaya kasher mittechillato: 
Harotze lemalleot kol ginnato mine yerakot rabbim velo yarchik benehem ose kol hagginna arugot merubbaot afillu shishsha al shishsha. veose bechol aruga chamishsha iggulin. arbaa bearba ruchoteha veechad beemtza. vezorea min bechol iggul vezorea arbaa minim acherim bearbaa karnot aruga. nimtzeu tisha minin bechol aruga vehen nirin muvdalin ze mizze veeno mafsid ella ma shebben haiggulin bilvad shehu mannicho charev kede sheyyerau haiggulin muvdalin min hakkeranot umuvdalin ze mizze. veim ratza shello yafsid kelum im hayu haiggulin zeruim sheti zorea ma shebbenehen erev veim hayu zeruin erev zorea ma shebbenehen sheti kede sheyyerau muvdalin: 
Mikkol ellu haddevarim nitbaer lecha shebbizman sheyyesh ben shene hamminin harechaka haruya lahem kede shello yinku ze mizze en choshshin lemarit haayin kemo shebbearnu. uvizman sheyyerau muvdalim ze mizze en choshshim linikatan afillu hen ze betzad ze kemo shennitbaer atta:
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 5:
Hazzorea shene mine tevua o shene mine yerakot im zera hakkerem hare ze loke shetayim. achat mishshum <small>(Vayikra 19 19)</small> "sadcha lo tizra kilayim" veachat mishshum <small>(Devarim 22 9)</small> "lo tizra karmecha kilayim": 
Veeno loke mishshum zorea kile hakkerem ad sheyyizra beeretz yisrael chitta useora vechartzan bemappolet yad. vechen im chippa otam beafar loke. vechen im zara shene mine yarak vechartzan o zera echad yarak vezera echad min tevua vechartzan bemappolet yad hare ze loke: 
Veeno chayyav min hattora ella al kanbos veluf vechayyotze bahen mizzeraim shennigmarim im tevuat hakkerem aval shear hazzeraim asurim middivrehem. vechen asur middivrehem lizroa kile hakkerem bechutza laaretz: 
Velamma asru kile hakkerem [bechutza laaretz velo asru kile zeraim] mippene shekkile hakkerem chamurin hem sheim nizreu beeretz yisrael hare hen asurin bahanaa vechevan shehen asurin bahanaa baaretz asru lezaran bechutza laaretz: 
Veen odrin im hannachri bechilayim aval okrin immo kede lemaet hattifla: 
En asur mishshum kile hakkerem ella mine tevua umine yerakot bilvad. aval shear mine zeraim muttar lezaram becherem veen tzarich lomar shear ilanot: 
Asur lizroa yerakot o tevua betzad haggefanim o litta gefen betzad hayyarak o tevua. veim asa ken af al pi sheeno loke hare ze kiddesh veneesru shenehem bahanaa hayyarak o hattevua o haggefanim. vesorfin et shenehen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 9)</small> "pen tikdash hamelea hazzera". vaafillu hakkash shel tevua vehaetzim shel gefanim haellu asurin bahanaa vesorfin otam velo yassik bahen tannur vechirayim velo yevashshel bahem beet serefatan: 
Echad hannotea veechad hamekayyem kevan sheraa kilayim tzamchu becharmo vehinnicham hare ze kiddesh. veen adam mekaddesh davar sheeno shello. lefichach hamesakkech gafno al gabbe tevuato shel chavero kiddesh gafno velo nitkaddesha hattevua. sikkech gefen chavero al tevuato kiddesh tevua velo kiddesh gefen chavero. sikkech gefen chavero al tevuat chavero lo kiddesh echad mehen. umippene ze hazzorea karmo bashsheviit lo kiddesh: 
Haroe kilayim becherem chavero vekiyyeman hare ze haroe asur bahanayatan vechol adam muttarin bahen. veillu kiyyeman baal hakkerem haya mekaddesh otan lechol adam kemo shebbearnu: 
Haannas shezzara kilayim becherem chavero im nishtakkeu habbealim af al pi shello nityaashu hare ze kiddesh min hattora. veim lo nishtakkeu habbealim af al pi shennityaashu eno mekaddesh ella middivre sofrim: 
Haruach sheakra peerot haggefen veshillecha otan al hattevua yigdod otan miyyad. veim ero ones velo sillekan hare ellu muttarin velo nitkaddeshu: 
Annas shezzara hakkerem kesheyyatza haannas yiktzor hazzera miyyad vaafillu bechullo shel moed. veim lo matza poalin yosif lahen ad shelish bischaran. bikkeshu mimmennu yoter mikken o shello matza poalim hare ze mevakkesh benachat vekotzer. veim nishtaha hazzera ad shehiggia leonat sheyyikdash hare ze yikdash veyeasru shenehem: 
Meematay tevua o yarak mitkaddeshin mishsheyyashrishu. anavim mishsheyyeasu kefol hallavan. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 9)</small> "hamelea hazzera asher tizra utevuat hakkarem" ad sheyyizra ze veyihye ze tevua. aval tevua sheyyavsha kol tzarkah vaanavim shebbashlu kol tzarkan enan mitkaddeshot. [ketzad. tevua sheyyavsha kol tzarkah uva venata gefen betochah vechen anavim shebbashlu kol tzarkan vezara tevua o yarak betziddan af al pi shezze asur enan mitkaddeshot]: 
Kerem shello higgiu anavav lihyot kefol hallavan ella adayin hen boser vezara betocho yarak o tevua vehishrishu hare ze lo kiddesh. veaf al pi chen konsin oto veosrin hazzera. aval habboser muttar veim akar hazzera kodem sheyyeasu haanavim kefol hallavan hare ze muttar bahanaya. miktzatan naasu kefol hallavan umiktzatan lo naasu. et shennaasu nitkaddeshu veet shello naasu muttarin: 
Anavim shennaasu kefol hallavan vezara betziddan tevua o mine yerakot velakat hazzera kodem sheyyashrish hare ze muttar bahanaa veim hishrish asur: 
Gefen sheyyavshu healin shellah venaflu kederech shettivash haggefen bime hakkor asur lizroa betziddah yarak o tevua veim zara lo kadshu. vechen hazzorea beatzitz sheeno nakuv hammunnach bakkerem lo kiddesh umakkin oto makkat mardut. aval atzitz nakuv hare hu keeretz: 
Haya over bakkerem venaflu mimmennu zeraim o sheyyatzu im hazzevalim o im hammayim o shehaya zorea o zore besade lavan usearattu haruach laachorav venaflu hazzeraim bakkerem vetzamchu hare ze lo nitkaddesh shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 9)</small> "asher tizra" veze lo zara. vechayyav laakor kesheyyire. veim kiyyeman hare ze kiddesh. searattu haruach lefanav veroe hazzeraim shennaflu lakkerem hare ze kezorea. vechetzad yaase. im tzamchu haasavim yahafchem bemachresha vedayyo. veim metzaan shennaasu aviv yenappetz oto aviv kede lehashechito shehakkol asur bahanaa. veim metzaah shennaaset dagan hare zo tissaref. veim raa otan vekiyyeman hare ellu yissarfu im haggefanim hassemuchot lahen: 
Haroe bakkerem esev sheen derech bene adam lezaro af al pi shehu rotze bekiyyumo livhema o lirfua hare ze lo kiddesh. ad sheyyekayyem davar shekkamohu mekayyemin rov haam beoto makom. ketzad. hamekayyem kotzim bakkerem baarav sherotzim bakkotzim ligmallehem hare ze kiddesh: 
Hairus vehakkisos veshoshannat hammelech ushear mine zeraim enan kilayim bakkerem. hakkanbos vehakkinras vetzemer gefen hare hen kishar mine yerakot umekaddeshim bakkerem. vechen kol mine deshaim sheolin mealehen bassade hare hen mekaddeshin bakkerem. ufol hammitzri min zeraim hu veeno mekaddesh. hakkanim vehavvered vehaattadin mine ilan hen veenan kilayim bakkerem: 
Ze hakkelal kol hammotzi alin meikkaro hare ze yarak vechol sheeno motzi alin hare ze ilan. vehatztzalaf ilan lechol davar: 
Haroe yarak bakkerem veamar kesheaggia lo elketenu muttar. higgia lo veavar mealav veamar kesheechezor lo elketenu im shaha ad shehosif echad mimmatayim hare ze kiddesh: 
Vechetzad meshaarin shiur ze. roin im nechtach yarak ze o min tevua ze min haaretz bechamma zeman yivash. hagga beatzmecha sheyyivash ad shello tishshaer bo lecha bemea shaa. im nishtaha baaretz mishshehiggia lo chatzi shaa hare hosif bematayim leesor. veim shaha pachot mechatzi shaa muttar: 
Asur laavor beatzitz nakuv shezzarua bo yarak betoch hakkerem. veim hinnicho tachat haggefen venishtaha sham baaretz kede lehosif echad mimmatayim hare ze kiddesh: 
Batzal shennetao bakkerem veachar kach neekar hakkerem veachar kach tzamchu betzalim min haikkar hannatua af al pi sherabbu haggiddulim al ikkaro bematayim hare oto haikkar beissuro sheen giddule hetter maalin et haikkar haasur:
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 6: Hazzorea yarak o tevua bakkerem o hamekayyemo ad shehosif bematayim hare ze mekaddesh min haggefanim shessevivotav shesh esre amma lechol ruach. agullot velo merubbaot. veroin kol haiggul sherachbo shetayim usheloshim amma keillu hu kullo male yarak. vechol gefen shettihye betoch iggul ze nitkaddesha im hayyarak vechol shechutz laiggul enan mitkaddeshot:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya ben sifte haiggul hazze uven shurot haggefanim shechutza lo yoter al arba ammot. aval im haya benehem arba ammot metzumtzamot o pachot roin et haiggul keillu higgia lashshura hassemucha lo ucheillu rochav haiggul arbaim amma veroin kol gefen shettippol betoch iggul ze shel arbaim amma hare hi mitkaddeshet:

Bamme devarim amurim bezorea o mekayyem toch hakkerem. aval hazzorea chutz lakkerem vesamuch lo hare ze mekaddesh shete shurot shel gefanim hassemuchot lazzera beorech kol hazzera veyeter arba ammot chutz lazzera umitkaddesh min hazzera rochav arba ammot beorech kol hashshura shel kerem. veim zara betzad gefen yechidit eno mekaddesh min hazzera ella shishsha tefachim lechol ruach:
Yalda pachot mittefach enah mekaddeshet et hazzeraim. bamme devarim amurim bishtayim keneged shetayim veachat yotza zanav. aval im haya kol hakkerem ken hare ze mekaddesh:

Shete ginnot zo al gav zo hattachtona asuya kerem zorea et haelyona ad shehu maggia laavir asara tefachim karov lakkerem. sheavir asara tefachim samuch lakkerem o legefen yechidit asur lizroa bo zeraim. veim hayta haelyona asuya kerem hare ze zorea et hattachtona ad shehu maggia lematta mishshelosha tefachim meikkar haggefanim:

Mi shehayta sadehu zerua yarak o tevua venimlach litta bah gefanim hofech et hazzeraim bemachresha veachar kach notea velo yitta veachar kach yahafoch. hayta netua gefanim venimlach lizroa bah zeraim mesharesh et haggefanim veachar kach zorea et hazzeraim. veim ratza lakotz et haggefanim ad shello yishshaer mehen ella pachot mittefach samuch laaretz hare ze muttar lizroa veachar kach yachazor visharesh et hannishar baaretz min haggefanim:

Hammavrich et haggefen baaretz afillu hivrichah betoch haddelaat sheyyavsha venaaset kesilon o betoch silon shel cheres im haya heafar al gabbah shelosha tefachim o yoter hare ze muttar lizroa al gabbah. veim haya al gabbah pachot mizze asur lizroa al gabbah umuttar lizroa betziddah:

Hivrichah bassela af al pi sheen afar al gabbah ella shalosh etzbaot muttar lehavi zera aleha. bamme devarim amurim sheen ikkar haggefen nire. aval im nire tzarich leharechik shishsha tefachim lechol ruach veachar kach yizra kemo shemmarchik mikkol gefen yechidit shello huvrecha kemo sheyyitbaer:
Hammavrich shalosh gefanim veikkerehem nirin. im yesh benehen mearba ammot ad shemone hare ellu mitztarfin lishar gefanim haomdot ucheillu lo hivrichan. veim lav enam mitztarfot:
Hayu pachot mishshalosh en mitztarfin ella marchik mehen shishsha tefachim lechol ruach vezorea:
Kol hazzorea tachat hassarigim vehealin hayyotzin min haggefen hare ze kiddesh veaf al pi shehazzera rachok meikkar haggefen kamma ammot:

Hidla et haggefen al miktzat appifyarot lo yizra tachat motar haappifyarot. veaf al pi sheen alehen lo alin velo sarigim. veim zara hoil veen hazzera tachat sechach haggefen hare ze muttar. vechen im hidla haggefen al miktzat badde ilan sheeno ose perot kegon haerez vehabberosh. aval im hidla al miktzat ilan maachol hare ze muttar lizroa tachat badde hailan shello nimshechu alehen sarige haggefen sheen adam mevattel ilan maachol veose appifyarot legefen. veim nimshechu hassarigim achar shezzara vesikkecho al hazzera hare ze machaziram lemakom acher:

Hazzorea tachat motar haappifyarot o tachat motar ilan sheeno ose perot venimshechu sarige haggefen vesikkechu al hazzeraim hare ze asur lekayyemo o lehachazir hassarigim ella ketzad ose. oker hazzera:

Kanim hayyotzin min hearis vechas alehen lefaskan kede shello yashchit haappifyarot hare ze muttar lizroa tachtehen. veim hinnicham kede sheyyehallechu alehen hassarigim vehealin hayyotzin hare ze asur lizroa tachtehen:
Perach hayyotze min hearis o min haddalit roin oto keillu mishkolet teluya bo ad haaretz veasur lizroa tachtav. vechen hammoteach zemora meilan leilan asur lizroa tachteha:

Kashar chevel o gemi bizmora vekashar harosh echad beilan hare ze muttar lizroa tachat hachevel. veim matach chaval ze kede sheyyehallechu alav hassarigim vehealim hare hu kaappifyarot veasur lizroa tachtav:
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 7:
Habba lizroa betzad hakkerem marchik mimmennu arba ammot meikkere haggefanim vezorea. veim gefen yechidit hi marchik mimmenna shishsha tefachim vezorea. hayta shura achat shel gefanim zo betzad zo afillu hen mea en ze kerem ella kegefen yechidit umarchik min hashshura shishsha tefachim vezorea. hayu shete shurot hare ellu kerem vetzarich leharechik arba ammot mikkol tzad veachar kach yizra: 
Vechamma yihye bechol shura shalosh gefanim o yoter. bamme devarim amurim beshehaya ben kol gefen vegefen mearba ammot ad shemone ammot. aval im haya ben shete hashshurot shemone ammot chutz mimmekom haggefanim atzman hare ellu kemuvdalot zo mizzo veenan kerem echad veeno marchik ella shishsha tefachim mikkol shura. vechen im haya benehen pachot mearba hare ellu kegefen achat umarchik shishsha tefachim lechol ruach: 
Hayu shalosh shurot af al pi sheyyesh benehen pachot mearba hare ellu kerem veroin et haemtzaiyyot keillu enam. vechen im hayu shalosh shurot uven kol shura veshura shemone ammot o yoter hare ze zorea ben hashshurot: 
Lefichach hannotea et karmo mittechilla vehirchik ben kol shura veshura shemone ammot muttar lehavi zera betocho. umarchik mikkol shura shishsha tefachim bilvad. aval im zara chutza lo tzarich leharechik mishshura hachitzona arba ammot kishar hakkeramim veen din ben hashshurot shel ze hakkerem kecherem shecharav beemtzao shehare mittechilla netaan meruchakin: 
Hayta besade zo shura achat shel gefanim uvisde chavero shura acheret kenegdah kerova lah. af al pi shemmafsik benehen derech hayyachid o derech harabbim o gader shehu namuch measara tefachim hare ellu mitztarfot lihyot shetehen kerem vehu sheyyihye benehen pachot mishshemone: 
Nata shura achat baaretz veshura achat bemadrega. im gevoha hammadrega min haaretz asara tefachim enam mitztarfin. pachot mikkan mitztarfin: 
Hannotea chamesh gefanim shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotzet zanav hare ze nikra kerem katan vetzarich leharechik mehen arba ammot lechol ruach. aval im netaan shetayim keneged shetayim veachat baemtza o shalosh beshura zo ushetayim kenegdan beshura sheniyya enam kerem veeno marchik mehen ella shishsha tefachim lechol ruach: 
Kerem shecharav im yesh bo lelakket eser gefanim lechol bet sea veyihyu netuot shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotza zanav. o yesh bo lechavven shalosh keneged shalosh hare ze nikra kerem dal veasur lizroa bechullo: 
Kerem sheeno natua shurot shurot ella meerbav. im yesh bo lechavven shetayim keneged shalosh hare ze kerem veim lav eno kerem. ella dayyo leharechik shishsha tefachim mikkol gefen vegefen vezorea: 
Hayu haikkarim mechuvvanin vehannof eno mechuvvan hare ze kerem. hannof mechuvvan vehaikkar eno mechuvvan eno kerem. hayu dakkot veenan mechuvvanot heevu vahare hen mechuvvanot hare ze kerem. ketzad hu yodea im hen mechuvvanot. mevi chut hammidda umoteach mizzo lezo: 
Kerem shecharav beemtzao venishar shalem mikkol sevivav. im yesh bakkarachat shebbeemtzao shesh esre amma hare ze marchik meikkere haggefanim arba ammot lechol ruach vezorea beemtza hakkarachat. veim en bah shesh esre amma hare ze lo yavi zera lesham. veim hevi hoil vehirchik arba ammot lechol ruach min haggefanim shel kerem hare ze lo kiddesh: 
Vechen makom shennishar panuy belo gefanim ben sof hakkerem uven haggader shello vehu hannikra mechol hakkerem im yesh bo shetem esre amma marchik min haggefanim arba ammot vezorea et hishshaer: 
Haya bo pachot mishshetem esre amma lo yavi zera lesham. veim hevi hoil vehirchik arba ammot hare ze lo kiddesh. bamme devarim amurim becherem gadol. aval bekatan en lo machol ella marchik arba ammot missof haggefanim vezorea ad haggader. vechen kerem gadol shehaya ben kol shura veshura shemone ammot o yeter en lo machol: 
Haya haggader hammakkif et hakkerem pachot measara tefachim. o shehaya gavho asara tefachim veen bo rochav arbaa tefachim. en lo machol. ella marchik missof haggefanim arba ammot vezorea ad hammechitztza. afillu haya ben haggefanim uven hammechitztza arba ammot umechetza zorea et chatzi haamma: 
Gader shehu gavoah asara tefachim vechen charitz shehu amok asara tefachim verachav arba hare ze muttar litta kerem betziddo mikkan virakot betziddo mikkan. afillu mechitztza shel kanim im en ben kane lachavero shelosha tefachim hare zo muvdelet ben hakkerem vehayyarak begader: 
Gader hammavdil ben kerem veyarak shennifratz ad eser ammot hare ze kefetach umuttar. hayta perutza yoter meeser keneged happirtza asur ad sheyyarchik min haggefanim kashshiur. nifretzu bo peratzot rabbot im haya haomed kefarutz hare ze muttar keillu en sham pirtza. haya parutz merubbe al haomed lo yizra keneged kol hammekomot happerutzim ad sheyyarchik kashshiur: 
Mechitztzat hakkerem shennifretza omrim lo gedor. gedarah venifretza omrim lo gedor. nityaesh mimmenna velo gedarah hare ze kiddesh: 
Bayit shechetzyo mekore vechetzyo eno mekore ugefanim netuot betzad ze muttar lizroa yerakot batztzad haacher. shehare pi tikra keillu yarad vesatam venaasa benehen kimchitztza. veim hishva et keruyo asur: 
Chatzer ketanna shennifretza bimloah ligdola vehayu haggefanim baggedola asur lizroa bakketanna. veim zara hazzeraim asurin vehaggefanim muttarin. hayu haggefanim bakketanna muttar lizroa baggedola hoil veyesh baggedola passin mikkan umikkan hare hi kemuvdelet min hakketanna veen hakketanna muvdelet min haggedola: 
Charitz shehu over bakkerem amok asara verachav arbaa im haya mefullash merosh hakkerem vead sofo hare ze nire keven shene hakkeramim umuttar lizroa betocho. uvilvad shello yihyu haggefanim mesakkechin alav kemo shebbearnu. veim lo haya mefullash hare hu kegat shebbeemtza hakkerem sheaf al pi shehi amukka asara urechava arbaa o yeter asur lo lizroa betochah ella im ken haya bakkarachat shesh esre amma: 
Shevil shebben shene hakkeramim hare hu kecherem shecharav meemtzao. im yesh benehem shesh esre amma marchik mizze arba ammot umizze arba ammot vezorea et hammotar. veim haya pachot mikkan lo yavi zera lesham: 
Shomera shebbakkerem im gevoha asara urechava arbaa muttar lizroa beroshah yarak. uvilvad shello yihyu hassarigin nogin bah kede shello yerae yarak betoch hakkerem millemala. bamme devarim amurim bimrubbaat. aval im hayta hashshomera agulla tzericha sheyyihye betochah chalal arbaa tefachim kede shettihye mufleget min haaretz. utzericha afar al roshah millemala shelosha tefachim: 
Habbayit shebbakkerem im haya yoter mishshelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim ad arbaa zorin betocho yarak. veim haya pachot mishshelosha al shelosha hare hu kesatum veen zorin betocho: 
Gefen yechidit shehayta netua betoch hanneka o betoch hecharitz marchik mimmenna shishsha tefachim lechol ruach vezorea et kol hecharitz kederech sheose bammishor. veim haya amok asara vehaya rochav sefat hecharitz lemala arbaa asur lizroa betocho af al pi shehirchik shishsha: 
Vechen gefen yechidit shehayta mukkefet gader gavoah asara verachav arbaa lo yizra bechol hammechitztza veaf al pi shehirchik shishsha. veim hirchik shishsha vezara lo kiddesh. vechamma yarchik lechattechilla veyizra arba ammot lechol ruach veachar kach yizra shear hecharitz o shear hammakom hammukkaf gader:
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 8:
Haggefannim sheggadlu kivriyyatan vahare hassarigim vehaeshkolot shellahen mushlachin baaretz hen hannikrain kerem. aval haose kemo mitta o kemo sevacha gevoha meal haaretz kede sheyyihyu haeshkolot vehassarigim nimshachin aleha vehigbiah nof haggefanim meal haaretz al otah hammitta vehidla oto hare ze nikra aris. veotam hakkanim vechayyotze bahen sheasa mehen mitta o sevacha vehidla alehen et nof haggefen hen hannikraim appifyarot. vedinim acherim yesh bearis: 
Hannotea shura achat shel chamesh gefanim o yeter veirsan al gabbe kotel gavoah asara vechayyotze bo o shennetaan betzad charitz amok asara verachav arbaa hare ellu nikrain aris. vetzarich leharechik min hearis arba ammot veachar kach yizra. kederech shemmarchik min hakkerem: 
Umehechan moddin. meikkar haggader sheersan alav. ketzad. hirchik et hashshura shel gefanim min hakkotel amma venimtza hearis min haggefanim velakkotel moded min hakkotel arba ammot vezorea. venimtza ben hazzera uven ikkere haggefanim chamesh ammot. veim ba lizroa mitztzad haggefanim marchik meikkere haggefanim arba ammot shennimtza rachok min hakkotel chamesh ammot. veal derech zo danin bechol aris: 
Echad habbone et haggader veachar kach nata o shennata veachar kach asa haggader hoil veersan hare ze aris. neheras haggader o nistam hecharitz en kan aris ella hare kol hashshura kigfanim yechidim: 
Aris shecharav emtzao venishtayyeru bo chamesh gefanim betzad haggader mikkan vechamesh gefanim betzad haggader haacher mikkenegdan zehu hannikra piske aris. im yesh benehen shemone ammot veechad mishshishshim baamma hare ze marchik mikkol shura shishsha tefachim vezorea. vehu shello yizra tachat haappifyarot kemo shebbearnu: 
Haya benehen shemone ammot betzimtzum hare ze lo yizra lesham. veim zeraan hoil vehirchik mikkol shura shishsha tefachim hare ze lo kiddesh. veim en sham gader marchik mikkol shura shishsha tefachim vezorea sheen kan lo aris velo piske aris. chazar uvana haggader chazar aris limkomo vechazru piske aris limkoman: 
Ginna ketanna shehi mukkefet gader veires et haggefanim saviv lah mibbachutz al kol ketaleha. im yesh bah melo botzer vesallo mikkan umelo botzer vesallo mikkan. hoil vehi mukkefet gader zorin betochah yerakot. veim en [bah] kashshiur hazze en zorim betochah mippene shennire hakkol kearis echad veyarak betocho: 
Gefanim shehayu zeruim bemadrega gevoha vehearis shellahen yotze umesakkech al hassade. im omed baaretz uvotzer et kullo roin kol hammakom shettachat hearis keillu hu mekom ikkere haggefanim veoser arba ammot bassade lechol ruach missefat hearis. veim eno yachol livtzor ad sheyyaale bammadrega o bassullam en asur lizroa ella tachat hearis bilvad: 
Shene ketalim hassemuchin ze laze vehaggefanim netuim bezaviyyot benehem vehearis yotze im hakketalim mittoch hakkeren vechalle. marchik meikkere haggefanim kashshiur vezorea bemakom hakkalle sheen alav aris. veaf al pi shehazzera mechuvvan ben shene hakketalim shebbenehen hearis hoil vehirchik kashshiur hare ze zorea ben hakketalim: 
Gefen sheala haetz shellah min haaretz meat veachar kach neekam venimshach al haaretz vechazar veala kemo arkubba. keshemmoddin ben haggefen uven hazzera shishsha tefachim o arba ammot en moddin ella missof haarkubba lo meikkar haggefen harishon: 
Kevar bearnu sheaf al pi shemmarchik ben hazzera uven haggefen kashshiur. tzarich lehizzaher shello tesakkech haggefen al hayyarak o yesakkech hayyarak al haggefen. zara yarak o tevua vetzimcha veachar kach sikkech aleha et haggefen hakkashshin muttarin vehaddagan yidlak. hayu sharshe haggefen yotzin letoch haarba ammot shebben hakkerem vehattevua yaakor. hayu sharshe hattevua yotzin letoch haarba ammot muttar: 
Kol haharchakot vehashshiurin haamurin bechilayim beamma bat shishsha tefachim sochakot. velo yetzamtzem bemiddot hakkilayim sheen metzamtzemim ella lehachamir: 
Kol hashshiurin haellu shemmarchikin ben haggefanim vehattevua o hayyarak enan ella beeretz yisrael o besureya. aval bechutza laaretz muttar lizroa betzad haggefanim betoch hakkerem lechattechilla. velo asru bechutza laaretz ella lizroa shene mine yarak o tevua im hachartzan bemappolet yad. veim amar letinok nachri lizroa lo bechutza laaretz muttar. aval lo yomar lenachri gadol shello yitchallef beyisrael: 
Veaf al pi shemmuttar lizroa hayyarak betzad hakkerem bechutza laaretz hare oto hayyarak hazzarua sham asur baachila vaafillu bechutza laaretz. vehu sheyyire oto loket umocher. aval sefeko muttar kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot:
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 9:
Hammarkiv zachar al nekeva sheeno mino ben bivhema ben bechayya uveof vaafillu bemine chayya shebbayyam hare ze loke min hattora bechol makom ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 19)</small> "behemtecha lo tarbia kilayim". veechad behema chayya veof shello o shel chavero. veeno loke ad sheyyachnis beyado kemichchol bishfoferet. aval im heelam ze al ze bilvad o sheorran bekol makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Muttar lehachenis shene minin lesahar echad. veim raa otam rovim ze et ze eno zakuk lehaferishan. veasur leyisrael litten behemto leakkum leharebiah lo: 
Mi sheavar vehirkiv behemto kilayim hare hannolad mehem muttar bahanaa. veim haya min tehora im min tehora muttar baachila kemo shebbearnu bemaachalot asurot: 
Shene mine behema o chayya sheddomin ze leze af al pi shemmitabberin ze mizze vedomin ze laze hoil vehem shene minin hare hem kilayim veasur leharekivan. ketzad. hazzeev im hakkelev vehakkelev hakkuferi im hashshual vehatztzevaim im haizzim vehayeelim im harchelim vehassus im happered vehappered im hachamor vehachamor im hearod af al pi sheddomin ze laze hare hen kilayim ze baze: 
Min sheyyesh bo midbari veyishshuvi kegon shor habbar im hashshor veharammach im hassus muttar leharekivan ze im ze mippene shehen min echad. aval avvaz im avvaz bar kilayim ze baze mippene shehaavvaz (bettiyi) betzav mibbifnim veavvaz bar betzav mibbachutz michlal shehem shene minin. vehakkevi kilayim im hachayya veim habbehema veen lokin alav mippene shehu safek: 
Hayeludim min hakkilayim im hayu immotehen min echad muttar leharekivan ze al ze. veim hayu shene minin asur leharekivan ze al ze veim hirkiv loke. vechen im hirkiv ze hannolad afillu al min immo loke. ketzad. pered sheimmo chamor muttar leharekivo al pereda sheimmah chamor. veasur leharekivo afillu al hachamor. aval pered sheimmo sus asur leharekivo al pereda sheimmo chamor. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lefichach harotze leharekiv pered al pereda o limshoch bishte peredot bodek besimane aznayim vezanav vekol im domin ze laze beyadua sheimman mimmin echad umuttarin: 
Kol haose melacha bishne mine behema o chayya keechad vehaya echad mehen min tehora vehashsheni miyin temea hare ze loke bechol makom shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 10)</small> "lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav". echad hachoresh o hazzorea o hammoshech bahem agala o even keechad o hinhigam keechad vaafillu bekol loke shenneemar yachdav mikkol makom. aval hamezavvegan patur ad sheyyimshoch o yanhig: 
Echad shor vachamor veechad kol shene minin sheechad tame veechad tahor ben behema im behema kachazir im hakkeves. o chayya im chayya keyachmur im happil. o chayya im behema kechelev im haez o tzevi im hachazir vechayyotze bahem al kol ellu loke min hattora shechayya bichlal behema hi kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot. aval middivre sofrim shene minin shehen kilayim beharebaa asurim lacharosh bahen keechad ulemashchan ulehanhigan. veim asa bahen melacha keechad o mashach o hinhig makkin oto makkat mardut. veasur lehanehig behema min hayyabbasha im chayya shebbayyam kegon ez im shibbut veim asa patur: 
Agala shehayu moshchin otah kilayim hayyoshev baagala loke. veaf al pi shello hinhig. sheyyeshivato goremet labbehema shettimshoch haagala. vechen im haya yoshev echad baagala veechad manhig shenehen lokin. vaafillu mea shehinhigu kilayim keechad kullan lokin: 
Muttar laasot melacha beadam uvabbehema o chayya keechad. kegon adam shechoresh im hashshor o moshech agala im chamor vechayyotze baze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 10)</small> "beshor uvachamor yachdav" lo beadam vachamor o beadam veshor: 
Behemat pesule hammukdashin af al pi shehi guf echad asaah hakkatuv kishne gufin. mippene shehayta kodesh venaaset kekodesh uchechol meoravin ze beze venimtzet behema zo kivhema temea im hattehora hameoravin keechad. hare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 27 11)</small> "veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmenna karban laAdonai". mippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno medabber ella bifsule hammukdashin. lefichach hachoresh beshor pesule hammukdashin o hammarbia hare ze loke mishshum kilayim. veissur ze middivre kabbala:
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 10:
En asur bechile begadim ella tzemer ufishtan bilvad shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 11)</small> "lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav". veyesh bichrakke hayyam kemo tzemer sheggadel al haavanim shebbeyam hammelach tavnito ketavnit hazzahav vehu rach beyoter vechalach shemo veasur im happishtan mippene marit haayin shehu dome letzemer rechelim. vechen hashsherim vehakkalach asurin mippene marit haayin: 
Rachel bat ez tzamrah en lokin alav mishshum kilayim aval asur hu middivrehem mippene marit haayin kevan shennitchabber hatztzemer im happishtan tzad chibbur baolam hare ze kilayim min hattora. ketzad. tzemer ufishtim shetterafan ze im ze vesha otan veasa mehen levadin hare ellu kilayim. terafan vetava otan keechad vearag beged mittiuuy ze hare ze kilayim: 
Tafar beged tzemer beshel pishtan vaafillu tefaran bemeshi o shettafar beged tzemer bechute pishtan o beged pishtim bechute tzemer o kashar chute tzemer bechute pishtim o gedalan afillu natan tzemer ufishtim besak o bekuppa ucherachan hare ellu kilayim. vaafillu kashar gedil shel tzemer bigdil shel pishtan af al pi shehartzua beemtza. vechen im kafal bigde tzemer ufishtan ukesharan hare ellu kilayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 11)</small> "tzemer ufishtim yachdav" mikkol makom kevan shennitached neesar: 
Uminnayin shekkol issurin ellu shel tora shehare hutzrach hakkatuv lehattir kilayim betzitzit. kemo shellamdu mippi hashshemua shello nismecha parashat kilayim lefarashat tzitzit ella lehattir kilayim betzitzit. vehatztzitzit chutin keshurin bilvad hen. michlal shechibbur kaze shello bimkom mitzva asur min hattora. sheeno memaet battora davar shehu asur middivre sofrim: 
Hakkilayim en lo shiur afillu chut kol shehu shel tzemer beveged gadol shel pishtan o shel pishtan betzemer asur: 
Tzemer rechelim vetzemer gemallim vechayyotze bo shetterafan ze beze vetava mehen tiuuy. im haya hachetzi min harchelim hare hakkol ketzemer rechelim vahare hu kilayim im happishtan. veim haya harov min haggemallim muttar learvo im happishtan mippene shetztzurat hakkol tzurat tzemer gemallim veen choshshin lenimot shel tzemer hameorevet bahen mippene sheenan chute tzemer: 
Lefichach orot hakkevasim sheosin mehen begadim af al pi shettofrin otan befishtan muttarin veen choshshin lenimot shel tzemer af al pi shennichrechu bichlal chut happishtan shettafru bo shehare batlu bemiutan: 
Vechen hakkanbos vehappishtan shetterafan ze baze im rov min hakkanbos muttar leerog hattiuuy mehen im chute tzemer veim hayu mechetza lemechetza asur: 
Haose beged kullo tzemer gemallim o tzemer arnavim o kanbos vearag bo chut shel tzemer mitztzad ze vechut shel pishtan mitztzad ze hare ze asur mishshum kilayim: 
Beged tzemer shennifram muttar lifrof oto bechute pishtan. vekosher aval lo yitpor: 
Lovesh adam bigde tzemer uveged pishtan vechoger alehem mibbachutz uvilvad shello yichroch et hammeshicha veyikshor bah ben ketefav: 
Kile begadim muttar laasotam ulemachram veen asur ella lelavshan bilvad o lehitkassot bahen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 11)</small> "lo tilbash shaatnez". veneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 19)</small> "lo yaale alecha". haaliyya shehi derech levisha asur aval aliyya sheen derech levisha kegon ohel shehu kilayim muttar leshev tachtav. vechen muttar min hattora leshev al matztzaot shel kilayim shenneemar lo yaale alecha aval atta matztzio tachtecha. umiddivre sofrim afillu eser matztzaot zo al gabbe zo vehattachton shebbahen kilayim asur leshev al haelyon shemma tikkarech nima al besaro: 
Bamme devarim amurim berakkin kegon yeriot usemalot. aval bekashin sheenan nichrachin kegon karim uchesatot muttar leshev ulehasev alehen. vehu shello yihye besaro nogea bahem: 
Vechen happarochet shehi kilayim im hayta rakka asura shemma yissamech lah hashshammash vetaale al besaro. veim hayta kasha sheenah nichrechet mutteret: 
Minal shehu kilayim veen lo akev muttar lelavsho. sheor haregel kashe hu veeno nehene kishar or hagguf: 
Tofre kesut tofrin kedarkan uvilvad shello yitkavvenu bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. vehatztzenuin tofrim baaretz. vechen mochre kesut mochrin kedarkan uvilvad shello yitkavvenu bachamma sheyyatzel lahem hakkilayim sheal ketefan min hachamma. velo yitkavvenu baggeshamim lehitchammem bo. vehatztzenuin mafshilin bemakkel laachorehen: 
Lo yikkach adam betza keshehi chamma beveged kilayim shehare hu nehene bechilayim mippene hachamma o mippene hatztzinna. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Lo yilbash adam kilayim aray vaafillu al gabbe asara begadim sheeno mehannehu kelum. vaafillu lehaveriach et hammeches. veim lavash ken loke: 
En asur mishshum kilayim ella begadim shehen derech chimmum kegon hakketonet vehammitznefet vehammichnasayim vehaavnet vehassimla uvegadim shemmechappin bahen et hashshokayim veet hayyadayim vechayyotze bahem. aval tziltzulin ketannim sheosin otan haam bevet yad shellahen litzror bahen maot o tavlin usemartut shemmannichin alav retiyya o melugema o ispelanit vechayyotze bahen hare ellu muttarin af al pi shebbesaro nogea bahen sheen derech chimmum bechach: 
Tzitz shel or o meshi vechayyotze bahen shettala bahen chute tzemer vechute pishtan meduldalin al pene haadam kede lehaferiach hazzevuvin en bo mishshum kilayim sheen derech chimmum bechach: 
Hammanhig behemot umachnis chavalim letoch yado mehen pishtim umehen tzemer hare ze muttar veaf al pi shekkorchan al yado. aval im kesharan kullan naasu kilayim veasur lo lecharchan al yado: 
Mitpachot shemmekannechin bahen et hayyadayim umitpachot shemmesappegin bahen hakkelim vehakkarkaot (umitpachat sefer tora) umitpachot sefarim asurim mishshum kilayim shehare hayyadayim nogot bahen vehen nichrachin al hayyad tamid umitchammemin: 
Otot sheosin hakkovsin vehaggeradin babbegadim kede sheyyehe kol echad makkir et shello. im hayta ot shel tzemer befishtan o pishtan betzemer hare ze asur af al pi sheeno chashuv etzlo: 
Beged tzemer shechibbero im beged pishtan bitchifa achat eno chibbur veen ze kilayim. kibbetz shene rashe hachut keechad o shettachaf shete techifot hare ze kilayim: 
Muttar laasot min hakkilayim tachrichin lemet sheen al hammetim mitzva. velaasot mimmennu mardaat lachamor veyoshev aleha vehu shello yihye besaro nogea bah. velo yanniach mardaat zo al ketefo afillu lehotzi alehen et hazzevel: 
Hammet vehabbehema shehayu melubbashin kilayim muttar lenasan al ketefo: 
Beged tzemer sheavad bo chut shel pishtan. o beged pishtan sheavad bo chut shel tzemer. hare ze lo yimkerennu lenachri shemma yimkerennu hannachri leyisrael. velo yaasennu mardaat lachamor shemma yimtza oto acher veyikraennu meal hammardaat veyilbashennu shehare en hakkilayim nikkar bo. vechetzad takkanat beged ze. tzovo sheen hatztzemer vehappishtim olim betzeva echad umiyyad hu nikkar lo veshomto. veim lo nikkar hare ze muttar shemma nishmat vehalach lo shehare badak velo metzao. uchevar bearnu behilchot biot asurot shekkol issur sefekot middivre sofrim ulefichach hekellu besafek: 
Hallokeach keli tzemer min hannachri tzarich levadko yafe yafe shemma hen tefurin befishtan: 
Haroe kilayim shel tora al chavero afillu haya mehallech bashshuk kofetz lo vekoro alav miyyad. vaafillu haya rabbo shellimmedo chachma. sheen kevod habberiyyot doche issur lo taase hameforash battora. velamma nidche beheshev aveda mippene shehu lav shel mamon. velamma nidche betumat met hoil uferet hakkatuv <small>(Vayikra 21 3)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 6 7)</small> "uleachoto". mippi hashshemua lamdu laachoto eno mittamme aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva. aval davar sheissuro middivrehem hare hu nidche mippene kevod habberiyyot bechol makom. veaf al pi shekkatuv battora <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "lo tasur min haddavar" hare lav ze nidche mippene kevod habberiyyot. lefichach im haya alav shaatnez shel divrehem eno koro alav bashshuk veeno poshto bashshuk ad shemmaggia leveto veim haya shel tora poshto miyyad: 
Hallovesh kilayim o hammitkasse bo loke. haya lavush bechilayim kol hayyom kullo eno loke ella achat. hotzi rosho min habbeged vehechziro hotzi rosho vehechziro af al pi shello pashat habbeged kullo hare ze chayyav al kol achat veachat. bamme devarim amurim shehu chayyav achat kol hayyom keshehitru bo hateraa achat. aval im hitru bo veamru lo peshot peshot vehu lavush bo veshaha kede lifshot velilbosh achar shehitru bo hare ze chayyav al kol shehiyya ushehiyya shehitru bo aleha veaf al pi shello pashat: 
Hammalbish et chavero kilayim im haya hallovesh mezid hallovesh loke vehammalbish over mishshum <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl". veim lo yada hallovesh shehabbeged hu kilayim vehaya hammalbish mezid hammalbish loke vehallovesh patur: 
Kohanim shellavshu bigde kehunna shello bishat avoda afillu bammikdash lokin mippene haavnet shehu kilayim velo hutteru bo ella bishat avoda shehi mitzvat ase ketzitzit: seliku lehu hilchot kilayim besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 1: En haishsha mitgareshet ella bichtav sheyyaggia lah uchetav ze hu hannikra get. vaasara devarim hen ikkar haggerushin min hattora veellu hen. 1) shello yegaresh haish ella birtzono. 2) vesheyyegaresh bichtav velo bedavar acher. 3) vesheyyihye inyan hakketav sheggershah vehesirah mikkinyano. 4) vesheyyihye inyano davar hakkoret beno levenah. 5) vesheyyihye nichtav lishmah. 6) veshello yihye mechussar maase achar ketivato ella netinato lah [bilvad]. 7) vesheyyittenehu lah. 8) vesheyyittenehu lah bifne edim. 9) vesheyyittenehu lah betorat gerushin. 10) vesheyyihye habbaal o shelucho hu shennotno lah. ushear haddevarim shebbagget kegon hazzeman vachatimat haedim vechayyotze bahen hakkol middivre sofrim:

Uminnayin sheasara devarim ellu min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav vechatav lah sefer keritut venatan beyadah veshillechah mibbeto". im lo timtza chen beenav. melammed sheeno megaresh ella birtzono. veim nitgarsha shello birtzono enah megoreshet. aval haishsha mitgareshet birtzonah veshello birtzonah:

<small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "vechatav". melammed sheenah mitgareshet ella bichtav. <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "lah". lishmah. <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "sefer keritut". davar hakkoret beno levenah shello yishshaer lo aleha reshut. veim adayin lo nichrat beno levenah enah megoreshet kemo sheyyitbaer. <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "venatan beyadah". melammed sheenah mitgareshet ad sheyyinnaten hagget beyadah o beyad shelucha shehu keyadah o lachatzerah shehakkol keyadah kemo sheyyitbaer. <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "veshillechah". sheyyihye inyan hagget shehu hameshalleach otah. lo sheyyishlach atzmo mimmenna:

Ketzad. katav lah hare at meshullachat hare at megoreshet hare at leatzmech hare at mutteret lechol adam vechayyotze beze hainyan hare zo megoreshet. vegufo shel get hare at mutteret lechol adam. aval im katav lah eni balech eni arusech eni ishech en ze get shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "veshillechah" velo sheyyishlach et atzmo. vechen hakkotev leishto hare at bat chorin eno get:

Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "veshillechah mibbeto" en inyano shello yiggamru gerusheha ad shettetze mibbeto ella keshemmaggia get leyadah gamru gerusheha veaf al pi sheadayin hi beveto kemo sheyyitbaer. shello neemar veshillechah ella sheim geresh velo hotziah mibbeto hare ze kemi sheggeresh vehechezir gerushato. lefichach tzericha mimmennu get kemo sheyyitbaer:

Uminnayin shello yihye mechussar maase achar ketivato shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "vechatav" <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "venatan" mi sheeno mechussar ella ketiva unetina hu hagget hakkasher. yatza davar shemmechussar ketzitza achar hakketiva. lefichach im katav get al keren happara noten lah happara. veim chatach hakkeren achar shekketavo unetano lah eno get. vechen im katav bimchubbar af al pi shechatmu bo haedim achar shettelasho unetano lah eno get:
En kotvin bimchubbar afillu tofes hagget. katav hattofes bimchubbar utelasho veachar kach katav shem haish veshem haishsha vehazzeman vahare at mutteret lechol adam vachatamo unetano lah kasher:
Katav kol hagget al heale hazzarua beatzitz nakuv af al pi shennatan lah heatzitz kullo hagget pasul gezera shemma yiktom. aval kotev hu al charso shel atzitz venoten lah:

Uminnayin sheeno notno lah ella betorat gerushin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "sefer keritut" venatan beyadah sheyyitten oto betorat sefer keritut. aval im netano lah betorat shehu shetar chov o mezuza o shennetano beyadah vehi yeshena veneora vahare hu beyadah eno get. veim amar lah achar kach hare hu gittech hare ze get:

Amar leedim reu get sheani noten lah vechazar veamar lah kinsi shetar chov ze hare ze kasher. shehare hodia et haedim shennetano betorat gerushin. veze sheamar lah shetar chov mippene shennichlam mimmenna:

Hamegaresh tzarich sheyyomar lah kesheyyitten lah hagget hare ze gittech o hu gittech vechayyotze baze. veim natan beyadah velo amar kelum hare ze get pasul. bamme devarim amurim beshello haya medabber immah al iske gittah. aval im haya medabber al iske gittah venatal hagget venatan beyadah velo amar kelum hare ze get kasher:

Get shehaya munnach al haaretz veamar lah teli gittech meal gabbe karka unetalattu o shehaya kashur al yado o al yerecho ushelafattu mimmennu af al pi sheamar lah achar shebba leyadah hare ze gittech eno get shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "venatan beyadah" lo shettikkach hi meatzmah vahare lo natan lah lo hu velo shelucho. aval im hirkin lah begufo o hitta yado ad sheshshalfa hagget mealav veamar lah hare ze gittech hare ze get:

Uminnayin sheyyittenennu lah bifne edim. hare hu omer <small>(Devarim 19 15)</small> "al pi shenayim edim o shelosha edim yakum davar". vei efshar shettihye zo hayyom erva vehabba aleha bemitat bet din ulemachar tihye mutteret belo edim. lefichach im natan lah get beno levenah vaafillu beed echad eno get kelal:
Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hagget bichtav yad sofer. aval im katav habbaal hagget bichtav yado vechatam alav ed echad unetano lah hare ze get pasul [ufosel lichhunna]:

Takkanat chachamim hu sheyyihyu haedim chotmin al hagget. shemma yitten lah get bifne shenayim veyamutu venimtza hagget shebbeyadah kecheres mecharse adama shehare en bo edim. lefichach tikkenu sheyyaidu mittocho. veaf al pi shehaedim betocho notno lah bifne shenayim ben bifne otan haedim hachatumin alav ben bifne shenayim acherim. sheikkar haggerushin beede mesira:

Chatmu bo shenayim veavar unetano lah beno levenah o shennimtzeu ede mesira pesulin hare ze kasher hoil veedim shebbo kesherin vahare hagget yotze mittachat yadeha. veyesh shehora min haggeonim shehu pasul:
Hayu edav mittocho pesulin afillu echad pasul veechad kasher unetano lah bifne shene edim kesherin hare ze pasul shennimtza kimzuyyaf mittocho:

Hirchik et haedim min hakketav melo shene shitin pasul. vechamma yarchik et haedim min hakketav pachot mikkede shene shitin kede sheyyihyu nikrain immo. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hagget yotze mittachat yadeha velo hayu sham ede mesira. aval im mesaro lah beedim af al pi shehen meruchakin harebe veen nikrain immo veaf al pi sheen chatum alav ed kelal hare ze kasher. sheikkar haggerushin beede mesira:

Haedim shennoten et hagget bifnehem tzerichin likroto veachar kach yittenennu lah. veim netano lah bifnehem techilla chozrin vekorin oto achar shennetano lah. kerauhu vehu beyad habbaal o beyad shelucho vehechziruhu lo. vechazar hu vehichniso letoch yado unetano lah chozrin vekorin oto:

Lo kerauhu ella natlato uzerakattu layyam o laesh hare zo megoreshet. hoil ukerauhu techilla en choshshim lo shehechelifo. velo od ella afillu amar habbaal shetar acher haya velo haya hagget shekkeratem eno neeman vahare hi megoreshet:
Hare shello karu hagget battechilla venatan lah hagget bifnehem uzerakattu laur o layyam af al pi shehabbaal omer get kasher haya hare zo safek megoreshet:

Zarak lah hagget lachatzerah leven hechaviyyot bifne edim uvikkeshu umatzu mezuza o shetar acher en choshshin lah. shezze shennimtza hu shezzarak. nimtzeu sham shetayim shalosh mezuzot o shetarot choshshin shemma get shezzarak geraruhu achbarim vahare zo safek megoreshet:

Haedim shechotmin al hagget tzerichim lihyotam yodim likrot velachtom. veim enam yodim likrot korim bifnehem vechotmim. vehu sheyyakkiru leshon hagget. veim enam yodim lachtom roshmin lahem hanneyar berok vechayyotze bo middavar sheen rishshumo mitkayyem vehen kotvin al haroshem. veen osin kach bishar shetarot. kal hu shehekellu begitte nashim kede shello yihyu benot yisrael agunot hoil vachatimat haedim beget middivrehem kemo shebbearnu:

Af al pi shechatimat haedim beget middivrehem hitkinu sheyyihyu haedim mefarshin shemotehen bagget. vechen hitkinu beede hagget sheen chotmin ella ze bifne ze. veim chatmu ze shello bifne ze hare ze get pasul. vechen hitkinu chachamim sheyyichtov zeman bagget umekom ketivato kishar hashshetarot. shemma tihye ishto kerovato vetizne keshehi tachtav veyichtov lah get achar hazzenut veyitten lah. veim lo yihye bo zeman yechola lomar kodem hazzenut nitgarashti. ulefichach tikkenu zeman begittin:

Get sheyyesh alav edim veen bo zeman o shehaya mukdam o meuchar o shennichtav bayyom venechtam ballayla shelleacharav af al pi sheasukin beoto hainyan. o katav et hagget birushalayim vetaa vechatav belud. kol ellu pesulin ad sheyyachtemu bo bizman ketivato uvimkom ketivato:

Chatach mimmennu hazzeman unetano lah o shello katav shem hayyom ella beshabbat rishona o sheniyya mechodesh peloni o bechodesh peloni o beshana pelonit velo hizkir hachodesh afillu katav beshavua peloni kasher. vechen im katav bo hayyom gerashtiha kasher shemmashmao hayyom hazze sheyyatza bo hagget:

Vechen tikkenu sheyyehu monin begittin lemalchut oto hazzeman mishshum shelom malchut. katav leshem malchut sheenah malchut otah hammedina o levinyan habbayit o lechurban habbayit im derech anshe oto makom limnot bo hare ze kasher veim en darkan limnot bo hare ze pasul. uchevar nahagu kol yisrael limnot begittin o litzira o lammalchut alekkesanderos makdon shehu minyan shetarot. veim katav leshem malchut oto zeman bimdina sheyyesh bah reshut otah malchut hare ze kasher:

Haomer lishnayim kitvu vechitmu utenu get leishti venitacher haddavar yamim o shanim. o shennimtza hagget batel vehutzrechu lichtov lah get acher kasher achar kamma shanim kemo sheyyitbaer. hare ellu kotvin zeman hakketiva umekom hakketiva, lo hazzeman sheamar lahen habbaal bo kitvu velo oto hammakom. ketzad. hayu birushalayim kesheamar lahen vehayu omdin betishre venitacharu ad nisan vahare hen belud kotvin zeman hagget minnisan uvelud sheshsham nichtav hagget kishar shetarot:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 2:
Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "vechatav lah sefer keritut venatan beyadah". echad hakkotev beyado o sheamar leacher lichtov lo. veechad hannoten beyado o sheamar leacher litten lah. lo neemar vechatav ella lehodia sheen mitgareshet ella bichtav. venatan shello tikkach meatzmah: 
Amar lishnayim kitvu get vechitmu utenu leishti hare ellu kotvin vechotmin venotnin lah vehen hen sheluchav vehen hen edav. vechen im amar lassofer ketov li get leishti veamar laedim lachtom kotvim vechotmim venotnin lo vehu megaresh bo bechol et sheyyirtze: 
Vechotvin get laish af al pi sheen ishto immo. vehu sheyyihyu haedim vehassofer shekkatvu vechatmu bo makkirin veyodim shezze hu peloni veishto hi pelonit. veim hayu beoto makom shenayim sheshshemotehem shavim ushemot neshotehem shavim en megaresh echad mehem ella bemaamad chavero shemma yichtov get veyolicho leeshet chavero veyaasrenna alav: 
Uvishat hassakkana kotvin venotnin af al pi sheen makkirim. vehaishsha notenet sechar hassofer bechol makom: 
Vetzarich sheyyomar habbaal atzmo lassofer ketov velaedim chatomu. hare sheamru lo bet din o shenayim nichtov get leishtecha veamar lahem kitvu vechatvu hen atzman vechatmu bo hare ze kasher. aval im amru hem lassofer vechatav velaedim vechatmu af al pi shechazru unetanuhu labbaal vechazar venatan get ze leishto bifne edim hare ze get batel, shehare ketavo mi shello amar lo habbaal lechatvo: 
Amar lishnayim o lishlosha imru lassofer veyichtov get leishti veimru laedim veyachtomu veamru lassofer vechatav velaedim vechatmu, o sheamar lishnayim imru lassofer veyichtov get leishti veattem chatomu hare ze get pasul. umityashshevin bedavar ze harebe mippene shehu karov lihyot get batel: 
Uma ben pasul levatel. shekkol makom shenneemar bechibbur ze beget shehu batel hu batel min hattora. uvechol makom shenneemar pasul hu pasul middivre sofrim: 
Habbaal shehevi get beyado chatum veamar tenu get ze leishti hare ellu yittenu lah. amar laacherim lichtov get velachtom bo velitteno leishto vechatvu vechatmu venatnu lah venimtza hagget batel o pasul hare ellu kotvin get acher afillu mea ad sheyyaggia leyadah get kasher: 
Amar lahem habbaal kitvu vechitmu utenu lashshaliach leholich lah vechatvu vechatmu venatnu lashshaliach venimtza hagget batel o pasul en kotvim acher ad sheyyimmalchu babbaal. shehare lo asa otan sheluchim legerushin veshemma lo ratza ella sheyyichtevu veyittenu lashshaliach bilvad velo yishshaer lahem bo maase acher vahare katvu venatnu. lefichach lo yichtevu acher. veim katvu get acher kasher unetanuhu lashshaliach (venatnu lah) hare zo safek megoreshet: 
Haomer lishnayim o leyeter mishshenayim kitvu get utenu leishti garshuha shallechuha shivkuha tarchuha kitvu iggeret utenu lah hare ellu yichtevu get kasher veyittenu lah. amar lahem pitruha parnesuha asu lah kaddat asu lah kannimus asu lah karauy lo amar kelum. veim katvu get venatnu lah hare ze get batel: 
Amar lahem hotziuha izvuha hattiruha hannichuha hoiluha hare ze safek im mashma millot ellu gerushin o inyan acher. lefichach en kotvin lah. veim katvu get venatnu lah hare zo safek megoreshet: 
Haomer kitvu get leishti hare ellu kotvin vechotmin venotnin labbaal beyado veen notnin leishto ad sheyyomar lahem litten lah. veim natnu lah eno get. bamme devarim amurim bevari aval bimsukkan vehu adam shekkafatz alav hacholi bimhera vehichbid alav chalyo miyyad vehayyotze bekolar afillu al iske mamon vehamefaresh bayyam vehayyotze beshayyara veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyachtemu veyittenu lah. shehaddavar yadua shello nitkavven ze ella lichtov velitten lah: 
Bari sheamar kitvu get leishti vechatvu vechatmu venatnu lah veharag atzmo miyyad kegon shehishlich atzmo min haggag o hippil atzmo layyam hare ze get kasher. ala laggag udechafattu haruach venafal umet eno get. safek hippil atzmo safek dechafattu haruach hare ze get ad sheyyivvada lecha bevadday sheharuach dechafattu. vechen mi shehaya mushlach babbor veamar kol hashshomea koli yichtov get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu lah. vehu sheyyadu oto. veaf al pi sheheeluhu velo hikkiruhu hare ze kasher. shezze kishat hassakkana hu shekkotvim venotnin af al pi sheen makkirin. vechen mi shennaflu bo makkot raot shei efshar sheyyichye mehen afillu nishchatu bo rov simanin veramaz veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu shehare atta chay hu af al pi shessofo lamut: 
Mi shehayta ruach raa mevaetet oto veamar keshehitchil bo hacholi kitvu get leishti lo amar kelum. mippene sheen dato nechona umeyushshevet. vechen shikkor shehiggia leshichruto shel lot. veim lo higgia hare ze safek: 
Amar keshehu bari kitvu utenu get leishti veachar kach nivat mamtinin ad sheyyavri vechotvin venotnin lah. veen tzarich lachazor ulehimmalech bo achar shehivri. veim katvu venatnu kodem sheyyibbare hare ze pasul: 
Mi shennishtattek vahare dato nechona veamru lo nichtov get leishtecha vehirkin berosho bodkin oto shalosh peamim beserugin im amar lahem al lav lav veal hen hen hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. utzerichin levadko yafe yafe shemma nitrefa dato. vechen im katav beyado kitvu utenu get leishti hare ellu kotvin venotnin lah im hayta dato meyushshevet alav. sheen din mi shennishtattek kedin hacheresh: 
Mi shennasa keshehu pikkeach venitcharesh veen tzarich lomar nishtatta eno motzi leolam ad sheyyavri. veen somchin al remizat hacheresh velo al ketavo af al pi sheddato nechona umeyushshevet alav. aval im nasa ishsha keshehu cheresh megaresh birmiza sheen kiddushav kiddushin min hattora kemo shebbearnu. ucheshem shekkones birmiza kach motzi birmiza: 
Hamekaddesh ketanna al yede aviha vegershah keshehi ketanna aviha mekabbel gittah umishsheyaggia get leyad haav nitgarsha. gershah keshehi naara im higgia hagget leyadah o leyad aviha nitgarsha. veen osa naara hameorasa shaliach lekabbel gittah miyyad balah bechayye aviha. aval haav ose shaliach lekabbel hagget levitto hameorasa ben ketanna ben naara: 
Kiddeshah aviha keshehi ketanna umet. im mavchenet ben gittah ledavar acher hare zo mitgareshet mishsheyaggia hagget leyadah. veim lav enah mitgareshet ad shettavchin veim gershah enah megoreshet: 
Mi shehaddin noten shekkofin oto legaresh et ishto velo ratza legaresh. bet din shel yisrael bechol makom uvechol zeman makkin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani veyichtov hagget vehu get kasher. vechen im hikkuhu akkum veamru lo ase ma sheyyisrael omrin lecha velachatzu oto yisrael beyad haakkum ad sheyyegaresh hare ze kasher. veim haakkum meatzman anasuhu ad shekkatav hoil vehaddin noten sheyyichtov hare ze get pasul. velamma lo bittel get ze shehare hu anus ben beyad akkum ben beyad yisrael. sheen omrin anus ella lemi shennilchatz venidchak laasot davar sheeno mechuyyav bo min hattora laasoto kegon mi shehukka ad shemmachar o ad shennatan. aval mi shettekafo yitzro hara levattel mitzva o laasot avera vehukka ad sheasa davar shechayyav laasoto o ad shennitrachek middavar haasur laasoto en ze anus mimmennu ella hu anas atzmo bedato haraa. lefichach ze sheeno rotze legaresh meachar shehu rotze lihyot miyyisrael verotze hu laasot kol hammitzvot ulehitrachek min haaverot veyitzro hu shettekafo vechevan shehukka ad shettashash yitzro veamar rotze ani kevar geresh lirtzono. lo haya haddin noten shekkofin oto legaresh vetau bet din shel yisrael o shehayu hedyotot vaanasuhu ad sheggeresh hare ze get pasul hoil veyisrael anasuhu yigmor vigaresh. veim haakkum, anasuhu legaresh shello kaddin eno get. af al pi sheamar beakkum rotze ani veamar leyisrael kitvu vechitmu hoil veen haddin mechayyevo lehotzi vehaakkum anasuhu eno get:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 3:
Kol get shello nichtav leshem haish hamegaresh uleshem haishsha hammitgareshet eno get. ketzad. sofer shekkatav get lelammed o lehitlammed uva habbaal umatza shem shennichtav beget ze kishmo veshem haishsha keshem ishto veshem hair keshem iro unetalo vegeresh bo eno get: 
Yeter al ze katav legaresh et ishto venimlach umatza ben iro veamar lo shemi keshimcha veshem ishti keshem ishtecha unetalo mimmennu vegeresh bo af al pi shennichtav leshem gerushin eno get: 
Yeter al ze mi sheyyesh lo shete nashim sheshshemotehen shavot vechatav legaresh et haggedola venimlach vegeresh bo et hakketanna eno get. af al pi shennichtav leshem haish hamegaresh lo nichtav leshem zo shennitgarsha bo: 
Yeter al ken amar lesofer ketov vee zo sheertze agaresh bo vechatav hassofer al daat zo vegeresh bo achat mehen hare ze safek gerushin. vechol get shekketavo shello lishmah af al pi sheheevir alav kulmos lishmah eno get: 
Mi shekkatav [get] legaresh et ishto venimlach velo gershah venityached immah achar shekketavo lo yegarshenah beoto hagget paam acheret kesheyyirtze legarshah. veim gershah beoto hagget hayyashan hare zo megoreshet vetinnase bo lechattechilla shehare nichtav lishmah vahare natan lah atta beedim kehilchato. velamma lo yegarshenah bo lechattechilla gezera shemma yomru gittah kodem livnah: 
Amar lesofer ketov get liflonit veyihye immi lichsheessaenna agarshenna bo venichtav unesaah vegershah bo eno get. mippene shello hayta bat gerushin mimmennu keshennichtav get ze venimtza shennichtav shello leshem gerushin. aval im amar lo ketov oto laarusati lichsheessaenna agarshenna uchenasah vegershah bo kasher. ketavo livimto veachar sheyyibbemah gershah bo hare ze sefek gerushin hoil veenah ishto gemura keshekketavo: 
Mippene takkanat sofer hittiru chachamim lesofer sheyyichtov tafse gittin veyanniach mekom haish umekom haishsha umekom hazzeman umekom hare at mutteret lechol adam kede sheyyichtevem leshem haish hamegaresh uleshem haishsha hammitgareshet veachar kach yachtemu haedim lishmo velishmah: 
Sofer shekkatav hagget lishmo velishmah kehilchato vechatmu haedim shello lishmah hoil umesaru lah beedim hare ze get. (ella shehu pasul. velamma eno batel) lefi sheen haedim chotmin al hagget ella mippene tikkun haolam. veyesh mi sheomer sheim chatmu haedim shello lishmah hoil vehu kimzuyyaf mittocho hare ze get batel. vechen im haya echad meedav pasul o shehaya bo ed echad bilvad kasher. af al pi shennimsar beedim hare ze get batel. velo yerae li davar ze ella kimzuyyaf lo mezuyyaf vadday vehoil venimsar beede mesira kesherin hare ze pasul middivrehem: 
Hammevi get veavad mimmennu umetzao. im avad mimmennu bemakom sheen hashshayyarot metzuyot afillu metzao leachar zeman merubbe hare ze bechezkat shehagget sheavad mimmennu hu hagget shennimtza vetitgaresh bo. avad bemakom shehashshayyarot metzuyot im metzao miyyad vaadayin lo shaha adam sham min haovrim o shemmetzao bakkeli shehinnicho bo veyesh lo teviut ayin bearko verachbo shel get shehaya karuch hare hu bechezkato vetitgaresh bo: 
Huchzak beoto hammakom ish echad sheshshemo kishmo shebbagget choshshim shemma get ze hannimtza shel oto haish haacher hu hoil veavar adam sham veaf al pi shello shaha. veim nitgarsha bo hare zo safek megoreshet. aval im lo avar adam sham hare ze bechezkato af al pi shehuchzeku sham shenayim sheshshemotehen shavin: 
Haya laedim bagget siman muvhak kegon sheamru nekev yesh bo betzad ot pelonit. o sheamru meolam lo chatamnu ella al get echad sheyyesh bo shemot keshemot ellu hare ze bechezkato vetitgaresh bo veaf al pi shemmetzao achar zeman merubbe uvemakom shehashshayyarot metzuyot vehuchzeku sham shenayim sheshshemotehen shavin: 
Shenayim sheshshalchu shene gittin venitarvu notnin shenehen lazo ushenehen lazo beede mesira. lefichach im avad echad mehen hare hashsheni batel: 
Mi shehayu lo shene shemot. vechen ishsha sheyyesh lah shene shemot. keshemmegaresh kotev shemo ushemah shehen regilin bo viduin bo beyoter veomer ish peloni vechol shem sheyyesh lo geresh ishsha pelonit vechol shem sheyyesh lah. veim katav chanichato vachanichatah kasher: 
Katav hashshem sheenam yeduim bo beyoter vechatav kol shem sheyyesh lo hare ze pasul. shinna shemo o shemah veshem iro o shem irah af al pi shekkatav kol shem sheyyesh lo vechol shem sheyyesh lah eno get: 
Hakkol kesherin lichtov et hagget chutz mechamishsha. akkum veeved vecheresh veshote vekatan. afillu ishsha atzmah kotevet et gittah. yisrael shehemir leakkum o shehu mechallel shabbatot befarhesya hare hu keakkum lechol devarav: 
Velamma en kotvin ellu hachamishsha mippene shetztzarich hakkotev lichtov leshem haish hamegaresh uleshem haishsha hammitgareshet vehaakkum al daat atzmo hu kotev. vecheresh shote vekatan enan bene dea. vehaeved eno betorat gittin vekiddushin lefichach hu pasul keakkum lechol devarav. veim katav hagget echad mechamishsha ellu eno get af al pi shechatmu bo edim kesherim venimsar lah bichsherim: 
Katav echad mechamishsha ellu tofes hagget vehinniach makom hattoref shehu mekom haish umekom haishsha umekom hazzeman umekom hare at mutteret lechol adam uchetavan happikkeach haggadol hayyisreeli lishmo hare ze get kasher: 
Muttar lehaniach cheresh shote vekatan lichtov tofes hagget lechattechilla vehu sheyyihye gadol happikkeach omed al gabban. aval haakkum vehaeved en kotvin hattofes lechattechilla vaafillu yisrael omed al gabban shello hittiru lichtov tafse gittin shello lishmah lechattechilla ella mippene takkanat sofer kemo shebbearnu: 
Hakkotev get beshabbat o beyom hakkippurim bishgaga unetano lah hare zo megoreshet. ketavo vachatamo bo bayyom bezadon unetano lah enah megoreshet shehare haedim pesulin min hattora. ketavo beyom tov bezadon venimsar lah bifne edim kesherim beyom tov hare ze get pasul:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 4: En kotvin et hagget ella bedavar sherishshumo omed kegon deyo vesikra vekomos vekankantom vechayyotze bahen. aval im ketavo bedavar sheeno omed kegon mashkin ume perot vechayyotze bahen eno get. ketavo baavar beshachor uveshichor kasher. veen kotvin bahen lechattechilla:

Kotvin beme appetza lechattechilla al gav hanneyar vehaor vechayyotze bahen aval lo al gabbe megilla afutza mippene sheeno nikkar. veim katav eno get. vechen kol kayyotze bo. al hakkol kotvin et hagget vaafillu al issure hanaa. vechotvin al davar sheyyachol lehizdayyef vehu sheyyitteno lah beede mesira:

Ketzad kotev (oto). al hanneyar hammachuk veal haddiftera veal hacheres veal healin veal yado shel eved veal keren shel para. umoser lah haeved vehappara o hanneyar hammachuk vehaddiftera vechayyotze bo bifne edim:

Haya hagget chakuk al yado shel eved bichtovet kaaka vehaya yotze mittachat yadah vehayu haedim chakukim al yado hare zo megoreshet af al pi sheen lah ede mesira. shehare en yachol lehizdayyef. afillu hayu muchzakin beeved shehu shello veget chakuk al yado vehu yotze mittachat yadah vehi omeret beedim nimsar li hare zo safek megoreshet shemma meatzmo nichnas lah shehaggodrot en lahen chazaka:

Haya hagget chakuk al hattavla vehaedim alav vehu yotze mittachat yadah af al pi shehen muchzakin betavla shehu shellah hare zo megoreshet, shehaishsha atzmah kotevet et gittah. sheen kiyyum hagget ella bechotmav im en sham ede mesira:

Chakak hagget al halluach o al haeven o al tas shel mattechet im chafar yarche haotiyyot kasher. shezze ketav hu. hare hu omer <small>(yirmeya 17 1)</small> "ketuva beet barzel" kelomar shehu chafaro. vechen im chakak hayerechot meachore hattas ad shebbaltu bifne hattas. aval im chafar toch haot ad sheyyerau hayerechot gevohot mikkan umikkan kichtav dinar zahav shehakketav bolet eno get sheen ze ketav:

Hamekarea al haor tavnit ketav o sherasham al haor tavnit ketav hare ze kasher. kotvin et hagget bechol ketav uvechol lashon. get shennichtav bichtav min halleshonot veedav chatumin bichtav acher kasher. vehu sheyyehu haedim makkirin leshon hakketav vehakketiva
Echad min haedim chatam bichtav (lashon achat) vehaed hashsheni bichtav lashon acheret kasher. aval im haya miktzat hagget katuv belashon achat umiktzato belashon acheret pasul:

Kol lashon sheyyikkatev bah hagget tzarich sheyyizaher hassofer bedivre hagget shello yehe mashmaan shene inyanim ad shennimtza hakkore omer shemma lechach ulechach nitkavven sheen mashmao leshon gerushin o shemma leinyan ze nitkavven shemmashmao leshon gerushin. ella yihyu haddevarim sheen bahen safek beoto hallashon ella mashmaan inyan echad sheggeresh veshalach peloni et pelonit:

Vechen tzarich sheyyihye oto hakketav mevoar hetev beoto hakketav sheyyichtov bo ad sheyyedu hakketannim likroto shemmakkirim oto ketav sheenan lo nevonim velo sechalim (velo biktannim) ella benonim. velo yihye ketav meukkam umevulbal shemma tidme ot leot venimtza hainyan mishtanne:

Haya bo mashmaut shene inyanim o shehaya bichtavo ikkum o bilbul ad sheefshar sheyyikra mimmennu inyan acher. hoil venikra leinyan haggerushin veyesh bo mashma gerushin hare ze pasul. kevar nahagu kol am yisrael lichtov hagget leshon arami uchenosach ze af al pi shemmuttar lechatvo bechol lashon lechattechilla:

Veze hu nusach hagget
bechach beshabbat bechach vechach leyerach peloni bishnat kach vechach laytzira o lashshetarot leminyana deragilna lemimne bah hacha bemakom peloni ech ana peloni bar peloni demimmakom peloni vechol shum ochoran vachanicha deit li velaavahati uleatri uleatrehon daavahati tzaviti birut nafshi bidla anisna ufatrit veshavkit uteruchit yatichi lechi ant pelonit bat peloni demimmata pelonit vechol shum ochoran vachanicha deit lechi velaavahatichi uleatrichi uleatrehon daavahatichi di havit intati min kadmat dena. uchedo patrit veshavkit uteruchit yatichi lechi deyithavyayn rashshaa veshaltaa benafshichi limhach lehitnasba lechol gevar deyittzavyayn veinash lo yimche beyadichi (min shemi) min yoma denan ulealam vahare at mutteret lechol adam veden di yeheve lechi minnai sefer teruchin veget pitturin veiggeret shivukin kedat moshe veyisrael. vehaedim chotmim lematta kemo shebbearnu. peloni ben peloni ed. peloni ben peloni ed:

Kesheyyichtov hagget ballashon hazze uvenosach ze lo yichtov veden beyu"4 shemma yikra hakkore vedin kelomar mishpat yihye beni uvenech. velo yichtov veiggeret beyu"4 shemma yikra hakkore vei garat kelomar im zanit. lo yichtov limhach beyu"4 shemma yikra hakkore li mehach [vechen yarchik regel hahe"1 miggaggah shemma yikra limchach] kelomar lischok. velo yichtov tehevyan vetitzbeyan bishte yudi"50 shemma yikra hakkore tehevyayn vetitzbeyayn kelomar shehu medabber im shete nashim venimtza sheeno megaresh lazo ella lishtayim acherot. vechen yaarich levay"6 deuchedo shemma tidme leyu"4 veyihye mashmao uchedi kelomar bitnay ze eftor otach. vechen yaarich levay"6 deteruchin veshivukin shemma tidme leyu"4 veyihye mashma terichin ushevikin kelomar shehu omer lah shehi shavka vegersha oto. veal derech ze tzarich lehizzaher bechol lashon uvechol ketav sheyyichtov shello yihye bo mashma shete inyanot:
Hare shekkatav benosach ze velo heerich vavi"50 ellu o lo katav hayyudi"50 hayeterot o shekkatav hayyudi"50 sheamarnu shello yikkatvu hare ze get pasul. vechen kol kayyotze baze bechol lashon pasul:

Get shemmachak bo ot o teva o shettala ben hashshitin. im mittofes hagget hare ze kasher. veim min hattoref eno get. veim chazar uferesh besof hagget sheot pelonit teluya o al machak afillu mittoref hagget kasher kishar shetarot. vechen get shennimtza karua sheti vaerev shehu kera shel bet din hare ze get batel kishar hashshetarot. aval im nikra veeno kera shel bet din kasher:
Nimmok o shehirkiv o shennaasa kichvara kasher. nimchak o nittashtesh uvavua shello kayyemet im yachol likrot kasher veim lav eno get:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hagget yotze mittachat yadah beede chatima veen sham ede mesira. aval im yesh sham edim shennimsar lah hagget bifnehem vehaya kasher hare ze kasher. af al pi shehaya toref hagget al hammachak o ben hashshitin o shehaya karua sheti vaerev keshennatan lah bifnehem:

Chamishsha shekkatvu get echad lachamesh neshotehen. im ketavuhu bakkelal kegon shekkatvu bechach beshabbat geresh peloni liflonit ufeloni liflonit vechen amar kol echad mehen leishto lechi di tehevyan vechol tofes hagget ushene edim chotmin millematta hare ze get kasher veyinnaten lechol achat mehen beede mesira. veim en sham ede mesira kelal kol mi shettetze megilla zo mittachat yadah megoreshet. aval im katav bechach beshabbat geresh peloni liflonit vehishlim hagget vehitchil tachtav get acher beotah megilla vechatav uveyom ze o bechach beshabbat geresh peloni liflonit vehishlim hagget hashsheni. vechen ad shehishlim kol haggittin vehaedim millematta. im nittena megilla zo lechol achat mehen beede mesira hare kullan megorashot. veim en sham ede mesira vehayta megilla zo yotza mittachat yad achat mehen. im hayta zo sheggittah baacharona shehaedim nikrain immo hare zo megoreshet. veim hayta hammegilla yotza mittachat yad achat min harishonot hare zo safek megoreshet:

Katav anu peloni ufeloni gerashnu neshotenu pelonit ufelonit vehishlim hagget af al pi shennimsar lechol achat mehen beede mesira eno get sheen shete nashim mitgarshot beget echad shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "vechatav lah" velo lah velachavertah. chazar uferatan betoch hagget vechatav peloni geresh pelonit ufeloni geresh pelonit bizman peloni hare ellu kesherim:

Katav shene gittin bishne dappin bimgilla achat ze betzad ze. im yesh sham shene edim nikraim besof get ze ushene edim besof get ze hare ze kasher. vechol shettetze megilla zo mittachat yadah megoreshet:

Hayu sham shene edim bilvad baim mittachat get ze letachat get ze. im yatza mittachat yad zo shehaedim nikraim im gittah hare zo megoreshet. veim yatza mittachat yad sheniyya sheen haedim nikraim immo eno get ad sheyyimsor lah beedim:

Katav shene gittin bishne dappin ze lemala mizze vehaedim ben shene haggittin shennimtzeu besof harishon ulemala min hashsheni. im haya yotze mittachat yad zo shehaedim nikrain besof gittah hare zo megoreshet. vezo shehaedim nikrain berosh gittah millemala enah megoreshet. haedim shechatmu berosh haddaf shel get o mitztziddo o meachorav eno get. veim nimsar lah beedim kasher:
Hikkif rosh haddaf ze lerosh daf ze vehaedim baemtza shennimtzeu haedim berosh shene haggittin shenehem betelin. veim nimseru lahen beedim shenehem kesherim:

Shiyyer miktzat hagget uchetavo baddaf hashsheni vehaedim millematta besof haddaf hashsheni kasher. vehu sheyyihye nikkar bammegilla shello nechtach veshellechach nitkavven hassofer sheyyashlim baddaf hashsheni. aval im eno nikkar af al pi shennimsar beedim hare zo safek megoreshet. shemma shene gittin hayu venechtach miktzat ze missof haddaf umiktzat hashsheni merosh haddaf:

Hare shekkatav hagget veachar sheggamar katav shaalu bishlom peloni o shalom alecha peloni rei vechayyotze baze vechatmu haedim millematta vahare get ze yotze mittachat yadah hare zo safek megoreshet. shemma lo chatmu haedim ella al sheilat shalom. aval im katav veshaalu bishlom peloni o veshalom alecha rei vechayyotze baze shehare livva devarim ellu al divre hagget veal shenehem chatmu hare zo megoreshet. veim nimsar lah beedim ben kach uven kach hare ze get kasher:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 5: Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "venatan beyadah" en inyan hakkatuv ella sheyyaggia hagget lah. veechad yadah o chekah o chatzerah o sheluchah sheasta yado keyadah hakkol echad hu. veechad chatzerah hakkenuya lah o chatzerah hammuskeret lah o sheula lah hakkol reshutah hu. umishsheyaggia get lirshutah nitgarsha:

Hazzorek get leishto letoch chatzerah. im hayta omedet sham betzad chatzerah nitgarsha. veim lav lo nitgarsha ad shettaamod betzad chatzerah veaf al pi shehi chatzer sheyyishtammer hagget betochah. shechov hi lah haggerushin veen chavin laadam ella befanav:

Hayta omedet berosh haggag shellah vehu millematta bachatzero uzerako lah lemala kevan shehiggia laavir mechitztzot hammaake o lefachot mishshelosha tefachim samuch laggag nitgarsha uvilvad sheyyanuach. aval im nimchak o nisraf kodem sheyyaggia lah af al pi shennimchak leachar shehiggia laavir mechitztzot o achar shehiggia lefachot mishshelosha tefachim samuch laggag kegon shennashva haruach veheelathu venimchak o nisraf hoil veeno holech lanuach eno get velo nitgarsha:
Haya haggag shello vehu millemala bo vehi millematta bechatzer shellah vezarak lah gittah. kevan sheyyatza hagget mimmechitztzot haggag vehiggia limchitztzot mekomah shehi omedet bo nitgarsha:
Zerako lirshutah letoch haesh venisraf o letoch hammayim [venimchak o] neevad eno get. aval im higgia lirshutah [venach] veachar kach ba haesh userafathu hare ze get:

Zerako al gabbe kane o romach hanneutzim birshutah eno get ad sheyyanuach bemakom hammishtammer bo. shete chatzerot zo lefanim mizzo happenimit shellah vehachitzona shello vechatle hachitzona gevohot al happenimit kevan shezzarak hagget letoch avir hachitzona nitgarsha. shehappenimit bechatle hachitzona mishtammeret ma sheen ken bekuppot:

Ketzad. shete kuppot zo lefanim mizzo happenimit shellah vehachitzona shello vezarak lah gittah betochan afillu higgia laavir happenimit enah megoreshet ad sheyyanuach al tzad hakkuppa happenimit. bamme devarim amurim beshehayta mutta al tziddah veen lah shulayim aval yesh lah shulayim afillu nach bekarkaitah enah megoreshet shekkeli haishsha birshut habbaal eno kone lah hagget ella im ken eno makpid al mekomo:

Zarak lah gittah vehi betoch beto o betoch chatzero enah megoreshet ad sheyyaggia hagget leyadah o lichli min hakkelim shellah sheen habbaal makpid al mekomo kegon tzelochit o kefifa ketanna o kayyotze bahen. vechen im higgia lammitta shellah shehi yoshevet aleha vehayta gevoha asara tefachim hare zo megoreshet shehare chalka reshut leatzmah veen habbaal makpid al mekom kire hammitta:

Hishil lah habbaal makom bachatzero velo yichado [lah] vezarak lah get vehiggia learba ammot shellah shehi omedet bahen hare zo megoreshet. nitgalgel venafal al gabbe kora o al gabbe sela rachok mimmenna. im hammakom shennafal alav en bo arba ammot al arba ammot veeno gavoah asara veen lo sham levavy hare ze lo chalak reshut leatzmo ucheillu hu vehi bemakom echad. veim yesh sham echad mishshelosha devarim ellu chalak reshut leatzmo umakom echad hishil lah shene mekomot lo hishil lah veenah megoreshet ad sheyyaggia hagget leyadah:
Zarak lah gittah lirshutah veavar betoch reshutah shehi omedet bah venafal chutz lirshutah af al pi sheavar befachot mishshelosha samuch laaretz enah megoreshet ad sheyyanuach birshutah:

Hayta omedet al gaggah (zo) uzerako lah venafal begag acher samuch lo. im yechola lifshot yadah velittelo hare zo megoreshet sheaf al pi sheddiyyurin chalukin lemala keshem shehen chalukin lematta en bene adam makpidin al makom kayyotze baze:

Hayta yadah katafres vezarak hagget al yadah venafal laaretz. im nafal letoch arba ammot shellah venach hare zo megoreshet. nafal letoch hayyam o letoch haesh enah megoreshet. vehu shehayta omedet al gabbe hammayim o samuch laesh shemmittechillat nefilato leibbud haya omed:

Zerako lah birshut harabbim o birshut sheenah shel shenehem karov lo enah megoreshet. haya hagget mechetza lemechetza umimmechetza lemechetza ad sheyyihye karov lah hare zo safek megoreshet. haya karov lah kede shettashuach vetittelennu hare ze pasul ad sheyyaggia get leyadah veachar kach tinnase bo lechattechilla:
Ketzad hu karov lo. haya hu yachol leshamro vehi enah yechola leshamro ze hu karov lo shenehem yecholim leshamro o sheshshenehem en yecholin leshamro ze hu mechetza lemechetza:

Ba hu techilla veamad veachar kach amda hi kenegdo uzerako lah. im haya hagget betoch arba ammot shello enah megoreshet af al pi sheim tashuach tittelennu. amda hi techilla uva hu veamad kenegdah uzerako lah af al pi shehu mechetza lemechetza hoil vehu letoch arba ammot shellah hare ze get pasul ad sheyyaggia hagget leyadah:
Zarak hagget leyadah vehaya kashur bimshicha uketzat hammeshicha beyado. im yachol lenatteko velahavio etzlo enah megoreshet ad shettifsok hammeshicha. veim eno yachol lenatteko hare zo megoreshet:

Natan hagget beyad avdah vehu neor vehi meshammarto. im haya kafut hare ze get ucheillu higgia lachatzerah shehi omedet betziddah. veim eno kafut eno get. netano beyad haeved vehu yashen vehi meshammarto hare ze pasul. veim haya kafut hare zo megoreshet:

Katav hagget unetano beyad avdo vechatav lah shetar mattana alav kevan shezzachta baeved zachta bagget venitgarsha im haya kafut. veim eno kafut veneor kanta haeved veenah megoreshet ad sheyyaggia hagget leyadah. vechen im natan hagget bachatzero umocher lah hechatzer o netano lah kevan shekkanta hechatzer bishtar o bechesef o bachazaka nitgarsha:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 6: Hashaliach sheosa haishsha lekabbel lah gittah miyyad balah hu hannikra sheliach kabbala. umishsheyaggia hagget leyad sheluchah titgaresh keillu higgia leyadah. utzericha laasoto bishne edim. utzericha shene edim sheyyaidu shehiggia hagget leyad sheluchah. vaafillu hem harishonim o echad min harishonim hare zo edut gemura:

Bamme devarim amurim besheavad hagget o nikra. aval im haya hagget yotze mittachat yede sheliach kabbala eno tzarich edim. ben shennetano lo habbaal beno leveno ben shennimsar lo beedim. yetziato mittachat yado kitziato mittachat yede haishsha. veaf al pi chen lo yitten lo hagget lechattechilla ella beede mesira kemo haishsha atzmah:
Habbaal eno yachol laasot shaliach lekabbel get leishto. aval yachol laasot shaliach leholich hagget leishto veze hu hannikra sheliach holacha:
Vechen haishsha sholachat shaliach lehavi lah get miyyad balah veze hu hannikra sheliach havaa. veen sheliach holacha vahavaa tzarich edim:

Veen haishsha mitgareshet beget sheshshalach habbaal o shehevi lah sheliach havaa ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. vechol makom shenneemar beinyan gittin shaliach setam hu sheliach holacha o sheliach havaa:

Hakkol kesherin lishlichut hagget ben lishliach kabbala ben lishliach holacha vahavaa chutz min hachamishsha. haakku"40 vehaeved vehacheresh vehashshote vehakkatan. veim kibbel o hevi echad mehen eno get:
