Aval hannashim vehakkerovim kesherim. vaafillu happesulin middivre sofrim baavera kesherin lishlichut get. aval happesulin baavera middivre tora pesulin lahavaat hagget. veim heviu hare ze pasul. bamme devarim amurim keshennitkayyem hagget bechotmav aval im lo nismoch bo ella al divre pasul baavera min hattora eno get:

Haya hashshaliach katan keshennatan lo hagget vegadal keshehevio. cheresh venitpakkeach. shote venishtappa. akku"40 venitgayyer. eved venishtachrer. hare ze batel. aval im natan lo hagget vehu pikkeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach. haya shafuy keshennatan lo hagget venishtatta vechazar venishtappa keshehevi hagget leyad haishsha hare ze get kasher mippene shettechillato vesofo bedaat:

Haishsha sheasta shaliach beedim veamra lo tol li gitti vihe li beyadcha hare ze shaliach lekabbala ucheillu amra lo hitkabbel li gitti. veyesh laishsha laasot sheliach kabbala lekabbel lah gittah miyyad shelucho shel balah. uketanna enah osa shaliach lekabbala. af al pi shechatzerah kona lah gittah kigdola. mippene sheshsheliach kabbala tzarich edim veen meidin al hakkatan sheeno ben dea gemura:

Haishsha sheasta shaliach lekabbala veamar lo habbaal en retzoni shettekabbel lah gittah ella hare ze gittah holech oto lah. harshut beyad habbaal venaasa ze shaliach leholacha velo shaliach lekabbala. aval im amar lo hitkabbel lah gittah [o he lecha] o zeche lah lo akar shelichut hakkabbala. aval im amar lo holech lah akar shelichut hakkabbala venaasa sheliach habbaal. vechen im amar lo holech veten lah akar shelichut hakkabbala:

Sheliach haishsha shebba lekabbel get min habbaal veamar lo sheliach kabbala ani veomer lo habbaal holech get ze kemo sheamra kelomar eni oker shelichutecha ella ben sheasta otcha sheliach kabbala o sheliach havaa hare atta kemo sheamra. vehevi et hagget. veamra lo lo [shaliach lekabbala] samticha ella sheliach havaa afillu higgia leyadah enah megoreshet. shehare akar hashshaliach shelichut sheamra hi veamar labbaal meolam lo naaseti sheliach havaa lah:

Amar shaliach labbaal sheliach havaa ani veamar lo habbaal holech kemo sheamra. vehevi et hagget. veamra lo shaliach lekabbala samticha. kevan shehiggia get leyadah megoreshet shehare lo akar shelichut sheamra ella gara otah shehare hi omeret lekabbala vehu omer labbaal lahavaa bilvad:

Habbaal sheshshalach get leishto. ba shaliach litteno lah velo netalto. ella amra lo bifne edim yihye (li) get ze pikkadon etzlecha. o sheamra lo hare at shaliach lekabbelo li. hare zo megoreshet besafek ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. umishsheyaggia hagget leyadah titgaresh vadday:

Shaliach shehevi get keshehu notno lah notno lah bifne shenayim veotan hashshenayim tzerichin likroto veachar kach yinnaten lah bifnehem. sheddin hashshaliach im haishsha kedin habbaal immah shettachtav hu kam. lefichach im netano hashshaliach lah velo kerauhu ede mesira unetalto uzerakto layyam hare zo safek megoreshet:
Avar hashshaliach venatan hagget beno levenah yittelennu mimmenna veyachazor veyitteno lah bifne shenayim. veim met hoil vehagget yotze mittachat yadah mekuyyam bechotmav hare ze get kasher:

Shaliach shennatal hagget vekodem sheyyaggia leyad haishsha chazar habbaal veamar lo get sheshshalachti immecha batel hu. o shekkadam veamar laishsha get sheshshalachti lich batel hu. o sheshshalach shaliach acher levattelo. o sheamar laacherim get sheshshalachti leishti batel hu. hare ze batel veaf al pi shehiggia get leyadah. vechol hamevattel bifne acherim tzarich sheyyevattel bifne shenayim. veim achar shehiggia get leyadah o leyad sheliach kabbala eno yachol levattelo veaf al pi shechazar betoch kede dibbur uvittelo hoil veachar shehiggia leyadah o leyad sheliach kabbala o lachatzerah bittelo eno batel vahare ze get kasher:

Haya mechazzer umevakkesh shaliach kede levattelo. o shehaya mevakkesh shenayim sheyyevattelennu bifnehem uven shehu mechazzer verodef higgia get leyadah veachar kach bittelo eno batel. af al pi shehaya mechazzer levattelo kodem shehiggia hagget leyadah:

Amar laasara kitvu get utenu leishti yachol levattel laze shello bifne ze vaafillu bifne shenayim acherim. shalach hagget beyad shenayim hare ze yachol levattel ze shello bifne ze. vaafillu hayu asara mishshebbittelo bifne echad mehem batel hagget:

Vechen mi sheamar lishnayim get sheani kotev leishti batel hu vechatav achar kach get unetano lah bifne shenayim acherim hare ze batel. vezo hi mesirat hammodaa al hagget. vechen im amar lahem kol get sheyyichtov li peloni batel. o kol get sheechtov bevet dino shel peloni hare ze get batel. o kol get sheechtov mikkan vead esrim shana batel. hare get batel. vechen im amar bifne shenayim kol get sheechtov liflonit ishti batel hu vechol davar sheavattel bo modaa zot hare hu batel vechatav achar kach get unetano lah af al pi shebbittel hammodaa kodem sheyyichtov hagget hare hagget batel:

Im ken mahu takkanat davar ze. sheyyomru lo haedim kodem ketivat hagget emor befanenu shekkol haddevarim shemmasarta sheggormin kesheyyitkayyemu otan haddevarim levattel get hare hen betelim vehu omer hen. veachar kach omer lahem lichtov velachtom velitten lah velo yenichuhu lelech ad sheyyaggia hagget leyadah kede shello yetze vivattelo. veen hammoser modaa velo hamevattel modaa tzarich kinyan:

Hashsholeach get beyad hashshaliach uvittel hagget hare chozer umegaresh bo kesheyyirtze. shello bittelo mittorat get ella mittorat shelichut. lefichach im haya hagget beyad habbaal uvittelo kegon sheamar get ze batel hu eno megaresh bo leolam vahare hu kecheres hannishbar. veim geresh bo enah megoreshet. vechen im peresh beet shebbittelo vehu beyad hashshaliach veamar get sheshshalachti hare hu batel millihyot get en megaresh bo leolam:

Bee ze leshonot mevattel hagget. amar batel hu. i efshi bo. get ze lo yoil. lo yattir. velo yaazov. velo yeshalleach. velo yegaresh. yehe kecheres. yehi cheres. hare hu kecheres. veim amar echad meellu vechol haddome lahen hare ze bittelo:

Aval im amar get ze eno. get pasul hu. eno moil. eno mattir. eno meshalleach. eno megaresh. cheres hu. lo amar kelum. sheen ze lashon mevattel ella leshon modia amittat haddavar vahare hodia lanu davar sheeno ken. kemi sheomer al davar asur shehu muttar o al davar hattame shehu tahor:
Amar get ze batal shemmashmao poal sheavar kegon <small>(Shir HaShirim 5 6)</small> “chamak avar" hare ze safek. lefichach im nitgarsha beget ze hare safek megoreshet:

Mi sheshshalach get leishto uva shaliach veamar lo lo metzatiha o lo ratzta likkach. veamar habbaal baruch hattov vehammetiv o kayyotze bidvarim ellu shemmashmiin sheen bedato legarshah shehare sameach beikkuv hagget. lo batel hagget ella yitten vetihye megoreshet. ad sheyyomar lo beferush lo titten lah o yevattel beferush:

Mi sheshshalach get leishto vechazar uvittelo bifne shenayim acherim. vechen mi shemmasar modaa al hagget makkin oto makkat mardut mippene sheggorem lihyot mamzerim. shehare yaggia get leyadah vetinnase bo veachar zeman yetzu edim shebbittel bifnehem o shemmasar modaa bifnehem kodem sheyyichtov hagget venimtza havvalad mamzer:

Shaliach shehevi get unetano laishsha en omrin shemma bittelo habbaal ella notnin oto lah bechezkat shehu kasher vetinnase bo. veim nimtza achar ken shebbittelo tetze vehavvalad mamzer. vechen hakkotev get unetano leishto en omrin shemma masar modaa al get ze ella hare hu bechezkat kashrut vetinnase bo:

Vechen hammevi get vehinniach habbaal chole o shehaya zaken notno lah bechezkat shehu kayyam. aval im hinnicho goses sherov gossin lemita veaf al pi shennetano lah hare ze sefek gerushin sheen get leachar mita. vechen ir shehikkifah hachayil vehi bematzor usefina hammuterefet bayyam vehayyotze ladun hare ellu bechezkat chayyim. veim haya get echad mehen beyad hashshaliach notno leishto vetihye bechezkat megoreshet:

Aval ir shekkevashah haggayis vehuvkea usefina sheavda bayyam vehayyotze lehareg mibbet din shel akku"40. umi sheggerarattu chayya o shetafo nahar o nafla alav mappolet notnim alehem chumre chayyim vechumre metim. veim haya get echad mehen beyad hashshaliach eno notno leishto veim netano lah hare zo sefek megoreshet. veim noda shemmet habbaal kodem sheyyaggia hagget leyadah eno get:
Habbaal sheshshalach get leishto hare hu chayyav bimzonoteha uvechol tenae ketubba ad sheyyaggia hagget leyadah o leyad sheliach kabbala:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 7: Shaliach shehevi get mimmakom lemakom beeretz yisrael af al pi shello raa ketivat hagget velo yada mi hem edav ella natan lo habbaal get veamar lo ten get ze leishti hare ze notno lah bifne edim veaf al pi sheen edav yeduin etzlenu vetihye megoreshet vetinnase bo:

Ba habbaal veirer veamar lo gerashtiha meolam veget shehuva lah mezuyyaf hu yitkayyem bechotmav. veim lo nitkayyem velo nodu edav kelal tetze vehavvalad mamzer shehare enah megoreshet. [avad hagget hare zo sefek megoreshet]. lefichach nashim shechezkatan shehen sonot zo et zo en neemanot lehavi get beeretz yisrael zo lazo shemma mezuyyaf hu vetitkavven lekalkel otah kede shettinnase veteaser al balah:
Veellu hen hannashim shechezkatan sonot zo et zo. chamotah uvat chamotah vetzaratah afillu hayta hatztzara nesua leacher. vivimtah afillu hayta achotah uvat balah. aval shear kol hannashim kesherot:

Hammevi get mimmakom lemakom beeretz yisrael vechala o neenas meshallecho beyad acher. vechen hashsheni im chala meshallecho beyad acher. vaafillu mea. veen tzarich edim lachazor velaasot shaliach bifnehem. vehaacharon shehiggia hagget leyado notno lah bifne shenayim vetitgaresh bo af al pi shemmet harishon:

Shaliach shehevi get mimmakom lemakom bechutza laaretz o meeretz yisrael lechutza laaretz. o mechutza laaretz laaretz. im haya hashshaliach omed bishat ketivat hagget vachatimato hare ze omer bifne shenayim befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam veachar kach yitten lah bifnehem vetitgaresh bo. veaf al pi sheen edav yeduin etzlenu. vaafillu hayu shemot edav kishmot haakku"40 en choshshin lahen:
Ba habbaal veamad veirer en mashgichin bo. lefichach af hannashim shessonot zo et zo neemanot lehavi get ze velomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam:

Vechen shaliach shehevi get beeretz yisrael veamar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam af al pi sheeno tzarich im yavo habbaal viarer en mashgichin bo. veim en hashshaliach omed bishat ketiva vachatima lo yinnaten lah ella im ken nitkayyem bechotmav. veyesh lashshaliach lihyot mikkelal hashshelosha shekkiyyemu otan bechotmav. veim lo nitkayyem venatan lah hare ze pasul ad sheyyitkayyem. veim ba habbaal veirer velo nitkayyem enah megoreshet. avad hagget hare zo safek megoreshet:

Umippene ma hitzrichu lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam bechutz laaretz. kede shello tihye haishsha tzericha lekayyemo im yavo habbaal viarer mippene sheen haedim metzuyin lekayyemo mimmakom lemakom bechutza laaretz:

Baal shehevi reaya berura shegget ze shenneemar bo befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam mezuyyaf hu hare ze batel. shello heeminu devarav shel echad sheamar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam ella lidchot irur habbaal sheen immo reaya. aval bimkom edim shemmachchishin oto lo heeminuhu:

Hanneharot shebbeeretz yisrael vehannissin shebbayyam haggadol shebbetoch hattechum shel eretz yisrael hare hen keeretz yisrael. veshechutz lattechum kechutza laaretz. uvehilchot terumot yitbaaru techume eretz yisrael. uvavel keeretz yisrael legittin:

Get shekketavo beeretz yisrael vachatamo bechutza laaretz tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. ketavo bechutza laaretz vachatamo beeretz yisrael eno tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam:

Nichtav miktzat hagget befanav venechtam kullo befanav. im miktzato harishon hu hare ze omer befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam afillu lo nichtav bo ella shita achat befanav vaafillu shama kol hakkulmos kotev vechatmu haedim befanav hare ze omer befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. vechen im yatza hassofer lashshuk vechazar vehishlim et hagget eno choshesh shemma acher metzao veamar lo uleshem ishsha acheret ketavo ella omer befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam:

Amar befanay nichtav aval lo befanay nechtam. befanay nechtam aval lo befanay nichtav. befanay nichtav kullo vechatam ed echad aval lo haed hashsheni. afillu haya hu haed hashsheni hare ze yitkayyem bechotmav veachar kach yinnaten lah. veim heid hu veacher al haed hashsheni shello chatam befanav hare ze kasher veyinnaten lah. veen tzarich lomar im heidu shenayim acherim al ketav haed hashsheni shezze kasher:

Shenayim sheheviu get bechutza laaretz af al pi shello nichtav venechtam bifnehem hoil unetano lahem habbaal litteno leishto hare ellu notnin lah vetihye megoreshet. shehare en habbaal yachol learer beget ze af al pi sheeno mekuyyam shehare sheluchav hem edav. sheillu amru hashshenayim befanenu nitgarsha hare zo megoreshet af al pi sheen sham get:

Bamme devarim amurim bizman shehagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem aval im en hagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem tzerichin lomar befanenu nichtav uvefanenu nechtam. lefichach im amar echad befanay nichtav vehaacher omer befanay nechtam vaafillu shenayim omrim befanenu nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam hoil veeno yotze mittachat yede shenehem lo yinnaten lah ad sheyyitkayyem bechotmav:
Amar echad befanay nichtav ushenayim omrim befanenu nechtam kasher af al pi sheeno yotze mittachat yadam shehare nitkayyem bechotmav:

Shaliach shehevi get bechutza laaretz unetano lah beno levenah o shennetano lah bifne shenayim velo amar lah befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam af al pi shennisset notlo mimmenna vechozer venotno lah bifne shenayim veomer bifnehem befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. veim lo netalo mimmenna hare ze pasul ad sheyyitkayyem bechotmav:
Netano lah velo hispik lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam ad shennishtattek hare ze yitkayyem bechotmav veachar kach yinnaten lah:

Hassuma eno yachol lehavi get ze shel chutza laaretz mippene sheeno yachol lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. lefichach im nichtav venechtam befanav keshehu patuach venistama hare ze omer bifne shelosha befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam venotno lah. vechen haishsha shehevia get ze shel chutza laaretz tzericha shelosha lomar bifnehem befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. shello amru bifne shenayim ella bizman shehashshaliach kasher leedut shehare hu mitztaref im hashshenayim venimtza mikkelal hashshelosha shekkiyyemu get ze bidvarav. shehaed naasa dayyan bedavar shehu middivrehem:

Chala hashshaliach o neenas ba levet din veomer lahem get ze befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam vehen meshallechin oto beyad shaliach acher. veen hashshaliach haacharon tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam ella omer sheliach bet din ani venotno lah bifne edim:

Chala hashsheni o neenas ose shaliach acher bevet din afillu mea vehaacharon omer sheliach bet din ani venotno lah. af al pi shemmet hashshaliach harishon. umippene ma tzarich bet din mippene shehu tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. aval im nitkayyem hagget bechotmav af al pi shennetano shaliach leshaliach afillu mea benam leven atzmam ad shehiggia hagget leyadah hare ze kasher. veaf al pi shello peresh habbaal velo amar lo shallecho beyad acher im teanes im chala o neenas hare ze meshallecho:
Kol haose shaliach eno tzarich sheyyehe hashshaliach immo bevet din ella omer lahem hare peloni sheluchi vaafillu shello befanav. vechen hashshaliach ose shaliach acher shello befanav afillu hen mea:

Haish shennatan get leishto venichtav venechtam befaneha veamar lah hare at sheluchati leholacha ad bet din peloni vehem yaamidu shaliach veyittenu lich get ze vetitgarshi bo hare zo neemenet lomar bifnehem befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam vehem notlin oto venotnin oto leshaliach litteno lah kemaamar habbaal:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehitna aleha habbaal tenay ze aval im lo hitna aleha ella natan lah gittah vahare hagget yotze mittachat yadah enah tzericha lomar kelum vahare hi bechezkat megoreshet. hoil veget shebbeyadah katuv kehilchato vehaedim chatumim alav. veaf al pi sheen anu makkirin ketav otan haedim velo nitkayyem en choshshin lah shemma ziyyefa oto shehare enah mekalkelet al atzmah. veod shehaedim hachatumim al hagget hare hen kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din ad sheyyehe sham mearer. lefichach naamid hagget bechezkato vetinnase. veen choshshin shemma yimmatze mezuyyaf. kemo shennaamid hagget bechezkat kasher kesheyyavi oto hashshaliach ad sheyyearer habbaal o ad sheyyavi reaya shehu mezuyyaf o batel. sheim nachush lidvarim ellu vechayyotze bahen kach haya lanu lachush leget sheyyitten habbaal befanenu shemma bittelo veachar kach netano. o shemma edim pesulin chatmu bo vahare hu kimzuyyaf mittocho. o shemma shello lishmah nichtav. ucheshem sheen choshshin laze vechayyotze bo ella naamidennu al chezkato ad sheyyivvada shehu batel kach lo nachush lo lashshaliach velo laishsha atzmah shehagget yotze mittachat yadah. sheen dine haissurin kedine hammamonot:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 8: Hamegaresh al tenay im nitkayyem hattenay hare zo megoreshet veim lo nitkayyem hattenay enah megoreshet. uchevar bearnu beferek shishshi mehilchot ishut mishpete hattenain kullam. vesham nitbaer shehamegaresh al tenay kesheyyitkayyem hattenay tihye megoreshet beshaa sheyyitkayyem. lo bishat netinat hagget leyadah. lefichach yesh labbaal levattel hagget o lehosif al tenao o lehatenot al tenay acher kol zeman shello nitkayyem hattenay harishon af al pi shehiggia get leyadah. veim met habbaal o avad hagget o nisraf kodem sheyyitkayyem hattenay enah megoreshet. ulechattechilla lo tinnase ad sheyyitkayyem hattenay. veim nisset lo tetze ella im ken lo nishar beyadah lekayyemo. shehare batal hattenay. vesham nitbaer sheim amar lah hare at megoreshet meachshav o mehayyom al tenay kach vechach. o sheamar lah hare at megoreshet al menat kach vechach. kesheyyitkayyem hattenay tihye megoreshet mishsheat netinat hagget leyadah. lefichach eno yachol levattel hagget velo lehosif al tenao mishshehiggia get leyadah. veim avad o nisraf afillu met habbaal kodem sheyyitkayyem hattenay hare zo mekayyemet hattenay achar moto uchevar nitgarsha mishsheat netinat hagget leyadah veyesh lah lehinnase lechattechilla af al pi sheadayin lo nitkayyem hattenay. veen choshshin shemma lo yitkayyem hoil vehaya hattenay bimachshav o beal menat:

Kol hamegaresh al tenay ben sheamar meachshav ben sheamar im yihye veim lo yihye hare ze lo yityached im ishto kol zeman shello nitkayyem hattenay ella bifne ed. vaafillu eved vaafillu shifcha chutz mishshifchatah o benah katan mippene sheenah bosha milleshammesh bifnehem. vehaddavar yadua sheim nityached immah bifne shene edim keechad afillu nitkayyem hattenay achar kach hare zo sefek megoreshet. shemma bealah uvatel hagget kemo sheyyitbaer bahalachot ellu:

Ketzad megaresh adam al tenay. lo sheyyomar kitvu get leishti al tenay ze. o kitvu utenu lah al tenay. veen tzarich lomar shello yichtov betoch hagget al tenay ze geresh peloni et pelonit. ella ketzad ose. omer lassofer lichtov velaedim lachtom vechotvin get kasher belo shum tenay baolam. veachar kach noten lah hagget veomer lah hare ze gittech o hare at megoreshet baze al menat kach vechach. o yomar lahem o lashshaliach tenu lah get ze al menat kach vechach:

Katav hattenay bagget achar sheggamar lichtov toref hagget hare ze get kasher. ben shekketavo kodem chatimat haedim ben shekketavo leachar chatimat haedim. aval im ketavo kodem toref hagget afillu katav al menat kach vechach hare ze sefek gerushin shehare nishar lo zechut begufo shel get. vechen im hitna al pe kodem ketivat hattoref hare ze sefek gerushin:

Hamegaresh et ishto vehitna aleha ben bichtav achar hattoref ben al pe achar hattoref veamar lah hare at mutteret lechol adam chutz meish peloni o ella leish peloni venatan lah hagget al tenay ze im haya oto haish akku"40 o eved o asur aleha mishshum erva kegon aviha veachiha o aviv o achiv hare ze get kasher. veim haya oto haish sheyyesh lo bah kiddushin af al pi shehu mechayyave lavin veaf al pi shehu katan eno get. shehare shiyyer bagget veen ze keritut. haya baal achotah sheaf al pi shehu hayyom asur aleha mishshum erva im tamut achotah yihye muttar lah hare zo sefek megoreshet:

Amar lah hare at mutteret lechol adam chutz mimmi sheyyivvaled sheeno atta baolam. o chutz mizzenutich kelomar tihye mutteret lehinnase lechol adam aval liznot hare at beissur eshet ish. o hare at mutteret lechol mi sheyyavo alecha kederech kol haaretz aval shello kedarkech hare at beissurich. o hare at mutteret lechol adam chutz mimmekaddesh bishtar. kelomar shehi mutteret lehitkaddesh bechesef uvevia aval bishtar hare at beissur eshet ish. o hare at mutteret lechol adam chutz mehafarat nedarayich. kelomar lo nishar li alayich shum ishut chutz mehafarat nedarayich sheat ishti leinyan hafarat nedarim. o leinyan achilat teruma. o leinyan yerushsha sheim meta yirashenna. bechol echad meellu hare zo sefek megoreshet:
Amar lah hare at mutteret lechol adam chutz meruven veshimon vechazar veamar lah hare at mutteret liruven veshimon hare zo megoreshet. shehare batel hattenay shehaanashim shehitna bahen hittiran lah:

Amar lah hare at mutteret liruven hare zo enah megoreshet shehare lo bittel tenao shel shimon. amar lah hare at mutteret leshimon o hare at mutteret af leshimon hare ze sefek gerushin shemma lo hittira ella leshimon ureuven beissuro omed veze sheamar af leshimon kelomar lechol adam af leshimon. o shemma hittirah lakkol veze sheamar af leshimon vehu haddin liruven sheshshimon samuch haya liruven bitnao:
Hitna aleha veamar hayyom en at ishti ulemachar at ishti enah megoreshet veaf al pi shekkarat beno levenah hayyom. lefichach kotvin begittin min hayyom hazze uleolam:

Hare ze gittech al menat shello tishti yayin kol yeme chayyaychi eno get sheen ze keritut. kol yeme chayyay o kol yeme [chayye] peloni hare ze get shehare karat beno levenah velo tishshaer lo aleha reshut kesheyyamut oto peloni:

Hare ze gittech al menat shello telchi levet avicha ad sheloshim yom hare ze get. shello telchi levet avicha leolam eno get shehare en ze keritut. lefichach haomer hare ze gittech al menat shello tochli basar ze leolam. shello tishti yayin ze leolam eno get sheen ze keritut. ad sheloshim yom hare ze get:

Hare ze gittech al menat shello tinnasi lifloni eno get. ha lema ze dome leomer lah hare ze gittech al menat shello tishti yayin leolam o shello telchi levet avich leolam o kol yeme chayyaychi. aval im amar lah al menat shello tinnasi lifloni ad chamishshim shana hare ze get velo tinnase lo kol zeman shehitna. veim nisset batel hagget lemafrea. zanta immo havvalad kasher vehagget kasher shello hitna ella al hannissuin:

Hare ze gittech al menat shettinnasi lifloni im nisset lo hare ze get kishar kol hattenaim. aval amru chachamim lo tinnase lo leoto peloni velo leacher. leoto peloni lo tinnase shemma yomru neshehen notnin bemattana ze laze. uleacher lo tinnase sheeno get ella bekiyyum hattenay. avra venisset leoto peloni lo tetze. nisset leacher kodem shettinnase leoto peloni batel hagget vetetze vehavvalad mamzer utzericha get mishsheni:
Hare ze gittech vehanneyar shelli enah megoreshet sheen ze keritut. al menat shettitteni li et hanneyar hare ze get vetitten:
Chakak hagget al tas shel zahav unetano lah veamar lah hare ze gittech uchetubbatech kasher venitkabbela ketubbatah im yesh battas kede ketubbatah veim lav yashlim ketubbatah:

Kol hamegaresh al tenay shemmevuttal hagget kegon shehitna lah shello tochal basar velo tishte yayin kol yeme chayyeha. o shettihye mutteret lechol adam chutz mippeloni. o shehitna aleha shear tenaim kodem ketivat hattoref. im haya tenao katuv bagget vechazar umechako unetano lah hare zo safek megoreshet. veim haya hattenay al pe hare ze notel hagget mimmenna vechozer venotno lah belo tenay kelal o bitnay kasher:

Ketzad. hare shennatan get leishto veamar lah hare at megoreshet baze umutteret lechol adam chutz mippeloni. im netalo mimmenna vechazar unetano lah veamar lah hare at mutteret lechol adam o hare ze gittech hare zo megoreshet. vechen kol kayyotze bo:

Hannoten get leishto al tenay shettitten lo matayim zuz vechazar vehitna aleha tenay acher bifne edim shetteshammesh aviv shete shanim. lo bittelu devarav haacharonim et harishonim ella hare ze keomer lah asi echad mishshene hattenaim. ratzat meshammeshet ratzat notenet. veen echad min harishonim veechad min haacharonim mitztarfin. aval im hitna aleha shettitten lo matayim zuz vechazar vehitna bifne shenayim shettitten lo shelosh meot zuz. kevar bittel hattenay shel matayim utzericha litten shelosh meot zuz. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hitna aleha shettaase davar ze setam hare ze kimfaresh yom echad hoil velo peresh kamma zeman taase. ketzad. amar lah hare ze gittech al menat shettaasi immi melacha. al menat shetteshammeshi et abba. al menat shetteniki et beni. im asta immo melacha o im shimmesha et aviv yom echad o shehenika beno yom echad betoch hazzeman shehabben yonek bo vehu betoch arbaa veesrim chodesh hare ze get. met habben o met aviv kodem shettenik o shetteshammesh eno get:

Amar lah al menat shetteniki et beni o teshammeshi et avi shete shanim. hare zo mashlemet hazzeman shepperesh. met habben o haav betoch hazzeman o sheamar haav en retzoni shetteshammesheni eno get shehare lo nitkayyem hattenay. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz mikkan vead sheloshim yom. natna betoch sheloshim yom middato hare zo megoreshet. leachar sheloshim enah megoreshet. netanah lo beal karcho vehu eno rotze lekabbel hare ze get pasul ad shettitten middato. chazar veamar lah betoch hashsheloshim yom hare hen mechulin lach enah megoreshet. shehare lo naasa hattenay. met betoch sheloshim yom hoil veshalmu hashsheloshim yom velo natna enah megoreshet:

Amar lah hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz velo kava zeman umet kodem shettitten enah yechola litten leyorshav shello hitna aleha ella shettitten lo. velo batal hagget shehare lo kava zeman. lefichach af al pi sheavad hagget o nikra kodem sheyyamut hare zo lo tinnase lezar ad shettachalotz:

Hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li keli peloni o beged peloni veavad oto keli o oto beged o nignav af al pi shennatna lo elef zuz bedamav eno get ad shettitten oto keli o oto beged atzmo o ad sheyyevattel hattenay:

Mi shennitgarsha al tenay vekiddeshah acher kodem sheyyitkayyem hattenay. im nitkayyem hattenay hare zo mekuddeshet. veim lo nitkayyem hattenay uvatal hagget enah tzericha get mishsheni shehare en kiddushin tofsin bah. aval im nisset velo nitkayyem hattenay uvatal hagget tzericha get mishsheni kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 9: Hamegaresh et ishto leachar zeman kavua hare zo megoreshet kesheyyaggia hazzeman shekkava. vahare ze dome litnay veeno tenay. dome litnay shehi mitgareshet kesheyyaggia hazzeman shekkava. veeno tenay shehamegaresh al tenay hare geresh veze adayin lo geresh ad sheyyaggia oto hazzeman. lefichach hamegaresh al tenay tzarich lichpol tenao veze eno tzarich lichpol devaro velo lishar mishpete hattenain shebbearnu:

Ketzad. haomer leishto hare ze gittech velo titgarshi bo ella leachar sheloshim yom enah megoreshet ella leachar sheloshim yom. veim met habbaal o avad hagget o nisraf betoch sheloshim enah megoreshet:

Halcha vehinnichato betzidde reshut harabbim venignav o avad mishsham leachar sheloshim yom hare zo megoreshet hoil vehaya hagget kayyam bayyom shemmitgareshet bo veyichada oto bemakom sheeno reshut harabbim. shetztzidde reshut harabbim enan kirshut harabbim:

Vechen im tala haggerushin bemaase dino kedin megaresh achar zeman. ketzad. kegon sheamar leishsha hare ze gittech velo titgarshi bo ad shettitteni li matayim zuz hare zo mitgareshet achar shettitten. veen tzarich lichpol tenao velo lishar mishpete hattenain shebbearnu. shehare lo geresh al tenay ella adayin lo geresh ze ella tala haggerushin baasiyyat kach vechach veachar kach titgaresh:

Uma ben hamegaresh al tenay leze shekkava zeman legerushin o telaan bemaase. shehamegaresh al tenay yesh sham gerushin veenan gomrin ad sheyyitkayyem hattenay. lefichach kesheyyitkayyem hattenay nitgarsha im haya hagget kayyam af al pi sheeno birshutah veenah tzericha lachazor velittelo o lihyoto birshutah achar shennitkayyem hattenay shehare higgia leyadah techilla betorat gerushin. veim nisset kodem sheyyitkayyem hattenay lo tetze kemo shebbearnu. aval hattole gerushin bizman o bemaase lo higgia get leyadah betorat gerushin ella betorat pikkadon ad hazemen shekkava o ad shettaase hammaase. lefichach keshehiggia hazzeman tzericha lihyot hagget birshutah o tachazor vetittelennu o sheyyihye bammakom sheyyichada oto bo af al pi sheeno reshutah kemo shebbearnu veachar kach titgaresh bo. veim nisset kodem sheyyaggia hazzeman shekkava o kodem shettaase hammaase shettala bo haggerushin tetze vehavvalad mamzer sheadayin hi eshet ish gemura veen kan shem gerushin:
Hannoten get beyad ishto veamar lah im lo titteni li matayim zuz en ze get o en at megoreshet hare ze lo geresh kelal veen kan get lo al tenay velo taluy bemaase. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Harotze legaresh al tenay veyihye inyan tenao shello titgaresh ad zeman peloni hare ze motzi inyan ze bilshon tenay veyitle hattenay beviato bizman kavua o bahalichato. ketzad. kegon sheyyomar lah im lo bati mikkan vead sheloshim yom hare ze get veim bati betoch sheloshim yom lo yihye get venoten hagget beyadah. o yomar lah hare ze gittech al menat shello avo limdina zo ad sheloshim yom. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hitna aleha sheyyihye get im lo ba ad sheloshim yom limdina zo vehaya ba badderech betoch sheloshim yom vechala o ikkevo nahar velo ba ad achar sheloshim yom hare ze get. afillu omed vetzoveach hare ani anus sheen ones begittin. veaf al pi sheggilla dato sheen retzono legaresh:

Hitna aleha shettitgaresh kesheyyaavor minneged paneha sheloshim yom vehaya holech uva holech uva velo nityached immah kesheyyelech veyishhe sheloshim yom tihye megoreshet. veaf al pi shehaya holech uva betoch sheloshim yom hoil velo nityached immah hare ze get kasher. bamme devarim amurim beshehitna veamar hare hi neemenet alay lomar shello piyyastiha. aval im lo heeminah choshshin shemma piyyesah keshehaya holech uva umachala lo vechazar uvatal hagget kesheppiyyesah. umippene chashash ze yihye hagget pasul achar sheloshim yom. vechen haomer leishsha hare ze gittech leachar shenem asar chodesh vehaya immah bammedina choshshin shemma piyyesah ad sheyyomar neemenet alay shello piyyasti:

Vechen kol hattenain shehen teluyin birtzonah veim ratzat umachala otan levalah batel hagget choshshin lah shemma piyyes ad sheyyomar neemenet alay. bamme devarim amurim bemitgareshet min hannissuin shellibbo gas bah aval bemitgareshet min haerusin en choshshin lo shemma piyyes:

Hare ze gittech meachshav im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh en choshshin shemma basseter ba sheen derech bene adam lavo betzina. veim tam hazzeman shekkava velo ba hare zo megoreshet. met betoch 10"2 chodesh af al pi shei efshar sheyyavo vahare hi megoreshet lo tinnase bimkom yavam ad achar shenem asar chodesh kesheyyitkayyem hattenay:

Bari shehitna sheyyihye ze get im matti. o chole shehitna sheyyihye ze get im matti mecholi ze lo amar kelum. shemmashmaut im matti leachar mita umashmao meatta. lefichach im amar im matti hare ze keomer leachar moti veen get leachar mita:
Amar lah hare ze gittech meachshav im matti o mehayyom im matti hare ze get uchesheyyamut tihye megoreshet:

Amar lah hare ze gittech meachshav o mehayyom leachar mitati umet hare zo safek megoreshet shemma achar sheamar meachshav chazar bo milleshon meachshav vesamcha dato al leachar mita veen get leachar mita:

Hare ze gittech lichshettetze chamma minnartekah umet ballayla eno get. al menat shettizrach chamma umet ballayla hare zo megoreshet ucheshettizrach chamma yitkayyem hattenay. hitna aleha sheim zarcha chamma yihye get veim lo zarcha lo yihye get umet ballayla eno get shehare lo nitkayyem hattenay ad shemmet veen get leachar mita:

Shechiv mera shekkatav get leishto vegeresh veamad eno yachol lachazor bo sheen gitto kemattenato. sheim tomar yachazor bo yomru gitto leachar mita yegaresh kemo mattenato sheenah kona ella leachar mita:
Hare ze gittech mehayyom im matti mecholi ze venafal alav bayit o neshacho nachash o terafo ari vechayyotze baze umet eno get:

Amar lah im lo yaamod mecholi ze venafal alav bayit o neshacho nachash o terafo ari hare zo safek megoreshet. hare ze gittech meachshav im matti mecholi ze veamad vehalach bashshuk vechala umet omdin oto im mechamat hacholi harishon met hare ze get veim lav eno get. veim nittak mecholi lecholi velo amad bashshuk hare ze get veeno tzarich omed:
Uvechol ellu hattenain kol hayyamim shemminnetinat hagget ad sheyyamut veyitkayyem hattenay hare hi megoreshet lechol davar. uvilvad shello tityached immo kemo shebbearnu:

Chole sheratza legaresh ishto al tenay kesheyyamut kede shello tippol lifne yavam veim amad lo tihye megoreshet velo ratza legarshah meachshav kede shello tittaref dato. kach hu kotev bagget achar shekkotev hattoref o omer lah keshennoten hagget. im lo matti lo yihye get veim matti yihye get veim lo matti lo yihye get. kede shettihye tenay kaful vehen kodem lelav velo yiftach piv techilla lefuranut. veim met tihye megoreshet kesheyyamut. vehu sheyyaggia hagget leyadah kodem mita:

Baal sheamar leechad zeche beget ze leishti kede shello tippol lifne yavam venatan hagget leyado umet habbaal kodem sheyyaggia hagget leyadah hare zo safek megoreshet. sherov hannashim zechut hu lahen shello yippelu lifne yavam. ulefichach tihye sefek megoreshet af al pi shello higgia get leyadah hoil vezacha lah bo acher:

Amar laedim leachar shenem asar chodesh kitvu get leishti o sheamar lahem kitvu utenu get leishti leachar 10"2 chodesh. hare ellu kotvin venotnin lah achar hazzeman shekkava. veim ketavuhu betoch hazzeman af al pi shennetanuhu lah leachar zeman sheamar eno get. ketavuhu achar zeman sheamar umet kodem sheyyinnaten lah eno get. veim lo noda im mita kadma lintinat hagget o netinat hagget kadma lemita hare zo safek megoreshet:

Amar lahen kitvu utenu leishti get achar hashshavua. en kotvin ella ad shana achar hashshavua. amar lahen leachar shana en kotvin [ella] ad leachar chodesh mishshana sheniyya. amar lahen leachar hachodesh (en) kotvin ad leachar hashshabbat mechodesh sheni. amar leachar shabbat (en) kotvin leachar hashshabbat ad sof yom shelishi. amar lahen kitvu utenu lah kodem hashshabbat kotvin miyyom revii vead sof yom shishshi venotnin lah:
Hare sheecharu achar hazzeman sheamar veachar kach katvu venatnu lah kegon sheamar lahen leachar hachodesh vechatvu venatnu lah leachar shete shabbatot mechodesh sheni hare ze pasul:

Nityached immah achar sheamar lahen lichtov velachtom velitten lah hare ellu lo yichtevu. vekal vachomer haddevarim im hagget shennatan lah leyadah keshennityached immah nifsal hagget shemma baal. kal vachomer laze shello nichtav. veim ketavo unetano lah achar shennityached immah eno get:

Amar laasara kitvu get leishti echad kotev al yede kullam. kullechem kitvu kotev echad mehem bemaamad kullam. holichu get ze leishti molicho echad mehen al yede kullam. kullechem holichu get ze leishti molicho echad mehen bemaamad kullam:

Amar laasara kitvu get vechitmu utenu leishti echad mehen kotev ushenayim mehen chotmin veechad mehen notno lah. vaafillu haya hakkotev echad mishshene haedim shechatmu bo vehu hashshaliach shennetano lah hare ze kasher. amar lahen kullechem chatomu kullam chotmin. veim menaan ben shemmana kullam ben shemmana miktzatan veamar lahen chatomu hare ze keomer lahen kullechem chatomu ushenayim shechotmin battechilla hen mishshum edim vehashshear mishshum tenay. lefichach im hayu hashshear pesulin o chatmu ze hayyom veze lemachar afillu leyamim harebe hare ze get kasher. met echad mehen kodem chatima hare ze get batel. haya echad mishshenayim harishonim pasul hare ze get pasul. shemma yomru ed pasul kasher beedut shear shetarot beet sheyyihyu haedim rabbim velo hichshiruhu beget sheedav rabbim ella mippene sheede mesira hen haikkar:

Tikkenu chachamim shehaomer lerabbim lichtov get o lachtom o leholich get leishto. im lichtiva omer lahen kol echad mikkem yichtov get leishti vechen leholacha kol echad mikkem yolich. veim lachatima yomar lahen kol shenayim mikkem yachtemu beget ze veyittenu leishti:

Velamma amru chachamim ede hagget en chotmin ella ze bifne ze gezera shemma yomar lerabbim kullechem chatomu. im tomar chotmin ze shello bifne ze shemma yaidu shenayim vetittol hagget beyadah vetachshov shekkevar heidu bo vaadayin lo nitkayyem hattenay:

Amar lishlosha shenayim mikkem yichtevu get leishti veyachtemu veyittenu lah vehaya bahen av uveno ben shechatam habben im haechad ben shechatam haav im haechad hare ze get kasher. shehaadam ose habben shaliach bimkom haav:

Amar lishnayim kitvu vechitmu utenu lifloni sheyyolich leishti. o tenu leshaliach sheyyolich lah. echad mehen kotev ushenehem chotmin venotnin lashshaliach. veim holichu hen beatzman venatnu lah eno get shello asa otan sheluchin legerushin. ketzad yaasu. yittelu oto mimmenna veyittenuhu lashshaliach vechozer venotno lah bifnehen o bifne acherim. verabbotay horu beget ze davar sheeno nire mippene shibbush shehaya bannuschaot shellahen:

Amar lesofer ketov li get leishti. ketavo unetano labbaal belo edim unetalo habbaal unetano leshaliach veamar lo ten get ze leishti bifne edim vehalach hashshaliach unetano lah bifne edim hare zo sefek megoreshet. sheen hashshaliach neeman lehattir haerva af al pi shehu ed echad ella mippene ketav haedim shechatmu al hagget shehen kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din ad sheyyihye sham mearer kemo shebbearnu sham. veim hayu sham shene edim sheyyaidu shegget ze habbaal netano lashshaliach legarshah bo hare zo megoreshet:

Haomer leshaliach ten get ze leishti bemakom peloni unetano lah bemakom acher eno get. hare hi bemakom peloni unetano lah bemakom acher kasher mippene shemmare makom hu lo. amar al tittenehu lah ella babbayit unetano lah baaliyya. al tittenehu lah ella beyamin unetano lah bismol. tenehu lah beyom peloni unetano lah betoch hazzeman eno get. al tittenehu lah ella beyom peloni unetano lah millefanav o meacharav eno get shehare hikpid al atzmo shel yom. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Vechen haishsha sheamra lishluchah hitkabbel li gitti bemakom peloni vekibbelo lah bemakom acher eno get. have li gitti bemakom peloni vehevio lah bemakom acher kasher:

Haomer lishlucho holech get ze leishti ben sheamar lo holech ben sheamar lo at holech vechala o neenas meshallecho beyad acher. veim amar lo tol mimmenna chefetz peloni veten lah get ze hare ze lo yeshallechennu beyad acher. veim shillecho beyad acher veyatzat haishsha likrat hashshaliach venatna hachefetz techilla veachar kach natan lah hagget hare zo megoreshet:

Natan lah hagget techilla veachar kach natna hachefetz afillu miyyad shaliach rishon eno get shehare avar al divre habbaal bedavar shessetam bene adam makpidin alav. shehare habbaal amar lo tol hachefetz techilla veten lah hagget vehu natan veachar kach natal:

Amar lo ten lah hagget vetol mimmenna chefetz peloni hare ze lo yeshallechennu beyad acher sheen retzono sheyyihye pikdono beyad acher. veim shillecho beyad acher hare ze get ben shennatna hachefetz techilla ben shello natna ella bassof:

Natan leshaliach hagget veamar lo lo tittenehu lah ella atta unetano leacher unetano lah eno get. vechen im amar lo al tittenehu lah atta tenehu lifloni vehu yittenehu lah unetano lah hashshaliach harishon eno get. lefi shello asahu shaliach legerushin:

Natan lo hagget veamar lo holech get ze leishti. amar lo hashshaliach eni makkirah. amar lo habbaal tenehu lifloni hu makkirah. hare ze shaliach shello nittan legerushin veeno noten hagget ella lifloni sheamar habbaal veoto happeloni hu shaliach legerushin hu shemmolicho lah o meshallecho beyad acher im chala o neenas:

Natan hagget leshaliach veamar lo lo tittenehu lah ad sheloshim yom vechala o neenas betoch hashsheloshim meshallecho beyad acher. sheaf al pi sheeno achshav shaliach legerushin hoil uleachar sheloshim yom yihye sheliach gerushin ose shaliach acher betoch sheloshim yom:

Bamme devarim amurim beshello haya balah immah bammedina o shehayta mitgareshet min haerusin. aval im mitgareshet min hannissuin uvalah immah bammedina choshshin lo shemma piyyes. veeno ose shaliach betoch hashsheloshim ella im ken amar neemenet alay shello piyyasti. aval noten lah hagget leachar sheloshim vechoshshin lah kemo shebbearnu ad sheyyomar neemenet alay shello piyyasti:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 10: Kol makom sheamarnu bechibbur ze shehagget batel o eno get o enah megoreshet hare ze get batel min hattora vaadayin hi eshet ish gemura. veim nisset tetze vehavvalad mamzer. veim haya balah kohen lo neesra alav mishshum gerusha. chutz min hamegaresh et ishto veamar lah hare at megoreshet mimmenni veen at mutteret lakkol sheaf al pi sheen ze get hare zo pesula lichhunna middivrehen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 7)</small> "veishsha gerusha meishah" amru chachamim afillu lo nitgarsha ella meishah velo huttera lakkol neesra lichhunna vezehu reach hagget shepposel bichhunna middivrehem:

Vechol makom sheamarnu bechibbur ze shehagget pasul hare ze pasul middivre sofrim bilvad venifsela bo min hakkehunna middivre tora. velo tinnase lechattechilla veim nisset lo tetze vehavvalad kasher. vechotvin lah get acher kasher venotnin lah vehi tachat balah. veim i efshar lichtov acher vehaya habbaal vatik vegeresh meatzmo hare ze meshubbach im en lah banim. aval im yesh lah banim lo yotzi mippene pesul hagget shemma yotzi laaz al banav:

Vechol makom sheamarnu bechibbur zo hare ze sefek gerushin o shehi safek megoreshet lo tinnase veim nisset tetze vehavvalad sefek mamzer mippene shehi sefek erva. vechen im geresh et ishto beget pasul o shehayta safek megoreshet veratza lehachazirah hare zo mutteret levalah. veeno tzarich lechaddesh hannissuin ulevarech sheva berachot velichtov ketubba ad shettitgaresh gerushin gemurin:

Kol mi shennisset beget batel hare zo tzericha get mibbaal sheni middivrehen kede shello yomru eshet ish yotza belo get. utzericha get min harishon lehattirah lishar haam. veneesra al shenehem leolam af al pi shennivala bishgaga. kede shello yomru hechezir ze gerushato achar shennisset. veim avar echad mishshenehen vehechezirah yotzi:

Vechen haddin beishsha shebbau edim shemmet balah venisset veachar kach ba balah ben shehaya balah pikkeach ben shehaya cheresh ben shennisset lefikkeach ben shennisset lecheresh sheen kiddushav kiddushin gemurim tetze mishshenehem utzericha get mizze umizze veneesra al shenehem olamit:

Hare shennitkaddesha veachar kach ba balah o nimtza hagget batel hare zo mutteret levalah veenah tzericha get mishsheni sheen kiddushin tofsin baarayot. veen choshshin shemma yomru eshet ish yotza belo get kevan shello nisset yomru tenay haya bakkiddushin velo nitkayyem:

Haishsha shennisset venimtza hagget batel. o ba balah achar sheshshama shemmet. en habbaal harishon vehashsheni zakkain lo bimtziatah velo bemaase yadeha velo bahafarat nedareha. vechol perot sheachlu shenehen achar shennisset en motziin mehen. veen lah ketubba velo tenay mittenae ketubba velo mezonot lo al ze velo al ze. veim natla mizze o mizze tachazir. vechol ma shebbala o avad minnechaseha vaafillu minnichse tzon barzel en motziin otan lo mizze velo mizze. vehavvalad min hashsheni mamzer. veim ba aleha harishon kodem sheggeresh hashsheni hare havvalad mamzer middivrehem. gershah hashsheni venatla mimmennu ketubba veachar kach ba balah o nimtza hagget batel en motziin miyyadah ma shennatla lo min hammezonot velo min hakketubba:

Vechen haddin beachin shekkiddesh echad ishsha vehalach achiv veshama bo shemmet veyibbem et ishto veachar kach ba tetze mizze umizze utzericha get mizze umizze vechol haddevarim haellu bah. vechen im kiddesh ishsha vehalcha limdina acheret veshama shemmeta venasa achotah veachar kach noda shello meta tzerichot shetehen mimmennu get vechol hadderachim haellu bahen:

Aval im halcha ishto hannesua limdina acheret veshama bah shemmeta venasa achotah venimtzet ishto kayyemet en achotah tzericha mimmennu get veishto mutteret. vechen shear haarayot shennesaan bechezkat hetter venimtzeu erva enan tzerichot get sheen kiddushin tofsin baarayot:

Umippene ma hitzrichu achot arusato get. shemma yomru tenay haya baerusin vechaddat nasa achotah. vehoil veyatza achotah beget, achotah shehi arusato harishona asura, kede shello yomru nasa achot gerushato:

Katav hassofer vetaa venatan get laish veshover laishsha. o shettau hen venatal habbaal hagget venatla hi hashshover vechimdumme lahen shennitgarsha uleachar zeman hare hagget yotze mittachat yede haish. im lo nisset hare zo enah megoreshet venitgalla haddavar sheadayin lo nitgarsha veyitten lah hagget befanenu vetihye megoreshet mishsheat netinato. veim nisset veachar kach hotzi habbaal et hagget veamar adayin lo nitgarsha shehare hagget beyadi velo higgia leyadah en shomin lo leasrah al balah. ella hare zo bechezkat gerusha venafal hagget miyyadah umetzao ze vahare ba leasrah al habbaal hashsheni:

Hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra o mishshum shehi perutza bindarim omrin lo hodiah shemmippene ze atta motziah kede leyasserah veda sheen atta machazirah leolam. umippene ma hammotzi et zo lo yachazirah leolam. gezera shemma tinnase leacher vetaase teshuva vetihye tzenua tachtav veyomar harishon illu hayiti yodea shekken hu lo hayiti megarshah venimtza kimgaresh al tenay velo nitkayyem shennimtza hagget batel lemafrea. lefichach omrim lo gemor belibbecha legarshah sheen zo chozeret lecha leolam. veim avar vehechezir kodem shennitkaddesha leacher lo yotzi:

Vechen hammotzi et ishto mishshum aylonit o mishshum sheroa dam bechol et tashmish hare ze lo yachazir leolam. shemma tinnase leacher veteled haaylonit vetitrappe hannidda veyomar illu hayiti yodea shekken hu lo hayiti megarshah venimtza hagget batel vehabbanim mamzerim. veim avar vehechezir lo yotzi:

Shaliach shehevi get chutza laaretz veamar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam hare ze lo yissaenna. sheanu choshshin shemma enav natan bah ulefichach heid lah. vechen haed haechad sheheid leishsha shemmet balah venisset al piv hare ze lo yissaenna. vechen hechacham sheasar et haishsha al balah beneder hare ze lo yissaenna. vechen hannitan al hashshifcha venishtachrera al hannachrit venitgayyera hare ze lo yissaenna. vechen akku"40 veeved habba al bat yisrael af al pi shechazar haakku"40 venitgayyer haeved venishtachrer hare ze lo yissaenna. vechullan im avru venasu en motziin miyyadam:

Vechullan shehayu lahem nashim umetu neshotehen o shennitgarshu vehayu hannashim hen shehirgilu et baalehen legarsham hare ellu muttarot lehinnase lahen lechattechilla. vechen im halchu nashim ellu venisseu laacherim venitalmenu o nitgarshu hare ellu muttarot lehinnase lahen lechattechilla:

Vechol achat mehen mutteret lehinnase leven haed sheheid lah. o leven hechacham sheasarah al balah. o leven hannitan aleha o lishar kerovin. sheen adam chote kede sheyyehane acher. umutteret haishsha lehinnase leechad meede gerusheha o meede meuneha. o leechad min haddayyanim shechaltza bifnehem. sheen choshshin ella leedut echad. uleolam yitrachek adam meedut meun veyitkarev lachalitza:

Hamegaresh et ishto vechazar uvealah bifne edim kodem shettinnase leacher ben sheggershah min hannissuin ben min haerusin hoil veishto hayta hare zo bechezkat shehechezirah uleshem kiddushin baal velo leshem zenut. vaafillu rau oto shennatan lah maot. shechazaka hi sheen adam ose beilato beishto beilat zenut vahare beyado laasotah beilat mitzva. lefichach hare zo bechezkat mekuddeshet kiddushe vadday utzericha mimmennu get sheni:

Nityached immah bifne edim vehu sheyyihyu shene haedim keechad. im hayta megoreshet min hannissuin choshshin lah shemma nivala vehen hen ede yichud hen hen ede bia. shekkol hamekaddesh bevia eno tzarich livol bifne edim ella yityached bifnehen veyivol kemo shebbearnu. lefichach tzericha get missafek vahare hi safek mekuddeshet. veim hayta megoreshet min haerusin en choshshin lah shehare en libbo gas bah:

Horu miktzat haggeonim shekkol ishsha shettibbael bifne edim tzericha get. chazaka sheen adam ose beilato beilat zenut. vehigdilu vehosifu bedavar ze sheala al datam ad shehoru shemmi sheyyesh lo ben mishshifchato choshshin lo velo tityabbem ishto shemma shichrer shifchato veachar kach ba aleha. veyesh mi shehora shevvadday shichrerah sheen adam ose beilato beilat zenut. vechol haddevarim haelle rechokim hem beenay ad meod middarche hahoraa veen rauy lismoch alehen. shello amru chachamim chazaka zo ella beishto sheggershah bilvad o bimkaddesh al tenay uvaal setam shehare ishto hi uveishto hi shechezkato sheeno ose beilat zenut ad sheyyefaresh shehi beilat zenut o yefaresh sheal tenay hu boel. aval bishar hannashim hare kol zona bechezkat shebbaal leshem zenut ad sheyyefaresh ki hu leshem kiddushin. veen tzarich lomar beshifcha o kutit sheenah bat kiddushin sheen choshshin lahen kelal. vahare habben mehen bechezkat kuti veeved ad sheyyivvada bevadday shennishtachrera immo o nitgayyera:

Mi shehuchzeka eshet ish ben min hannissuin ben min haerusin veyatza shemah bair megoreshet. afillu rov hair o kullah maavirin hakkol shennitgarsha en choshshin lah vahare hi bechezkatah. aval im yatza shemah bair mekuddeshet vehuchzak hakkol bevet din shehare hi mekuddeshet besafek kemo shebbearnu veachar kach yatza aleha kol shennitgarsha meotan hakkiddushin hakkol asarah vehakkol hittirah vahare zo megoreshet:

Lo yissa adam ishsha vedato legarshah. velo tihye yoshevet tachtav umeshammashto vedato legarshah. velo yegaresh adam ishto rishona ella im ken matza bah ervat davar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "ki matza vah ervat davar" vegomer. veen rauy lo lemaher leshalleach ishto rishona. aval sheniyya im seneah yeshallechenna:

Ishsha raa bedeoteha vesheenah tzenua kivnot yisrael hakkesherot mitzva legarshah shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 22 10)</small> "garesh letz veyetze madon". veishsha shennitgarsha mishshum peritzut en rauy leadam kasher sheyyissaenna. shello yomru ze hotzi reshaa mibbeto veze machnisah:

Mi shennitcharsha ishto hare ze megarshah beget vetihye megoreshet. aval im nishtattet eno motziah ad shettavri. vedavar ze takkanat chachamim hu kede shello tehe hefker lifrutzin shehare enah yechola lishmor atzmah. lefichach mannichah venose acheret umaachilah umashkah mishshellah. veen mechayyevin oto bisher kesut veona sheen koach beven daat ladur im hashshotim bevayit echad. veeno chayyav lerappeotah velo lifdotah. veim gershah hare zo megoreshet umotziah mibbeto veeno chayyav lachazor ulehittafel bah:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 11: En nosin et hakketonna. vehannose ketanna yetoma velo ratzta babbaal hare zo memaenet veholechet veenah tzericha mimmennu get. sheen kiddushin shel ketanna kiddushin gemurin kemo shebbearnu. vechen ketanna shehissiah aviha venitalmena o nitgarsha keshehi ketanna hare hi kitoma bechayye aviha. veim nisset keshehi ketanna hare zo memaenet:
Hachereshet af al pi shennissueha middivre sofrim kenissue ketanna lo tikkenu lah shettemaen kede shello yimmanu millenasah:

Memaenet hi hakketanna ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin. ben bifne balah ben shello befanav. ucheshem shemmemaenet bevaal kach memaenet beyavam. umemaenet bevaal ze umemaenet besheni im nisset leacher vechen bishlishi afillu kamma peamim kol zeman shehi ketanna yesh lah lemaen. uketanna shello meana af al pi shehi nesua vehalcha venitkaddesha leacher keshehi ketanna kiddusheha hem hem meuneha:

Ad matay habbat memaenet. kol zeman shehi ketanna ad shettihye naara o ad sheyyivvada shehi aylonit. bamme devarim amurim beshello ba aleha habbaal achar shennaaset bat 10"2 shana veyom echad. aval im higgia lazzeman hazze venivala hoil vehabbeila kona min hattora kemo shebbearnu hare zo enah memaenet. veenah tzericha bedika lemeun shechezkatah shehevia simanin:

Hare shennivdeka velo nimtzeu lah simanim hoil venivala achar shehiggia lazzeman harauy lesimanin hare zo choshshin lah shemma hevia venashru. ulefichach tzericha get missafek. veim meana achar shennivdeka venitkaddesha leacher tzericha mimmennu get missafek. veim nisset tetze mizze umizze vehavvalad sefek mamzer mishshenehem:

Ketanna shello meana vehigdila veaf al pi shello bealah balah mishshennaaset bat shetem esre shana veyom echad hare zo enah memaenet shehare higdila. utzericha get middivre sofrim shehare lo ba aleha achar shehiggia lishne naarut ad shennachush lah shemma hevia simanin vetihye safek mekuddeshet, velo ba aleha achar shehigdila kede shettihye eshet ish gemura. venimtzet sheenah tzericha get ella minnissue katnut shehen middivre sofrim. lefichach im amda venitkaddesha achar sheggadla tofsin bah kiddushin shel sheni. veim geresh harishon yichnos hashsheni. aval im geresh sheni lo yekayyem rishon shemma yomru hechezir gerushato meachar shennitarsa. veim ba aleha sheni kodem sheyyegaresh rishon tetze mizze umizze mippene sheddome leishsha sheshshama shemmet balah venisset veachar kach ba balah. veen havvalad min hashsheni mamzer. veim ba aleha rishon kodem sheggeresh sheni havvalad mamzer:

E zo hi ketanna shetztzericha lemaen. mibbat shesh ad bat eser shanim bodkin otah lefi yefi datah im yodaat lishmor kiddusheha veshehen kiddushin lo shettishmor otan kederech shemmeshammeret haegoz utemara vechayyotze bahen hare zo tzericha meun. veim enah yodaat lishmor kiddusheha enah tzericha lemaen ella holechet levet immah keillu lo nitkaddesha meolam. ufechuta mibbat shesh afillu yodaat lishmor enah tzericha meun. vitera al bat eser afillu sechala beyoter tzericha meun. vechol mi shehissiuha acheha o immah o keroveha shello ledatah enah tzericha lemaen:

Ketzad memaenet. omeret bifne shene edim en retzoni bifloni bali. o en retzoni bakkiddushin shekkiddeshuni immi o achay. vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. afillu hayu orchin mesubbin bevet balah vehi omedet umashka alehen veamra eni rotza bifloni bali hare ze meun:

Hashshenayim shemmemaenet hakketanna bifnehen kotvin lah beyom peloni meana pelonit bat peloni befanenu bifloni balah vechotmin venotnin lah. veze hu gufo shel get meun. veget meun eno keget haggerushin shennetinato megarshah. veeno tzarich ketiva lishmah velo mesira velo davar mimmishpete get haggerushin. veen kotvin bo tafse hagget shemma yerae keget gerushin lefi sheeno ella kemaase bet din:

Hashshenayim shemmemaenet bifnehen tzerichin sheyyehu makkirin otah veet balah shemmeana bo. lefichach kol mi sheraa otah shemmeana veshama meuneha yesh lo lichtov get meun lah af al pi sheen makkirah. uchevar nahagu yisrael lichtov get meun benosach ze:

Get meun:
bechach beshabbat kach vechach yom lechodesh peloni shenat kach vechach leminyan peloni meana pelonit bat peloni befanenu veamra sheimmi o achay hituni vehissiuni o kiddeshuni vaani ketanna lifloni bar peloni vehasheta gilliti dati kodomechon dela tzavina beh velo kaemna immeh. uvedakna pelonit da veitbarer lana daadayin ketanna hi uchetavna vachatamna veyahivna lah lizchut veliraya berura: peloni bar peloni ed: peloni bar peloni ed:

Hamegaresh et ishto venitkaddesha leacher af al pi shello bealah neesra al harishon. veim hechezir harishon uvealah loke vechofin oto lehotzi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 4)</small> "lo yuchal balah harishon" vegomer:

Zinneta im acher keshehi gerusha mutteret lachazor levalah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 2)</small> "veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayta leish acher". havayatah leish acher shehi hakkiddushin hi sheoseret otah al balah lachazor lo:

Uvichlal lav ze shekkol ishsha shezzinneta tachat balah neesra alav veloke aleha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 4)</small> "achare asher huttammaa" vahare nitmea. ella im ken hayta eshet yisrael shenneensa. lefichach kol ishsha shenneesra al balah al yede kinnuy usetira im baal otah makkin oto makkat mardut. veim avar vehechezirah achar sheggershah yotzi beget:

Cheresh sheggeresh birmiza kemo shebbearnu vehalcha venitkaddesha lecheresh acher veen tzarich lomar lefikkeach asura lachazor levalah hacheresh. aval ishto shel pikkeach shennitgarsha vehalcha venisset lecheresh venitgarsha mutteret lachazor levalah happikkeach:

Hamemaenet beish enah megoreshet mimmennu. vedinah im balah shemmeana bo kedinah im mi shello kiddeshah meolam. hi mutteret bikrovav vehu muttar bikrovoteha velo pesalah min hakkehunna. veim nisset leacher vegershah haacher o met o meana bo mutteret lachazor larishon. velo od ella afillu gershah harishon vehechezirah umeana bo venisset leacher achar shemmeana bo vegershah haacher mutteret lachazor larishon. shekkol hayyotzet bemeun af al pi shekkedamo get hare zo kemi shello nitgarsha mimmennu beget meolam umutteret lachazor lo. aval hamegaresh et hakketanna beget venisset leacher umeana bo asura lachazor larishon mippene sheyyatzat mimmennu beget af al pi sheyyatzat min haacharon bemeun. veen tzarich lomar im gershah haacharon o met. vechen asura laavi harishon velivno uleachiv kishar haggerushot af al pi sheyyatzat min haacharon bemeun:
Hamemaenet beyavam asura leaviv mippene shenniret kechallato beet shemmet beno. aval lishar kerovim mutteret. lefichach im meana beechad min hayyavamin mutteret leechav:

Kol ishsha shennitgarsha o shennitalmena hare zo lo tinnase velo titares ad shettamtin tishim yom chutz miyyom shennitgarsha o shemmet balah bo vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo. kede sheyyivvada im hi meubberet o enah meubberet lehavechin ben zaro shel rishon lezaro shel sheni:
Umiyyom ketivat hagget monin limgoreshet. vaafillu haya al tenay o shello higgia leyadah ella leachar kamma shanim miyyom hakketiva monin. shehare eno mityached immah mishshekketavo lah:

Ugezerat chachamim hi sheafillu ishsha sheenah reuya leled vaafillu nitgarsha o nitalmena min haerusin tzericha lehametin tishim yom. afillu ketanna o zekena o akara o aylonit. vaafillu balah bimdinat hayyam o chole o chavush bevet haassurin vaafillu betula min haerusin tzerichot lehametin tishim yom:

Shifcha shennishtachrera vegiyyoret shennitgayyera mamtinin tishim yom. vaafillu ger veishto shennitgayyeru mafrishin otan tishim yom kede lehavechin ben zera shennizra bikdushsha lezera shello nizra bikdushsha. vechen yefat toar af al pi shennatna lah tora sheloshim yom letakkanat atzmah tzericha lehametin tishim yom letakkanat havvalad. vehashsheloshim mikkelal hattishim:
Hamemaenet enah tzericha lehametin. lo gazru ella bigrusha. vechen hamezanna enah tzericha lehametin mippene shemmeshammeret atzmah shello titabber. vechen anusa umefutta enan tzerichot lehametin:

Mi shennisset betaut venoda shehi asura levalah vehotziuha bet din mittachtav. im hayta ketanna sheenah reuya leled enah tzericha lehametin. shezze davar sheeno matzuy hu vechol davar sheeno matzuy berov lo gazru bo:
Hameares betoch tishim yom menaddin oto. eres uvarach en menaddin oto. kanas betoch tishim yom mafrishin otan ad achar zeman veyaamod im ishto:

Vechen gazru chachamim shello yissa adam meubberet chavero umeneket chavero. veaf al pi shehazzera yadua lemi hi meubberet. shemma yazzik havvalad bishat tashmish sheeno makpid al ben chavero. umenika shemma yitakker hechalav vehu eno makpid lerappeot hechalav bidvarim hammoilin lechalav kesheyyitakker:
Kamma hu zeman hayenika. 20"4 chodesh chutz miyyom shennolad bo umiyyom shennitarsa bo:
Keshem sheasur lissa kach asur leares ad achar zeman ze. afillu natna benah lemenika o sheggemalattu betoch 20"4 chodesh lo tinnase. met benah mutteret linnase. veen choshshin shemma tahargennu:

Avar venasa meubberet o menika betoch zeman ze yotzi beget vaafillu haya kohen. veim haya yisrael yachazirenah achar 20"4 chodesh shel menika. nasa uvarach uleachar zeman ba veyashav im ishto en bechach kelum. eres meubberet o menika en kofin oto lehotzi velo lichnos ad achar zeman hayenika o ad sheyyamut havvalad:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 12: Haishsha shebbaa veamra eshet ish hayiti ugerusha ani neemenet. shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. huchzeka eshet ish uvaa veamra gershani bali enah neemenet lehattir atzmah lashshuk. aval pasla atzmah lichhunna leolam. veim met balah choshshin lidvareha vecholetzet velo mityabbemet:

Hayu lah shene edim shehi gerusha af al pi sheen sham get hare zo tinnase lechattechilla. hotzia get mittachat yadah veamra gershani bali baze hare zo neemenet vetinnase bo af al pi sheeno mekuyyam kemo shebbearnu:

Ba habbaal veirer im amar lo netattiv lah ella nafal mimmenni umatza oto eno neeman. shehare hoda shekketavo lah vahare hu yotze mittachat yadah. aval im amar habbaal al tenay haya. pikkadon haya. meolam lo ketavtiv. mezuyyaf hu. yitkayyem bechotmav o beede mesira kemo shebbearnu. veim lo nitkayyem enah megoreshet lihyot mutteret laacherim aval pasla nafshah mikkehunna kemo shebbearnu. shehare pasla atzmah behodaat piha veasta atzmah kachaticha shel issur:
Baa hi uvalah. hi omeret gerashtani veavad gitti. vehu omer lo gerashtich. af al pi shehuchzeka ishto hare zo neemenet. chazaka en ishsha meizza paneha bifne balah:

Amar habbaal gerashti et ishti eno neeman vechoshshim lidvarav vetihye safek megoreshet. vaafillu hodet lo sheggershah eno neeman shemma yitkavven lekalkelah o beget batel gershah vehi enah yodaat [o shemma taez paneha bo mippene shehu maaminah vehi enah yodaat] koved haissur shellah. lefichach omrim lo im emet haddavar hare attem kayyamim garesh otah atta befanenu:

Shenayim omrim nitgarsha ushenayim omrim lo nitgarsha afillu habbaal omed vehi omeret lo gerashtani hare zo bechezkat eshet ish gemura mippene shehaedim somchin otah veefshar shettaez paneha. lefichach im nisset tetze vehavvalad mamzer:

Bamme devarim amurim kesheamru achshav nitgarsha shehare omrin lah im emet haddavar hotzii gittech. aval im amru haedim mikkamma yamim nitgarsha yesh lomar avad hagget vehoil vehi omeret gerusha ani bevadday ushene edim meidin lah af al pi shehashshenayim machchishin otan im nisset leechad meedeha lo tetze shehare hi uvalah yodin bevadday shehi mutteret vachazaka hi sheen mekalkelin atzman. aval im nisset leacher hoil vehaddavar etzlo safek. vechen im amra eni yodaat afillu nisset leechad meedeha hare zo tetze vehavvalad sefek mamzer:

Amru shenayim reinuha shennitgarsha ushenayim omrim lo reinuha. im hayu kullam sheruyim bechatzer achat hare zo lo tinnase. veim nisset lo tetze vehavvalad kasher. shebbene adam asuyin legaresh betzina:

Haishsha shello huchzeka eshet ish uva ed echad veamar eshet ish hayta venitgarsha. uva ed echad veamar lo nitgarsha. hare shenehen meidin shehi eshet ish veechad meid shehi gerusha veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim ulefichach lo tinnase veim nisset tetze:

Ishsha ushene anashim shebbau mimmedina acheret. ze omer zo ishti veze avdi. veze omer zo ishti veze avdi. vehaishsha omeret shenehen avaday. hare hi mutteret lakkol veaf al pi sheshshenehen hechezikuha beeshet ish hoil vechol echad mehen heid leatzmo enan neemanin:

Sheliach kabbala shehotzi get mittachat yado vehabbaal omer mezuyyaf hu yitkayyem bechotmav o beede mesira kemo shebbearnu. amar habbaal lefikkadon netattiv lo vehashshaliach omer legerushin netano li hashshaliach neeman. vechen im haya hagget yotze mittachat yede haishsha vehi omeret shaliach ze netano li, vehashshaliach omer ken netattiv lah ulegerushin netano li, vehabbaal omer lo netattiv lo ella lefikkadon, hashshaliach neeman vehi megoreshet:

Avad hagget af al pi shehabbaal omer legerushin netattiv lashshaliach vehashshaliach omer netattiv lah hare zo sefek megoreshet shehare huchzeka eshet ish veen kan ella ed echad uvaal. vaafillu amra haishsha befanay netano lo legerushin unetano hashshaliach li hoil vehabbaal vehashshaliach soadin otah efshar shettaez paneha veshemma lo nitgarsha:

Sheliach kabbala shekkibbel get leishsha ushelacho lah bifne shene edim vehiggia hagget leyadah unetalattu vahare hagget yotze mittachat yadah. vehi enah yodaat im balah shelacho lah o sheliach kabbala shellah o shelucho shel balah. hare zo megoreshet kemo shebbearnu:

Ba baal veirer shello ketavo o shehu get batel yitkayyem bechotmav shehare edim meidim shehagget shennatnu lah yatza mittachat yad sheluchah sheyyado keyadah. veaf al pi shehi enah yodaat hare haedim yadu. veim lo nitkayyem enah megoreshet:

Mi shehuchzeka eshet ish vehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam veshalom beno levenah veshalom baolam uvaa veamra met bali neemenet vetinnase o tityabbem. chazaka sheenah mekalkelet atzmah veteesor atzmah al balah harishon veal ze vetafsid ketubbatah mizze umizze velihyot baneha mamzerin bedavar heasuy lehiggalot lakkol. vei efshar lehachechish velo liton taana sheim hu chay sofo lavo o yivvada shehu chay. vechen im ba ed echad veheid lah shemmet balah tinnase al piv shehaddavar asuy lehiggalot. afillu eved o ishsha o shifcha veed mippi ed mippi eved mippi shifcha mippi kerovav neemanim lomar met peloni vetinnase ishto o tityabbem al pihem:

Vehakkol neemanim lehaid lah edut zo chutz mechamesh nashim shechezkatam sonot zo et zo sheen meidot zo lazo bemitat balah shemma yitkavvenu leasrah alav vaadayin hu kayyam. veellu hen. chamotah. uvat chamotah. vetzaratah. vivimtah. uvat balah. afillu akku"40 hammesiach lefi tummo neeman umassiin al piv kemo sheyyitbaer. veim nitkavven lehaid eno neeman:
Vechen happasul baavera min hattora im ba lehaid beishsha shemmet balah eno neeman. veim haya mesiach lefi tummo neeman en ze pachut min haakku"40. aval pasul middivrehem neeman leedut ishsha:

Ba ed echad veheid shemmet balah vehittiruha lehinnase al piv veachar kach ba acher vehichchish et harishon veamar lo met hare zo lo tetze mehetterah vetinnase. sheed echad neeman beedut ishsha kishne edim bishar eduyyot veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim:

Bau shenehem keechad ze omer met veze omer lo met. ishsha omeret met veishsha omeret lo met. hare zo lo tinnase. veim nisset tetze mippene shehi safek. veim nisset laed sheheid lah vehi omeret bari li shemmet hare zo lo tetze. bau shenayim veamru lo met af al pi shennisset tetze:

Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya haed echad shennisset al piv kemo hashshenayim shebbau vehichchishu oto. kegon shennisset al pi ish uvau shenayim veamru lo met. o shennisset al pi ishsha o al pi atzmah uvau shete nashim o shene pesulin shel divrehen veamru lo met. aval ed kasher omer met venashim rabbot omrot lo met o pesulin omrim lo met hare ze kemechetza al mechetza. veim nisset leechad meedeha vehi omeret vadday met hare zo lo tetze:
Ishsha omeret met o hi sheamra met bali veachar kach ba ed kasher veamar lo met hare zo lo tinnase. veim nisset tetze:

Ishsha omeret lo met ushete nashim omrot met hare zo tinnase. vechen im amru eser nashim lo met veachat esre omrot met hare zo tinnase. sheen omrim shenayim kemea ella beedim kesherim aval bifsulin hallech achar harov ben lehakel ben lehachamir:
Shene edim omrim met ushenayim omrim lo met hare zo lo tinnase. veim nisset tetze mippene shehi safek. veim nisset leechad meedeha vehi omeret bari li shemmet hare zo lo tetze:

Mi sheyyesh lo shete nashim uvaa achat mehen veamra met bali hare zo tinnase al pi atzmah kemo shebbearnu. vetzaratah asura sheen tzara meida lachavertah. vaafillu nisset zo techilla en omrin illu lo met balah lo hayta oseret atzmah alav. shemma missinatah betzaratah rotza hi sheyyeasru shetehen alav. zot omeret met bali vetzaratah machcheshet otah veomeret lo met hare zo tinnase. keshem sheenah meida lah lehattirah kach enah yechola lehaid lah leasrah. zot omeret met vetzaratah omeret neherag hoil ushetehen omrot sheeno kayyam hare ellu yinnasu:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 13: Haishsha sheamra levalah gerashtani bifne peloni ufeloni uvau otan haedim vehichchishuha veachar kach halcha hi uvalah veshalom baolam uvaa veamra met bali enah neemenet. shezzo huchzeka shakranit verotza lehishshamet mittachat balah. ba ed echad veheid lah shemmet balah lo tinnase shemma hi sachra oto. veim nisset lo tetze shehare yesh lah ed:

Vechen im hayta milchama baolam uvaa veamra met bali bammilchama enah neemenet veaf al pi shehaya shalom beno levenah (shemma) tismoch datah al devarim sherubban lemita vetomar met kegon shennehergu harishonim vehaacharonim shehaya balah beemtzaan shehare hi omeret meachar shennehergu ellu veellu neherag hu bichlalan. lefichach enah neemenet vaafillu amra met bammilchama ukevartiv. aval im amra met al mittato neemenet:
Lo huchzeka milchama baolam uvaa veamra milchama hayta bemakom peloni umet bammilchama lo tinnase lechattechilla. veim nisset lo tetze:

Vechen haishsha sheamra met bali tachat hammappolet enah neemenet. vechen im haya shilluach nechashim veakrabbim veamra neshacho nachash o akrav vamet enah neemenet. shemma tismoch datah al rov anashim shemmetu kach binshicha:
Amra ishshenu alenu bayit o meara hu met vaani nitztzalti enah neemenet. keshem shennaasa lah nes kach naasa lo. hayta shenat reavon veamra met bali enah neemenet. met ukevartiv neemenet:
Amra naflu alenu akku"40 o listim hu neherag vaani nitztzalti neemenet. sheen darkan laharog et hannashim kede shennomar keshem shennitztzela hi kach nitztzal hu:

Haya dever baolam veamra met bali neemenet sheddavar pashut befi kol adam shebbishnat haddever ze chay veze met. veefshar sheyyamutu baddever nearim chazakim veyinnatzlu hazzekenim hacholim. ulefi ze en choshshin lah shemma samcha datah al rov hammetim:

Kevar amarnu sheed mippi ed kasher leedut ishsha. bamme devarim amurim sheshshama mippi ben daat shemmet peloni kegon eved o shifcha. aval im shama mippi shote o mippi katan eno meid veen somchin al divrehem:

Shama min hattinokot shehen omrin achshav banu mehesped peloni kach vechach safdanin hayu sham ufeloni hechacham ufeloni ala achar mittato kach vechach asu bemittato hare ze meid mippihen al pi haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen umassiin et ishto:
Yisrael sheamar haragti et peloni hare zo tinnase al piv sheen adam mesim atzmo rasha vahare heid shemmet:

Kevar amarnu shehaakku"40 shehesiach lefi tummo massiin al piv. ketzad. haya akku"40 mesiach veamar oy lifloni shemmet kamma haya nae vechamma tova asa immi. o shehaya mesiach veomer keshehayiti ba badderech nafal peloni shehaya mehallech immanu vamet utemehani ledavar ze ketzad met pitom vechayyotze bidvarim haellu shehen marin sheen kavvanato lehaid hare ze neeman:

Yisrael sheshshama meakku"40 hammesiach lefi tummo meid sheshshama mimmennu vetinnase al piv. bamme devarim amurim shello hayta sham amatla. aval im hayta sham amatla besichat haakku"40 shemma lo yitkavvin ella ledavar acher. kemo sheamar leechad ase li kach vechach shello eherog otcha kederech sheharagti peloni. en ze mesiach lefi tummo shekkavvanato lehattil ema al ze:
Vechen im shama meerkaot shel akku"40 sheamru haragnu peloni enam neemanin. shehen machazikin yede atzman bechazav kede lehattil ema. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu:
Akku"40 shehesiach lefi tummo techilla af al pi sheshshaalu oto achar kach uvedakuhu ad sheyyefaresh kol hameora hare ze neeman umassiin al piv:

Kevar hodanu shehaed sheamar shamati shemmet peloni afillu shama meishsha sheshshama meeved hare ze kasher leedut ishsha umassiin al piv. aval im amar haed o haishsha o haeved met peloni vaani reitiv shemmet. shoalin oto heach raita uvema yadata shemmet. im heid bedavar barur neeman veim heid bidvarim sherubban lemita en massiin et ishto sheen meidin al haadam shemmet ella kesherauhu shemmet vadday veen bo safek:

Ketzad. rauhu shennafal layyam afillu tava bayyam haggadol en meidin alav shemmet shemma yatza bemakom acher. veim nafal lemayim mekubbatzim kegon bor o meara sheomed veroe kol sevivav veshaha kede shettetze nafsho velo ala meidin alav shemmet umassiin et ishto. vechen im hishlichuhu bayyam vehishlichu metzuda acharav veheelu mimmennu evar shei efshar sheyyinnatel min hachay veyichye hare ze meidin alav shemmet umassiin et ishto:

Rauhu shennafal legov arayot unemerim vechayyotze bahen en meidin alav. efshar shello yochluhu. nafal lachafirat nechashim veakrabbim o letoch kivshan haesh o letoch yora rotachat melea yayin o shemen o sheshshachatu bo shene simanin o rubban afillu amad uvarach meidin alav shemmet. shevvadday sofo lamut. vechen kol kayyotze baze middevarim shei efshar sheyyichye ella yamut miyyad bizman karov hare ellu meidin alav:

Rauhu tzaluv vehaof ochel bo af al pi sheddekaruhu o yaru bo chitztzim eno meid alav shemmet. veim rau haof ochel bemakom shehannefesh yotza bintilato kegon mocho o libbo o bene meav hare ze meid alav shemmet:

Ed echad omer reitiv shemmet bammilchama o bemappolet o shettava bayyam haggadol vamet vechayyotze bidvarim ellu sherubban lemita im amar kevartiv neeman vetinnase al piv. veim lo amar kevartiv lo tinnase. veim nisset lo tetze:

Vechen haishsha sheheid lah ed echad shettava balah bayyam o bemayim sheen lahem sof velo ala veavad zichro venishtakkach shemo hare zo lo tinnase al edut zo kemo shebbearnu. veim nisset lo tetze. vaafillu haya haakku"40 shehesiach lefi tummo veamar tava peloni bayyam venisset al piv hare zo lo tetze. vechacham shehora lehassiah lechattechilla menaddin oto:

Metzauhu harug o met. im paddachto vechatmo ufartzuf panav kayyamin vehikkiruhu bahen shehu peloni meidin alav. veim nittal echad meellu af al pi sheyyesh lahem simanin begufo uvechelav vaafillu shuma en meidin alav shemma acher hu. bamme devarim amurim besherauhu betoch shelosha yamim achar harigato o achar mitato. aval achar shelosha en meidin alav mippene sheppartzuf panav mishtanne:

Tava bayyam vehishlicho hayyam layyabbasha afillu achar kamma yamim. im hikkiru panav vechatmo meidin alav, sheeno mishtanne bammayim ella leachar zeman merubbe. veim shaha bayyabbasha achar shehushlach min hayyam 10"2 shaot venitpach en meidin alav shehare nishtanna. keshemmistakkelin betzurato kede lehakkiro lehaid alav bodkin oto veroin oto afillu ballayla leor hanner o leor hallevana:
Rau echad omed merachok veomer shehu peloni ben peloni o peloni mimmakom peloni vahare neshacho nachash vahare hu met vehalchu umetzauhu shennishtanna velo hikkiruhu hare ellu massiin et ishto:

Ba echad veamar amru li bet din o anashim keshettelech lemakom peloni emor lahem shemmet yitzchak ben michael. uva hashshaliach veamar lanu. vehashshaliach eno yodea mi hu ze. hoil veanu yodim peloni hayyadua beshem ze hare ishto mutteret veen omrin shemma yitzchak ben michael acher hu shemmet:

Yatza akku"40 veyisrael meimmanu lemakom acher. uva haakku"40 vehesiach lefi tummo veamar ish sheyyatza immi mikkan met. massiin et ishto veaf al pi sheen haakku"40 yodea oto haish. vehu sheyyomar kevartiv:

Vechen im yatzu asara bene adam keechad mimmakom lemakom vehen asurin bekolar o nosim gemallim vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. vehesiach haakku"40 lefi tummo veamar sheasara anashim shehalchu mimmakom peloni lemakom peloni vehem nosim kach vechach metu kullam ukevarnum massiin et neshotehen:

Yisrael sheamar met ish yehudi immanu bemakom peloni kach vechach tzurato vechach hayu simanav. en omrim beomed haddaat peloni hu ad sheyyaid haed shehu peloni veyazkir shemo veshem iro. aval im amar echad yatza immanu meir pelonit umet. mechappesin beotah hair im lo yatza mishsham ella hu tinnase ishto:

Matzu katuv bishtar met ish peloni ben peloni o neherag peloni ben peloni venoda shezze katav yisrael hare ze tinnase ishto. vechen mi shennishtattek uvadku oto kederech shebbodkin legittin venimtzet dato mechuvvenet vechatav shemmet peloni ben peloni somchin al ketivato vetinnase. veen bodkin ede ishsha bidrisha vachakira shello amru chachamim baddavar lehachamir ella lehakel mishshum hattarat aguna:

Al yikshe beenecha shehittiru chachamim haerva hachamura beedut ishsha o eved o shifcha o akku"40 hammesiach lefi tummo veed mippi ed umippi hakketav uvelo derisha vachakira kemo shebbearnu. shello hikpida tora al haadat shene edim ushear mishpete haedut ella bedavar sheen atta yachol laamod al buryo ella mippi haedim uveedutan kegon sheheidu shezze harag et ze o hilva et ze. aval davar sheefshar laamod al buryo shello mippi haed hazze veen haed yachol lehishshamet im en haddavar emet. kegon ze sheheid shemmet peloni. lo hikpida tora alav. sheddavar rachok hu sheyyaid bo haed besheker. lefichach hekellu chachamim bedavar ze veheeminu bo ed echad mippi shifcha umin hakketav uvelo derisha vachakira kede shello tishshaarna benot yisrael agunot: <small>seliku lehu hilchot gerushin besiyyata dishmayya</small>
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 1: Chatzer sheyyesh bah shechenim harebe kol echad mehem bevayit leatzmo din tora hu sheyyihyu kullan muttarin letaltel bechol hechatzer umibbattim lechatzer umehechatzer labbattim mippene shekkol hechatzer reshut hayyachid achat umuttar letaltel bechullah. vechen haddin bemavoy sheyyesh lo lechi o kora sheyyihyu kol bene hammavoy muttarim letaltel bechullo umechatzerot lammavoy umimmavoy lachatzerot shekkol hammavoy reshut hayyachid hu. vechen haddin bimdina shehi mukkefet choma gevoha asara tefachim sheyyesh lah delatot veninalot ballayla shekkullah reshut hayyachid hi. ze hu din tora:

Aval middivre sofrim asur lishchenim letaltel birshut hayyachid sheyyesh bah chaluka bediyyurin ad sheyyearvu kol hashshechenim kullan meerev shabbat. echad chatzer veechad mavoy veechad hammedina. vedavar ze takkanat shelomo uvet dino:

Vechen yoshve ohalim o sukkot o machane shehikkifuhu mechitztza en metaltelin meohel leohel ad sheyyearvu kullan. aval shayyara shehikkifa mechitztza en tzerichin learev ella motziin meohel leohel belo eruv lefi shehen kullan meoravin veen otan ohalim kevuin lahen:

Umippene ma tikken shelomo davar ze. kede shello yitu haam veyomru keshem shemmuttar lehotzi min hachatzerot lirchovot hammedina ushevakeha ulehachnis mehem lachatzerot kach muttar lehotzi min hammedina lassade ulehachnis min hassade lammedina. veyachshevu shehashshevakim veharchovot hoil vehen reshut lakkol hare hen kesadot uchemidbarot veyomru shehachatzerot bilvad hen reshut hayyachid vidammu sheen hahotzaa melacha veshemmuttar lehotzi ulehachnis mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim:

Lefichach tikken shekkol reshut hayyachid shettechellak bediyyurin veyochaz kol echad veechad bah reshut leatzmo veyishshaer mimmenna makom birshut kullan veyad kullan shava bo kegon chatzer labbattim. shennachshov oto hammakom sheyyad kullan shava bo keillu hu reshut larabbim. venechshav kol makom umakom sheachaz kol echad min hashshechenim vechilleko leatzmo shehu bilvad reshut hayyachid. veyihye asur lehotzi mershut shechalak leatzmo lirshut sheyyad kullam shava bo. kemo sheen motziin mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim. ella yishtammesh kol echad barshut shechalak leatzmo bilvad ad sheyyearvu kullan af al pi shehakkol reshut hayyachid:

Uma hu haeruv hazze. hu sheyyitarvu bemaachol echad shemmannichin oto meerev shabbat. kelomar shekkullanu meoravin veochel echad lechullanu veen kol echad mimmennu cholek reshut mechavero ella keshem sheyyad kullanu shava bemakom ze shennishar lechullanu kach yad kullanu shava bechol makom sheyyochez kol echad leatzmo vahare kullanu reshut echad. uvammaase hazze lo yavou litot uledammot shemmuttar lehotzi ulehachnis mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim:
Haeruv sheosim bene hechatzer ze im ze hu hannikra eruve chatzerot. vesheosin anshe mavoy ze im ze o kol bene hammedina hu hannikra shittuf:

En mearvin bachatzerot ella befat shelema bilvad. afillu kikkar maafe sea vehi perusa en mearvin bah. hayta shelema vehi keisar mearvin bah. ucheshem shemmearvin befat tevua kach mearvin befat orez uvefat adashim aval lo befat dochan. veshittuf ben befat ben bishar ochalim. bechol ochel mishtattefin chutz min hammayim bifne atzman o melach bifne atzmo. vechen kemehin ufitriyyot en mishtattefin bahen sheenan chashuvin koochalim. erev mayim im melach naasa kemureyas umishtattefin:

Vechamma shiur haochel shemmishtattefin bo. kigrogeret lechol echad veechad mibbene hammavoy o mibbene hammedina. vehu sheyyihyu shemone esre o pachot. aval im hayu merubbim al ze shiuro shete seuddot shehen kishmone esre gerogarot shehen keshesh betzim benoniyyot. afillu hayu hammishtattefin alafim urevavot shete seuddot lechullan:

Kol ochel shehu neechol kemot shehu kegon pat umine dagan uvasar chay im nishtattefu bo shiuro mezon shete seuddot. vechol shehu liftan vederech haam leechol bo pittan kegon yayin mevushshal uvasar tzali vechometz umureyas vezetim veimmahot shel betzalim shiuro kede leechol bo shete seuddot:
