Nishtattefu beyayin chay shiuro shete reviiyyot lechullan. vechen beshechar shete reviiyyot. betzim shetayim umishtattefin bahen vaafillu hen chayyot. verimmonim shenayim. etrog echad. chamishsha egozim. chamishsha afarsekim. litra shel yarak ben chay ben shaluk veim haya bashil velo bashil en mearvin bo lefi sheeno rauy laachila. ukkela tavlin. kav temarim. kav gerogarot. mane devela. kav tappuchin. keshut kimlo hayyad. polin lachin kimlo hayyad. chazin litra. vehatteradin hare hen bichlal hayyarak umearvin bahen. ale betzalim en mearvin bahen. ella im hivtzilu venaasa orech kol ale mehen zeret. aval pachot mikkan eno ochel. vechol ellu haddevarim haamurin keliftan hen. ulefichach natnu bahen shiurin ellu. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. vechol hoochalin mitztarfin leshiur hashshittuf:

Litra haamura bechol makom melo shete reviiyyot. veukkela chatzi reviit. umane haamura bechol makom mea dinar. vehaddinar shesh main. vehammaa mishkal shesh esre seorot. vehassela arbaa dinarin. veharviit machzeket min hammayim o min hayyayin mishkal shiva asar dinarin vachatzi dinar bekeruv. nimtza hallitra mishkal chamishsha usheloshim dinar. vehaukkela mishkal tisha dinarin pachot revia:
Sea haamura bechol makom sheshet kabbin. vehakkav arbaa login. vehallog arba reviiyyot. uchevar bearnu middat harviit umishkalah. veellu hashshiurin sheadam tzarich lizkor otan tamid:

Ochel shehu muttar baachila af al pi shehu asur leze hamearev hare ze mearev bo umishtattef bo. ketzad. mishtattef hannazir beyayin veyisrael bitruma. vechen hannoder meochel ze o shennishba shello yochlennu mearev bo umishtattef bo. sheim eno rauy laze hare hu rauy leacher:

Aval davar haasur lakkol kegon tevel afillu tevel shel divre sofrim. vechen maaser rishon shello nittela terumato kahogen. vechen maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu kahalacha. en mearvin umishtattefin bahen. aval mearvin umishtattefin bidmay mippene sherauy laaniyyim. uvemaaser rishon shennittela terumato. uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu af al pi shello natan et hachomesh sheen hachomesh meakkev. umearvin bemaaser sheni birushalayim mippene shehu rauy sham laachila aval lo bigvulin:

Ketzad mearvin bachatzerot. govin challa achat shelema mikkol bayit uvayit umannichin hakkol bichli echad bevayit echad mibbatte hechatzer afillu bevet hatteven o bevet habbakar o bevet haotzar. aval im natnu bevet shaar afillu bet shaar shel yachid o beachsadra o bemirpeset o bevayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot eno eruv. ucheshemmekabbetz haeruv mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mitzvat eruv. veomer beeruv ze yihye muttar lechol bene hechatzer lehotzi ulehachnis mibbayit levayit beshabbat. veyesh lekatan ligbot eruve chatzerot. uvayit shemmannichin bo eruv eno tzarich litten et happat. veim hayu regilin lehanniach bo en meshannin oto mippene darche shalom:

Vechetzad mishtattefin bemavoy. gove ochel kigrogeret mikkol echad veechad o pachot mikkigrogeret im hayu merubbin. umanniach hakkol bichli echad bechatzer mechatzrot hammavoy o bevayit min habbattim afillu bayit katan o achsadra o mirpeset hare ze shittuf. aval im hinnicho baavir mavoy eno shittuf. veim hinniach hakkeli bechatzer tzarich lehagebiah hakkeli min hakkarka tefach kede sheyyihye nikkar. umevarech al mitzvat eruv. veomer beze hashshittuf yihye muttar lechol bene hammavoy lehotzi ulehachnis mechatzerot lammavoy beshabbat:
Chalku et haeruv o et hashshittuf af al pi shehu bevayit echad eno eruv. aval im milleu et hakkeli min haeruv venishar mimmennu meat vehinnichuhu bichli acher muttar:

Hammishtattefin bammavoy tzerichim learev bachatzerot kede shello yishkechu hattinokot torat eruv. shehare en hattinokot makkirin ma naasa bammavoy. lefichach im nishtattefu bammavoy befat somchin alav veen tzerichin learev bachatzerot shehare hattinokot makkirin bappat. bene chavura shehayu mesubbin vekaddash alehen hayyom pat sheal hashshulchan somchin aleha mishshum eruve chatzerot. veim ratzu lismoch aleha mishshum shittuf somchin af al pi shehen mesubbin bechatzer:

Lakach echad mibbene hechatzer pat achat veamar hare zo lechol bene hechatzer o shehu ochel kishte seuddot veamar hare ze lechol bene hammavoy eno tzarich ligbot mikkol echad veechad. aval tzarich lezakkot lahen bo al yede acher. veyesh lo lezakkot al yede beno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo haivri veal yede ishto. aval lo al yede beno uvitto hakketannim velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim mippene sheyyadan keyado. vechen yesh lo lezakkot lahen al yede shifchato haivrit af al pi shehi ketanna. shehakkatan zoche laacherim bedavar shehu middivre sofrim. veeno tzarich lehodia livne hechatzer o livne hammavoy shehare zacha lahen veerev alehen shezzechut hi lahen vezachin lo leadam shello befanav:

En mearvin velo mishtattefin beshabbat ella mibbeod yom. umearvin eruve chatzerot veshittufe mevoot ben hashshemashot af al pi shehu safek min hayyom safek min hallayla. uleolam tzarich sheyyehe haeruv o hashshittuf matzuy veefshar leachlo kol ben hashshemashot. lefichach im nafal alav gal o avad o nisraf o shehaya teruma venitmet mibbeod yom eno eruv. mishshechashecha hare ze eruv. veim safek hare ze eruv shessefek haeruv kasher:

Natan haeruv o hashshittuf bammigdal venaal alav veavad hammafteach kodem shechashecha im i efshar lo lehotzi haeruv ella im ken asa melacha ben hashshemashot hare ze kemi sheavad veeno eruv shehare i efshar leachlo. hifrish terumat maaser o teruma gedola vehitna aleha shello tihye teruma ad shettechshach en mearvin bah sheadayin hi tevel kol ben hashshemashot vetzarich shettihye seudda haruya mibbeod yom:
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 2: Anneshe hechatzer sheervu kullan chutz meechad mehen shello erev immahen ben mezid ben shocheach hare ze oser alehen. veasur lechullan lehotzi mibbattehen lechatzer o mechatzer levattehen. bittel lahen ze shello erev reshut chatzero bilvad hare ellu muttarin lehotzi ulehachnis mibbattehen lechatzer umechatzer levattehen aval leveto asur. bittel lahen reshut beto ureshut chatzero hare kullam muttarin. hen mippene sheervu vahare bittel lahen reshut beto vachatzero. vegam hu muttar mippene shello nishar lo reshut vahare hu keoreach etzlam vehaoreach eno oser:

Hamevattel reshuto setam reshut chatzero bittel reshut beto lo bittel. vehamevattel reshuto livne chatzer tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad beferush veomer reshuti mevuttelet lecha ulecha ulecha. vehayyoresh mevattel reshut af al pi shemmet morisho beshabbat shehayyoresh kam tachat morisho lechol davar. uvittul reshut beshabbat muttar lechattechilla:
Bittelu ellu hamearvin reshutan leze shello erev. hu muttar shehare nishar levaddo. vehem asurin shello nishar lahen reshut. veen omrim yihyu keorchim etzlo sheen rabbim orchin etzel echad:

Hayu ellu shello ervu shenayim o yeter. im bittelu reshutam lamarvin hamearvin muttarin veellu shello ervu asurin. veen hamearvin yecholim levattel reshutam lishnayim shello ervu shekkol echad mehen oser al chavero. vaafillu chazar haechad shello erev uvittel reshuto lashsheni shello erev hare ze oser shebbeshaa shebbittelu lo hamearvin asur haya. echad sheerev eno mevattel reshuto leechad shello erev aval haechad shello erev mevattel reshuto leechad sheerev:

Keshem shebbaal habbayit ze mevattel reshuto levaal habbayit ze bechatzer achat kach mevattelin mechatzer lechatzer. umevattelin vechozrin umevattelin. ketzad. shenayim sheshsheruyim bechatzer velo erev. echad mehen mevattel reshuto lashsheni venimtza hashsheni metaltel birshuto shebbittel lo chavero ad sheyyaase tzerachav. vechozer hashsheni umevattel reshuto larishon umetaltel harishon birshuto shebbittel lo. vechen kamma peamim. veyesh bittul reshut bechurba kederech shehu bechatzer:

Mi shebbittel reshuto vechazar vetiltel birshuto shebbittel. im bemezid hotzi hare ze oser alehen shehare lo amad bevittulo. veim beshogeg hotzi eno oser shehare hu omed bevittulo. bamme devarim amurim shello kadmu vehecheziku ellu shebbittel lahen. aval im kadmu vehecheziku vehotziu im chazar hu vehotzi ben beshogeg ben bemezid eno oser alehen:

Shene battim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim vehekifum nachrim mechitztza beshabbat en mevattelin ze laze hoil vei efshar lahem learev meemesh. echad mibbene chatzer shemmet veheniach reshuto leechad min hashshuk. im met mibbeod yom hare hayyoresh sheeno mibbene hechatzer oser alehem. veim met mishshechashecha eno oser alehem. veechad min hashshuk shemmet veheniach reshuto leechad mibbene hechatzer. im mibbeod yom met eno oser alehem shehare kullan meoravim. veim met mishshechashecha oser alehem ad sheyyevattel reshut morisho lahen:

Yisrael veger sheshsheruyim bimara achat umet hagger mibbeod yom af al pi shello hechezik yisrael acher binchasav ad shechashecha hare ze hammachazik oser ad sheyyevattel shehare hu keyoresh. veim met hagger mishshechashecha af al pi shehechezik yisrael acher binchasav eno oser alav ella behettero harishon hu omed:

Yisrael haddar im haoved kochavim umazzalot o im ger toshav bechatzer eno oser alav sheddirat haoved kochavim umazzalot enah dira ella kivhema hu chashuv. veim hayu shene yisreelim o yater veoved kochavim umazzalot shachen immahen hare ze oser alehem. vedavar ze gezera shello yashkinu oved kochavim umazzalot immahen shello yilmedu mimmaasav. velamma lo gazru beyisrael echad veoved kochavim umazzalot echad. mippene sheeno davar matzuy. shehare yifchad shemma yityached immo veyahargennu uchevar asru lehityached im haoved kochavim umazzalot:

Shene yisreelim veoved kochavim umazzalot hashshochnim bechatzer achat veervu hayyisreelim leatzman lo hoilu kelum. vechen im bittelu leoved kochavim umazzalot o bittel lahen o bittelu hayyisreelim ze laze venaasu keyachid im haoved kochavim umazzalot lo hoilu kelum. sheen eruv moil bimkom oved kochavim umazzalot. veen bittul reshut moil bimkom oved kochavim umazzalot. veen lahen takkana ella sheyyiskeru mimmennu reshuto veyease haoved kochavim umazzalot keillu hu oreach immahen. vechen im hayu ovde kochavim umazzalot rabbim maskirin reshutam leyisreelim vehayyisreelim mearvin umuttarin. veyisrael echad shessachar min haoved kochavim umazzalot mearev im shear hayyisreelim veyutteru kullam. veen kol echad tzarich liskor min haoved kochavim umazzalot:

Shete chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo veyisrael veoved kochavim umazzalot darim bappenimit veyisrael acher bachitzona. o shehaya yisrael veoved kochavim umazzalot bachitzona veyisrael acher bappenimit hare ze oser al hachitzona ad sheyyiskor mimmennu. shehare ragle shene yisreelim veoved kochavim umazzalot metzuyim sham. vehappenimi muttar bappenimit:

Sochrin min haoved kochavim umazzalot afillu beshabbat. shehassechirut kevittul reshut hi sheenah sechirut vaddait ella hekker bilvad. lefichach sochrin min haoved kochavim umazzalot afillu befachot mishsheve peruta. veishto shel oved kochavim umazzalot maskeret shello ledato. vechen sechiro veshammasho maskirin shello ledato. vaafillu haya sechiro o shammasho yisreeli hare ze maskir shello ledato. shaal min haoved kochavim umazzalot makom lehanniach bo chafatzav vehishilo hare nishtattef immo birshuto umaskir shello ledato. hayu leoved kochavim umazzalot ze sechirim o shammashim o nashim rabbim im hiskir echad mehen dayyo:

Shene yisreelim veoved kochavim umazzalot haddarim bechatzer achat vesachru min haoved kochavim umazzalot beshabbat chozer haechad umevattel reshuto lashsheni umuttar. vechen im met haoved kochavim umazzalot beshabbat mevattel hayyisreeli layyisreeli haacher veyihye muttar letaltel:

Oved kochavim umazzalot shehiskir leoved kochavim umazzalot im en harishon yachol lehotzi haoved kochavim umazzalot hashsheni ad sheyyashlim zeman sechiruto sochrin mizze haoved kochavim umazzalot hashsheni shehare nichnas tachat habbealim. veim yesh reshut larishon lehotzi haoved kochavim umazzalot hassocher mimmennu bechol et sheyyirtze. im lo haya hashsheni omed vesachru hayyisreelim min harishon hare ellu muttarin:

Chatzer sheyyisreelim veoved kochavim umazzalot sheruyin bah vehayu challonot petuchot mibbet yisreeli ze levet yisreeli ze veasu eruv derech challonot. af al pi shehen muttarin lehotzi mibbayit levayit derech challonot hare hen asurin lehotzi mibbayit levayit derech petachim mippene haoved kochavim umazzalot ad sheyyaskir. sheen rabbim naasim beeruv keyachid bimkom haoved kochavim umazzalot:

Yisrael shehu mechallel shabbat befarhesya o shehu oved avodat kochavim umazzalot hare hu keoved kochavim umazzalot lechol devarav. veen mearvin immo veeno mevattel reshut ella sochrin mimmennu keoved kochavim umazzalot. aval im haya min haeppikorosin sheen ovdin avodat kochavim umazzalot veen mechallelin shabbat kegon tzedokin uvaytosin vechol hakkofrim battora shebbeal pe, kelalo shel davar kol mi sheeno mode bemitzvat eruv, en mearvin immo lefi sheeno mode baeruv. veen sochrin mimmennu lefi sheeno keoved kochavim umazzalot. aval mevattel hu reshuto leyisrael hakkasher vezo hi takkanato. vechen im haya yisrael echad kasher veze hatztzedoki bechatzer hare ze oser alav ad sheyyevattel lo reshuto:
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 3: Chalon shebben shete chatzerot im yesh bo arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim o yeter al ze vehaya karov min haaretz betoch asara tefachim. afillu kullo lemala measara umiktzato betoch asara o kullo betoch asara umiktzato lemala measara im ratzu yoshve shete hachatzerot learev kullan eruv echad harshut beyadan veyeasu kechatzer achat vitaltelu mizzo lazo. veim ratzu mearvin shene eruvin ellu leatzman veellu leatzman. haya hachallon pachot mearbaa o shehaya kullo lemala measara mearvin shene eruvin ellu leatzman veellu leatzman:

Bamme devarim amurim bechallon shebben shete chatzerot aval shebben shene battim afillu haya lemala measara. vechen challon shebben bayit laaliyya im ratzu mearvin eruv echad afillu sheen benehem sullam. vehu sheyyihye bo arbaa al arbaa. haya challon agol im yesh bo kede lerabbea bo arbaa al arbaa hare hu kimrubba:

Kotel shebben shete chatzerot o matben shebben shete chatzerot pachot measara tefachim mearvin eruv echad veen mearvin shenayim. haya gavoah asara o yeter al ken mearvin shene eruvin ellu leatzman veellu leatzman. veim haya benehem sullam mikkan vesullam mikkan hare hen kefetach. veim ratzu mearvin echad. vaafillu haya hassullam zakuf vesamuch lakkotel shehare en yecholin laalot bo ad sheyyimmashech veyitrachek mittachtav min hakkotel hare ze mattir. vaafillu lo haya maggia rosh hassullam lerosh hakkotel im nishar benehen pachot mishshelosha hare ze mattir umearvin echad im ratzu:

Haya hakkotel rachav arbaa veasa sullam mikkan vesullam mikkan af al pi shehassullamot meruchakim ze mizze im ratzu mearvin echad. en berochav hakkotel arbaa im en ben hassullamot shelosha mearvin echad. haya benehem shelosha mearvin shenayim:

Bana matztzeva al gabbe matztzeva betzad hakkotel. im yesh battachtona arbaa memaet. en battachtona arbaa veen benah leven haelyona shelosha memaet. veim ratzu mearvin echad. vechen bemadregot shel etz shessemachan lakkotel:

Kotel gavoah shebben shete chatzerot veziz yotze beemtzaito im nishar min hazziz ad rosh hakkotel pachot measara manniach sullam lifne hazziz umearvin echad im ratzu. aval im hinniach hassullam betzad hazziz eno memaet. haya hakkotel gavoah tisha asar tefachim motzi ziz echad baemtza umearvin echad im ratzu shehare min hazziz ad haaretz pachot measara umin hazziz haelyon ad rosh hakkotel pachot measara. haya hakkotel gavoah esrim tefachim tzarich shene zizin ze shello keneged ze. ad sheyyihye ben hazziz hattachton uven haaretz pachot measara uven hazziz haelyon uven rosh hakkotel pachot measara. umearvin echad im ratzu:

Dekel shechatacho usemacho al rosh hakkotel veal haaretz mearvin echad im ratzu veeno tzarich lekavo babbinyan. vechen hassullam kavdo kovo veeno tzarich lechabbero babbinyan. hayu kashshin mavdilin ben shete hachatzerot vesullam mikkan vesullam mikkan en mearvin echad shehare en kaf haregel ola bassullam lefi sheen lo al ma sheyyismoch. haya sullam baemtza vekashshin mikkan vekashshin mikkan im ratzu mearvin shenayim:

Haya ilan betzad hakkotel veasahu sullam lakkotel. im ratzu mearvin echad hoil veissur shevut hu sheggaram lo shello yaale bailan. asa ashera sullam lakkotel en mearvin echad mippene sheasur laalot aleha min hattora shehare hi asura bahanaya:

Kotel sheggavoah asara uva lemaato kede learev eruv echad im yesh beorech hammiut arbaa tefachim mearvin echad. satar miktzat hakkotel ad shennitmaet measara. tziddo hakkatzar notnin oto lechatzer zo ushear hakkotel haggavoah leven shete hachatzerot:

Nifratz hakkotel haggavoah shebbenehen. im hayta happirtza ad eser ammot mearvin shene eruvin. veim ratzu mearvin echad mippene shehi kefetach. hayta yeter meeser mearvin eruv echad veen mearvin shene eruvin:

Hayta happirtza pechuta meeser uva lehashelimah leyeter meeser chokek bakkotel gova asara tefachim umearvin eruv echad. veim ba lifrotz lechattechilla pirtza yeter meeser bechol hakkotel tzarich lihyot gova happirtza melo komato:

Charitz shebben shete chatzerot amok asara verachav arbaa o yeter mearvin shene eruvin. pachot mikkan mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim. veim miet amko beafar o bitzrorot mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim shessetam afar utzerorot becharitz mevuttalin hen. aval im milleahu teven o kash en memaatin ad sheyyevattel:

Vechen im miet rachbo beluach o bekane shehoshito beorech kol hecharitz mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim. vechol haddavar hannittal beshabbat kegon hassal vehassefel en memaatin bo ella im ken chibbero baaretz chibbur shei efshar leshamto ad sheyyachpor bedeker:

Natan luach sherachav arbaa tefachim al rochav hecharitz mearvin echad veim ratzu mearvin shene eruvin. vechen shete gezuzteraot zo keneged zo im hoshit luach sherachav arbaa tefachim mizzo lezo mearvin eruv echad. veim ratzu mearvin shene eruvin ellu leatzman veellu leatzman. hayu zo betzad zo veenan beshave ella achat lemala mechavertah im yesh benehen pachot mishshelosha tefachim hare hen kichtzotztera achat umearvin achat. veim yesh benehem shelosha o yeter mearvin shenayim ellu leatzman veellu leatzman:

Kotel shebben shete chatzerot shehu rachav arbaa vehaya gavoah asara tefachim mechatzer zo veshave lekarka chatzer sheniyya notnin rachbo livne hechatzer shehu shave lahen veyechashev mechatzeran. hoil vetashmisho benachat leellu vetashmisho bekashe leellu notnin oto leellu shettashmisho lahen benachat. vechen charitz shebben shete chatzerot amok asara tefachim mitztzad chatzer zo veshave lekarka chatzer sheniyya notnin rachbo lechatzer shehi shava lah. mippene shettashmisho nachat laze vekashe laze notnin oto leellu shettashmisho lahen benachat:

Haya hakkotel shebben shete hachatzerot namuch mechatzer haelyona vegavoah mechatzer hattachtona shennimtzeu bene haelyona mishtammeshin beavyo al yede shilshul uvene hattachtona mishtammeshin beavyo al yede zerika shenehen asurin bo ad sheyyearvu shetehen eruv echad. aval im lo ervu en machnisin meovi kotel zo labbattim veen motziin mehabbattim leavyo:

Shene battim shebbenehen churba shehi reshut hayyachid im yecholin shenehem lehishtammesh bachurba al yede zerika osrin ze al ze. veim haya tashmishah laze benachat vehaacher eno yachol lizrok lah mippene shehi amukka mimmennu hare ze shehi lo benachat mishtammesh bah al yede zerika:

Kol gaggot hair af al pi shezze gavoah veze namuch im kol hachatzerot veim kol hakkarpifot shehukkefu shello leshem dira sheen bechol echad mehen yeter al bet satayim im ovi hakketalim shebben hachatzerot im hammevoot sheyyesh lahen lechi o kora kullan reshut achat hen umetaltelin bechullan belo eruv kelim sheshshavtu betochan. aval lo kelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit ella im ken ervu:

Ketzad. keli sheshshavat betoch hechatzer ben ervu anshe hechatzer ben lo ervu muttar lehaaloto min hechatzer laggag o lerosh hakkotel. umin haggag legag acher hassamuch lo afillu haya gavoah mimmennu kol shehu o namuch. umin haggag haachar lechatzer sheniyya umechatzer sheniyya legag shelishi shel chatzer shelishit. umiggag shelishi lemavoy. umin hammavoy legag revii ad sheyyaavirennu kol hammedina kullah derech gaggot vachatzerot o derech gaggot vekarpifot o derech chatzerot vekarpifot o derech shelashtan mizze laze umizze laze. uvilvad shello yikkanes bichli ze levayit min habbattim ella im ken ervu anshe kol hammekomot haellu eruv echad:

Vechen im shavat hakkeli babbayit vehotzio lechatzer lo yaavirennu lechatzer acheret o legag acher o lerosh hakkotel o lekarpaf ella im ken ervu anshe kol hammekomot shemmaavirin bahen keli ze eruv echad:

Bor shebben shete chatzerot en memallein mimmennu beshabbat ella im ken asu lo mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim kede sheyyihye kol echad veechad dole mershuto. vehechan maamidin et hammechitztza. im hayta lemala min hammayim tzarich sheyyihye tefach min hammechitztza yored betoch hammayim. veim hayta hammechitztza kullah betoch hammayim tzarich sheyyihye tefach mimmenna yotze lemala min hammayim kede shettihye nikkeret reshut ze mershut ze:

Vechen im asu al pi habbor kora rechava arbaa tefachim ze memalle mitztzad hakkora veze memalle mitztziddah haacher ucheillu hivdila chelek ze mechelek ze af al pi shehammayim meoravin millematta kal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim:

Beer shebbeemtza hashshevil ben shene katle chatzerot af al pi shehi mufleget mikkotel ze arbaa tefachim umikkotel ze arbaa tefachim shenehem memallein mimmenna veen tzerichin lehotzi zizin al gabbah sheen adam oser al chavero derech avir:

Chatzer ketanna shennifretza bimloah lechatzer gedola mibbeod yom. anshe gedola mearvin leatzman umuttarim shehare nishar lahen petzimin mikkan umikkan. veanshe ketanna asurin lehotzi mibbattehen lechatzer shellahen ad sheyyearvu im bene haggedola eruv echad. sheddiyyurin shel gedola chashuvin kiktanna veen diyyure ketanna chashuvin kigdola:

Shete chatzerot sheervu eruv echad derech happetach shebbenehen o derech hachallon venistam happetach o hachallon beshabbat kol achat veachat mutteret leatzmah hoil vehuttera miktzat shabbat huttera kullah. vechen shete chatzerot sheerva zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah venafal hakkotel shebbenehen beshabbat ellu muttarim leatzman umotziin mibbattehen umetaltelin ad ikkar hammechitztza. veellu metaltelin ken ad ikkar hammechitztza hoil vehuttera miktzat shabbat huttera kullah. veaf al pi shennitvassefu haddiyyurin shehaddiyyurin habbain beshabbat enan osrin. niftach hachallon venaasa happetach bishgaga o sheasu nachrim ledatan chazru lehetteran. vechen shete sefinot shehayu keshurot zo bazo veervu venifseku asur letaltel mizzo lazo vaafillu haya mukkafot mechitztza. chazru veniksheru beshogeg chazru lehetteran:
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 4:
Anneshe chatzer shehayu kullam ochlin al shulchan echad af al pi shekkol echad veechad yesh lo bayit bifne atzmo en tzerichin eruv mippene shehen keanshe bayit echad. ucheshem sheen ishto shel adam uvene beto vaavadav osrin alav veeno tzarich learev immahen kach ellu keanshe bayit echad hen mippene shehen kullan somchin al shulchan echad: 
Vechen im hutzrechu laasot eruv im anshe chatzer acheret eruv echad lechullan ufat achat bilvad molichin leoto makom shemmearvin immo. veim haya haeruv ba etzlan enan tzerichin learev kemo habbayit shemmannichin bo haeruv sheeno tzarich litten et happat shekkol ellu habbattim kevayit echad hen chashuvin: 
Vechen anshe chatzer sheervu naasu kullan kevayit echad. veim hutzrechu learev im chatzer sheniyya kikkar echad bilvad hu shemmolichin al yede kullan lammakom shemmearvin bo. veim haya haeruv ba etzlan enan tzerichin litten pat: 
Chamishsha sheggavu et haeruv leholicho lemakom shemmannichin bo haeruv keshehem molichin enan tzerichin leholich al yede chamishshetan ella kikkar achat shekkevan sheggavu kullan naasu keanshe bayit echad: 
Haav uveno veharav vetalmido shehen sheruyin bechatzer enan tzerichin learev mippene shehen kevayit echad. veaf al pi sheppeamim ochlin al shulchan echad ufeamim enan ochlin hare hen kevayit echad: 
Haachim shekkol echad mehem lo bayit bifne atzmo veenan somchin al shulchan avihen. vechen hannashim o haavadim sheenan somchin al shulchan baalehen o rabban tamid aval ochlin hem al shulchano bischar melacha sheosin lo o betova yamim yeduin kemi shessoed etzel chavero shavua o chodesh. im en immahen diyyurin acherim bechatzer enan tzerichin learev. veim ervu im chatzer acheret eruv echad lechullan. veim ba haeruv etzlan en notnin pat. veim hayu diyyurin immahen bechatzer tzerichin pat lechol echad veechad kishar anshe hechatzer mippene sheenan somchin al shulchan echad tamid: 
Chamesh chavurot sheshshavtu bitraklin echad. im haya mafsik ben kol chavura vachavura mechitztza hammaggaat lattikra hare kol chavura mehen keillu hi becheder bifne atzmo o baaliyya bifne atzmah lefichach tzerichin pat mikkol chavura. veim en hammechitztzot maggiot lattikra kikkar echad lechullan shekkullan keanshe bayit echad chashuvin: 
Mi sheyyesh lo bachatzar chavero bet shaar sherabbim dorsin bo o achsadra o mirpeset o bet habbakar o bet hatteven o bet haetzim o otzar hare ze eno oser alav ad sheyyihye lo immo bechatzer mekom dira shehu somech alav leechol bo pitto veachar kach yihye oser alav ad sheyyearev immo. aval mekom lina eno oser. lefichach im kava lo makom leechol bo bevet shaar o beachsadra umirpeset eno oser alav lefi sheeno mekom dira: 
Asara battim ze lifnim mizze habbayit happenimi vehashsheni lo hem shennotnin et haeruv vehashshemona battim hachitzonim enan notnin et haeruv hoil verabbim dorsin bahen hare hen kevet shaar vehaddar bevet shaar eno oser. aval hatteshii en dorsin bo rabbim ella yachid lefichach oser ad sheyyitten eruvo: 
Shete chatzerot uvenehen shelosha battim petuchim ze laze ufetuchim lachatzerot veheviu bene chatzer zo eruvan derech habbayit happatuach lahen vehinnichuhu bevayit emtzai. vechen heviu bene hechatzer haacher eruvan derech happatuach lahen vehinnichuhu babbayit haemtzai. otan hashshelosha battim enan tzerichin litten et happat. haemtzai mippene shehinnichu bo haeruv vehashshenayim shemmitztzedadav mippene shekkol echad mehen bet shaar leanshe chatzer: 
Shete chatzerot ushene battim petuchin ze laze benehen veheviu ellu eruvan derech habbayit happatuach lahen vehinnichuhu babbayit hashsheni hassamuch lechatzer haacheret veheviu ellu eruvan derech happetach hassamuch lahen vehinnichuhu babbayit haacher. shetehen lo kanu eruv. shekkol echad mehen hinniach eruvo bevet shaar shel chatzer acheret: 
Echad mibbene hechatzer shehaya goses af al pi sheeno yachol lichyot bo bayyom hare ze oser al bene hechatzer ad sheyyezakku lo befat viarvu alav. vechen katan af al pi sheeno yachol leechol kazzayit hare ze oser ad sheyyearvu alav. aval haoreach eno oser leolam kemo shebbearnu: 
Echad mibbene chatzer shehinniach beto vehalach veshavat bechatzer acheret afillu hayta semucha lachatzero. im hissia millibbo veen dato lachazor leveto beshabbat hare ze eno oser alehen. bamme devarim amurim beyisrael. aval oved kochavim afillu halach lishbot beir acheret oser alehen ad sheyyiskeru mimmennu mekomo shehare efshar sheyyavo beshabbat: 
Baal hechatzer shehiskir mibbatte chatzero laacherim vehinniach lo kelim o mine sechora bechol bayit uvayit mehen enan osrin alav hoil veyesh lo tefisat yad bechol bayit mehen naasu hakkol keorchin etzlo. bamme devarim amurim beshehinniach sham davar sheasur letaltelo beshabbat kegon tevel vaashashiyyot. aval im nishar lo bechol bayit mehen kelim shemmuttar letaltelan hoil veefshar sheyyotziem hayyom velo yishshaer lo sham tefisat yad hare ellu osrin alav ad sheyyearvu: 
Anshe hechatzer sheshshachchu velo ervu en motziim mibbattim lechatzer velo mechatzer levattim aval metaltelin hen kelim sheshshavtu bechatzer bechol hechatzer uvechol hannechshav im hechatzer. veim hayta sham mirpeset o aliyya veervu anshe hechatzer leatzman veanshe hammirpeset leatzman. anshe hammirpeset o anshe haaliyya metaltelin kelim sheshshavtu bevattehen bechol hammirpeset uvechol hannechshav immah o bechol rochav haaliyya uvechol hannechshav immah. veanshe hechatzer metaltelin bechol hechatzer uvechol hannechshav immah. vechen im haya yachid dar bechatzer veyachid dar baaliyya veshachchu velo ervu. ze metaltel bechol haaliyya vehannechshav immah veze metaltel bechol hechatzer vehannechshav immah: 
Ketzad. hassela o tel vechayyotze bo shebbetoch hechatzer im enan gevohin asara tefachim hare ellu nechshavin ben hechatzer uven hammirpeset ushenehen asurin lehotzi sham kelim shebbabbattim. veim gevohin asara vehaya benehen uven hammirpeset pachot mearbaa tefachim hare ellu nechshavin im hammirpeset shehare hen shavin lah uvene mirpeset muttarin bahem. veim hayu rechokin min hammirpeset arbaa tefachim o yeter al ken af al pi sheggevohin asara hare ellu bichlal hechatzer vehammirpeset lefi sheshshenehen efshar lehishtammesh bahen al yede zerika. lefichach shenehen asurin lehotzi lesham kele habbattim ad sheyyearvu. hayta matztzeva rechava arbaa tefachim lifne hammirpeset en hammirpeset oseret al bene hechatzer shehare nechleka mehen: 
Zizin hayyotzin min hakketalim. kol shehu lematta measara tefachim hare ze nechshav min hechatzer uvene hechatzer mishtammeshin bo. vechol shehu betoch asara tefachim haelyonim hassemuchin laaliyya. anshe aliyya mishtammeshin bo vehannishar ben asara hattachtonim ad techillat asara haelyonim min hazzizin hayyotzin sham shenehen asurin bo veen mishtammeshin bahen bakkelim shebbabbattim ella im ken ervu: 
Bor shebbechatzer im haya male perot tevalim sheasur letaltelan beshabbat vechayyotze bahen hare hu vechulyato kesela o tel shebbechatzer. im haya gavoah asara vehaya samuch lammirpeset hare hu nechshav im hammirpeset. aval im haya male mayim en bene chatzer velo bene mirpeset machnisin mimmennu labbattim ad sheyyearvu: 
Shete chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo veanshe happenimit yotzin venichnasin veovrin al hachitzona. erva happenimit velo erva hachitzona happenimit mutteret vehachitzona asura. erva hachitzona velo erva happenimit shetehen asurot. happenimit mippene shello erva vehachitzona mippene ellu shello ervu sheovrin alehen. ervu zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah zo mutteret bifne atzmah vezo mutteret bifne atzmah aval en metaltelin mizzo lazo: 
Shachach echad min hachitzona velo erev happenimit behetterah omedet. shachach echad min bene happenimit velo erev immahen af hachitzona asura mippene ellu bene happenimit shello ala lahen eruv shehen ovrin alehen: 
Asu shetehen eruv echad im hinnichuhu bachitzona veshachach echad mehen velo erev ben shehaya mibbene hachitzona ben mibbene happenimit shetehen asurot ad sheyyevattel lahen shehare bearnu shemmevattelin mechatzer lechatzer. veim hinnichu eruvan bappenimit veshachach echad mibbene hachitzona velo erev hachitzona asura ufenimit mutteret bimkomah. shachach echad mibbene happenimit velo erev shetehen asurot ad sheyyevattel lahen: 
Haya echad dar bechatzer zo veechad dar bechatzer zo enan tzerichin learev ella kol echad mehen mishtammesh bechol chatzero. veim haya oved kochavim umazzalot bappenimit af al pi shehu echad hare hu kerabbim veoser al hachitzona ad sheyyiskeru mekomo: 
Shalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo verabbim bechol chatzer mehen. ervu shetayim hachitzonot im haemtzait hi mutteret immahen vehen muttarot immah ushetayim hachitzonot asurot zo im zo ad sheyyaasu shelashtan eruv echad. haya bechol chatzer mehen echad af al pi sherabbim dorsin bachitzona enan tzerichin learev shekkol echad mehen muttar bimkomo. hayu shenayim bappenimit hoil vehen asurin bimkoman ad sheyyearvu hare hen osrin al hayechidim shebbaemtzait veshebbachitzona ad sheyyearvu shenayim shebbappenimit. ze hakkelal regel haasura bimkomah oseret shello bimkomah veregel hammutteret bimkomah enah oseret shello bimkomah mippene sheoveret alehen: 
Shete ketzotzteriyyot zo lemala mizzo shehen lemala min hammayim af al pi sheasta kol achat mehen mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim yoredet mikkol achat veachat. im hayu shete hakketzotzteriyyot betoch asara tefachim hare ellu asurin lemalleot ad sheyyearvu shetehen eruv echad mippene shehen kichtzotztera achat. veim haya ben haelyona vehattachtona yoter al asara tefachim veerva zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah shetehen muttarot lemalleot: 
Lo asta haelyona mechitztza veasta hattachtona af hattachtona asura lemalleot mippene deli shel bene haelyona shehen asurin sheover aleha. asta haelyona mechitztza velo asta hattachtona haelyona mutteret lemalleot vehattachtona asura. veim nishtattefu bene hattachtona im bene haelyona bammechitztza sheasu shetehen asurot lemalleot ad sheyyearvu eruv echad: 
Shalosh diatot zo lemala mizzo elyona vetachtona shel echad veemtzait shel echad lo yeshalshel min haelyona lattachtona derech emtzait sheen meshalshelin mershut lirshut derech reshut acher. aval meshalshel hu min haelyona lehattachtona shello derech emtzait: 
Shete diatot zo keneged zo vechatzer achat tachtehen sheshshofchin letochah hammayim lo yishpechu letochah ad sheyyearvu shetehen eruv echad. asu miktzatan uka bechatzer lishpoch bah hammayim umiktzatan lo asu. ellu sheasu shofchim lauka shellahen veellu shello asu lo yishpechu lachatzer ad sheyyearvu. veim asu ellu uka veellu uka kol achat mishshetehen shofechet lauka shellahen af al pi shello ervu:
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 5: Anneshe mavoy shehaya benehen shittuf bemaachol echad leinyan sechora kegon shekkanu yayin beshuttafut o shemen o devash vechayyotze bahen enan tzerichin shittuf acher leinyan shabbat ella somchin al shittuf shel sechora. vehu sheyyihye hammin shehen shuttafin bo min echad uvichli echad. aval im haya echad mehen shuttaf laze beyayin uleacher beshemen o shehaya hakkol yayin vehaya bishne kelim hare ellu tzerichin shittuf acher leinyan shabbat:

Echad mibbene hammavoy shebbikkesh mechavero yayin o shemen kodem hashshabbat velo natan lo batal hashshittuf. shehare gilla dato sheenan kullan keshuttafin sheen makpidin ze al ze. echad mibbene hammavoy sheragil lehishtattef im bene hammavoy velo nishtattef. bene mavoy nichnasin leveto venotlin mimmennu shittuf beal karcho. veechad mibbene hammavoy sheeno rotze lehishtattef kelal im bene hammavoy kofin oto lehishtattef immahen:

Echad mibbene hammavoy shehaya lo otzar shel yayin o shemen vechayyotze bahen hare ze mezakke mimmennu meat lechol bene hammavoy lehishtattef bo umearev bo alehem. veaf al pi shello hifrisho velo yichado ella hare hu meorav baotzar hare ze shittuf:

Chatzer sheyyesh lah shene petachim lishne mevoot im nishtattefa im echad mehen bilvad neesra bammavoy hashsheni veenah motzia umachnisa bo. lefichach im zikka echad beshittuf lechol bene hammavoy veshittef alehen tzarich lehodia leanshe hechatzer zo. sheenan mishtattefin ella middatan sheenah zechut lahen shemma bammavoy hashsheni rotzim lehishtattef velo baze:

Ishto shel adam mearevet lo shello middato vehu shello yeesoro al shechenav. aval im oser enah mearevet alav velo mishtattefet alav ella middato. ketzad oser. kegon sheamar eni mearev immachem o eni mishtattef immachem:

Nishtattefu anshe chatzer zo im echad mishni hammevoot im bemin echad nishtattefu afillu kala oto hammin hare ze ose shittuf acher umezakke lahen veeno tzarich lehodiam paam sheniyya. veim bishne minin nishtattefu venitmaet haochel mosif umezakke veeno tzarich lehodian. veim kalu mezakke lahem vetzarich lehodiam. nitvassefu shechenim bechatzer zo mezakke lahem vetzarich lehodiam:

Nishtattefa chatzer zo im bene hammavoy ze mippetach ze veim bene hammavoy hashsheni min happetach haacher mutteret im shenehen vehen muttarin immah ushene hammevoot asurin ze im ze. lo erva im echad mehem oseret al shenehen:

Hayta chatzer zo regila befetach echad vehappetach hashsheni enah regila. ze shergila lehikkanes velatzet bo oser vesheenah regila bo eno oser. erva im mavoy sheenah regila bo huttar hammavoy haacher leatzmo veeno tzarich learev immah:

Ervu bene hammavoy shehi regila bo leatzman vehi lo erva immo velo im bene hammavoy haacher sheenah regila bo vegam lo ervu bene hammavoy sheenah regila bo. dochin otah etzel ze hammavoy sheenah regila mippene shello erev. hoil vehi lo erva vehu lo erev dochin otah etzlo kede shello teesor al mavoy ze sheerev leatzmo:

Chatzer sheyyesh lah petach lemavoy ufetach acher levika o lekarpaf yeter mibbet satayim hoil veasur letaltel mechatzer leoto hakkarpaf eno somech ella al petach shel mavoy lefichach oser al bene hammavoy ad sheyyishtattef immahen. aval im haya hakkarpaf bet satayim o pachot eno oser al bene hammavoy sheal happetach hameyuchad lo somech hoil umuttar letaltel bechol hakkarpaf:

Echad mibbene mavoy shehalach lishbot bemavoy acher eno oser alehen. vechen echad mibbene mavoy shebbana matztzeva rechava arbaa tefachim al pitcho eno oser alehen shehare hifrish atzmo mehen vechalak reshuto:

Anshe mavoy shennishtattefu miktzatan veshachchu miktzatan velo nishtattefu mevattelin reshutan leellu shennishtattefu. vedinam leinyan bittul reshut kedin anshe chatzer sheshshachach echad mehen o shenayim velo ervu. uchevar amarnu shekkol adam im anshe beto hassemuchim al shulchano keish echad hen chashuvin ben leeruve chatzerot ben leshittufe mevoot:

Mavoy sheervu kol chatzerot shebbo kol chatzer vechatzer bifne atzmah veachar kach nishtattefu kullan bammavoy. shachach echad mibbene hechatzer velo erev im bene chatzero lo hifsid kelum. shehare kullam nishtattefu veal hashshittuf somchin velo hitzrichu learev bachatzerot im hashshittuf ella shello leshakkeach lattinokot torat eruv vahare ervu bachatzerot. aval im shachach echad mibbene hammavoy velo nishtattef asurim bammavoy umuttarin kol bene chatzer letaltel bachatzeran shehammavoy lachatzerot kechatzer labbattim:
Nishtattefu bammavoy veshachchu kullan learev bachatzerot. im en makpidin al perusatan somchin al hashshittuf bashshabbat harishona bilvad. veen mattirin lahen davar ze ella middochak:

Mavoy shello nishtattefu bo im ervu chatzerot im habbattim en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot kecharmelit. meachar sheervu chatzerot im habbattim naasa hammavoy keillu eno patuach lo ella battim bilvad belo chatzerot. ulefichach en metaltelin bechullan. veim lo ervu anshe hachatzerot metaltelin bechullan kelim sheshshavtu betocho kechatzer shello ervu bah:

Oved kochavim o tzedoki hashsharuy bechatzer shebbammavoy dino im bene hammavoy kedino im bene hechatzer shessochrim min haoved kochavim o meechad mibbene beto reshuto shebbammavoy. o mevattel lahen hatztzedoki. veim haya bammavoy oved kochavim veyisrael echad eno tzarich shittuf. vedin yisrael echad vedin rabbim shehen somchin al shulchan echad din echad hu:

Oved kochavim shehaya dar bammavoy im yesh lo bachatzero petach echad labbika eno oser al bene hammavoy. vaafillu haya petach katan arbaa al arbaa. veaf al pi shemmotzi gemallim ukeronot derech happetach shebbammavoy eno oser alehen sheen dato ella al petach hameyuchad lo shehu labbika. vechen im haya patuach lekarpaf shehu yeter al bet satayim hare ze kefatuach labbika veeno oser alehen. haya bet satayim o pachot eno somech alehen veoser alehen ad sheyyiskeru mimmennu:

Mavoy shetztziddo echad oved kochavim vetziddo echad yisreelim vehayu challonot petuchot mechatzer lechatzer shel yisrael veervu kullan derech challonot. af al pi shennaasu keanshe bayit echad umuttarin lehotzi ulehachnis derech challonot hare ellu asurin lehishtammesh bammavoy derech petachim ad sheyyiskeru min haoved kochavim. sheen naasim keyachid bimkom oved kochavim:

Ketzad mishtattefin bammedina. kol chatzer vechatzer mearevet leatzmah shello leshakkeach hattinokot. veachar kach mishtattefin kol anshe hammedina kederech shemmishtattefin bammavoy. veim hayta hammedina kinyan yachid afillu naaset shel rabbim mishtattefin kullan shittuf echad vitaltelu bechol hammedina. vechen im hayta shel rabbim veyesh lah petach echad mishtattefin kullan shittuf echad:

Aval im hayta shel rabbim veyesh lah shene petachim shehaam nichnasin baze veyotzin baze afillu naaset shel yachid en mearvin et kullah ella mannichin mimmenna makom echad afillu bayit echad bechatzer achat umishtattefin hashshear. veyihyu ellu hammishtattefin kullan muttarin bechol hammedina chutz meoto makom sheshshiyyeru. veyihyu otan hannisharim muttarin bimkoman bashshittuf sheosin leatzman im hayu hannisharim rabbim. vaasurin letaltel bishar kol hammedina:

Vedavar ze mishshum hekker hu kede sheyyedu shehaeruv hittir lahen letaltel bimdina zo sherabbim bokin bah. shehare hammakom shennishar velo nishtattef immahen en metaltelin bo ella ellu leatzman veellu leatzman:

Medina shel rabbim sheyyesh lah petach echad vesullam bemakom echad mearvin et kullah veenah tzericha shiyyur sheen hassullam shebbachoma chashuv kefetach. habbattim shemmannichin oto shiyyur af al pi sheenan petuchin lair ella achorehen lair ufenehem lachutz osin oto shiyyur umearvin et hashshear:

Hamezakke beshittuf livne hammedina. im ervu kullan eruv echad eno tzarich lehodian shezzechut hu lahen. vedin mi sheshshachach velo nishtattef im bene hammedina o mi shehalach lishbot beir acheret o oved kochavim shehaya immahen bammedina din hakkol kedinam bechatzer umavoy:

Medina shennishtattefu kol yoshveha chutz mimmavoy echad hare ze oser al kullan. veim banu matztzeva al petach hammavoy eno oser lefichach en mearvin medina lachatzain ella o kullah o mavoy mavoy. uvone kol mavoy umavoy matztzeva al pitcho im ratza lachalok reshuto mehen kede shello yeesor al shear hammevoot:
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 6: Mi sheyyatza min hammedina beerev shabbat vehinniach mezon shete seuddot rachok min hammedina betoch hattechum vekava shevitato sham. af al pi shechazar lammedina velan beveto nechshav oto keillu shavat bemakom shehinniach bo shete hasseuddot. veze hu hannikra eruve techumin:

Veyesh lo lehallech mimmekom eruvo lemachar alpayim amma lechol ruach. lefichach keshehu mehallech mimmekom eruvo lemachar alpayim amma keneged hammedina eno mehallech bammedina ella ad sof middato. veim hayta hammedina muvlaat betoch middato techashev hammedina kullah kearba ammot veyashlim middato chutza lah:

Ketzad. hare shehinniach et eruvo berichuk elef amma mibbeto shebbammedina leruach mizrach nimtza mehallech lemachar mimmekom eruvo alpayim amma lemizrach. umehallech mimmekom eruvo alpayim amma lemaarav. elef shemmin haeruv ad beto veelef amma mibbeto betoch hammedina. veeno mehallech bammedina ella ad sof haelef. haya mibbeto ad sof hammedina pachot meelef afillu amma achat shennimtzet middato kalta chutz lammedina techashev hammedina kullah kearba ammot vihallech chutza lah tesha meot shesh vetishim amma tashlum haalpayim:

Lefichach im hinniach eruvo berichuk alpayim amma mibbeto shebbammedina hifsid et kol hammedina kullah. venimtza mehallech mibbeto ad eruvo alpayim amma umeeruvo alpayim veeno mehallech mibbeto bammedina leruach maarav afillu amma achat. hammanniach eruvo birshut hayyachid afillu hayta medina gedola keninve vaafillu ir chareva o meara haruya lediyyurin mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechol ruach:

Hammanniach eruvo betoch hammedina sheshshavat bah lo asa kelum veen moddin lo mimmekom eruvo ella hare hu kivne hammedina kullan sheyyesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach chutz lammedina. vechen im natan eruvo bammekomot hammitztarfin lair shemmoddin hattechum chutz mehem hare ze kenotno betoch hair. natan eruvo chutz lattechum eno eruv:

En mearvin eruve techumin ella lidvar mitzva kegon shehaya rotze lelech levet haavel o lemishte shel nissuin o lehakebil pene rabbo o chavero shebba min hadderech vechayyotze beellu. o mippene hayyira kegon shehaya rotze livroach min haovde kochavim o min hallistim vechayyotze baze. veim erev shello leechad mikkol ellu ella ledivre harshut hare ze eruv:

Kol shemmishtattefin bo mearvin bo eruve techumin. vechol sheen mishtattefin bo en mearvin bo techumin. vechamma shiur eruve techumin mezon shete seuddot lechol echad veechad. veim haya liftan kede leechol bo shete seuddot. kemo hashshittuf:

Vetzarich sheyyihye hu veeruvo bemakom echad kede sheyyihye efshar lo leachlo ben hashshemashot. lefichach im nitkavven lishbot birshut harabbim vehinniach eruvo birshut hayyachid. o birshut hayyachid vehinniach eruvo birshut harabbim eno eruv. shei efshar lo lehotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim ben hashshemashot ella baavera:

Aval im nitkavven lishbot birshut hayyachid o birshut harabbim vehinniach eruvo becharmelit. o shennitkavven lishbot becharmelit vehinniach eruvo birshut hayyachid o birshut harabbim hare ze eruv. shebbishat keniyyat haeruv shehu ben hashshemashot muttar lehotzi ulehachnis mikkol achat mishshete harshuyot lecharmelit lidvar mitzva. shekkol davar shehu middivre sofrim lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot bimkom mitzva o bishat haddechak:

Netano bemigdal venaal veavad hammafteach im yachol lehotzio belo asiyyat melacha hare ze eruv. sheen asur laasot ben hashshemashot bimkom mitzva ella melacha. netano berosh hakkane o hakkundas hatztzomchin min haaretz eno eruv gezera shemma yitlosh. veim hayu telushin uneutzin hare ze eruv:

Kol hammanniach eruvo yesh lo bimkom eruvo arba ammot. lefichach hammanniach eruve techumin shello besof hattechum venitgalgel haeruv veyatza chutz lattechum betoch shete ammot hare ze eruv ucheillu lo yatza mimmekomo. veim yatza chutz lishte ammot eno eruv shehare naasa chutz lattechum vehammanniach eruvo chutz lattechum eno eruv mippene sheeno yachol lehaggia el eruvo:

Nitgalgel haeruv veyatza shete ammot chutz lattechum o avad o nisraf o shehaya teruma venitmet mibbeod yom eno eruv. mishshechashecha hare ze eruv. shekkeniyyat haeruv ben hashshemashot. veim safek hare ze eruv shessefek haeruv kasher. lefichach im neechal haeruv ben hashshemashot hare ze eruv:

Amru lo shenayim tze vearev alenu. echad erev alav mibbeod yom veechad erev alav ben hashshemashot. veze sheerev alav mibbeod yom neechal eruvo ben hashshemashot veze sheerev alav ben hashshemashot neechal eruvo mishshechashecha shenehem kanu eruv. shebben hashshemashot safek hu usefek haeruv kasher. af al pi chen safek chashecha safek lo chashecha en mearvin eruve techumin lechattechilla veim erev hare ze eruv:

Nafal al haeruv gal mibbeod yom im yachol lehotzio belo asiyyat melacha hare ze kasher shemmuttar lehotzio ben hashshemashot shehi sheat keniyyat haeruv. veim nafal alav gal mishshechashecha hare ze eruv veaf al pi shei efshar lehotzio ella baasiyyat melacha. safek mibbeod yom nafal o mishshechashecha hare ze kasher shessefek haeruv kasher:

Aval im erev bitruma shehi safek temea eno eruv sheenah seudda haruya. vechen im hayu lefanav shete kikkarot shel teruma achat tehora veachat temea veeno yodea e zo hi mishshetehen veamar eruvi battehora bechol makom shehu eno eruv. sheen kan seudda haruya laachila:

Amar kikkar ze hayyom chol ulemachar kodesh veerev bah hare ze eruv. shebben hashshemashot adayin lo nitkaddesha vadday ureuya hayta mibbeod yom. aval im amar hayyom kodesh ulemachar chol en mearvin bah sheenah reuya ad shettechshach. vechen im hifrish teruma vehitna aleha shello tihye teruma ad shettechshach en mearvin bah. shehare hi tevel kol ben hashshemashot vetzarich shettihye hasseudda reuya mibbeod yom:

Hannoten eruvo bevet hakkevarot eno eruv lefi shebbet hakkevarot asur bahanaya vechevan sherotze bekiyyum haeruv sham achar keniyya hare nehene bo. netano bevet happeras hare ze eruv vaafillu haya kohen mippene sheyyachol likkanes sham bemigdal happoreach o sheyyenappeach veholech:

Rabbim sheratzu lehishtattef beeruve techumin mekabbetzin kullan eruvan shete seuddot lechol echad veechad umannichin oto bichli echad bemakom sheyyirtzu. veim asa echad eruv al yede kullan tzarich lezakkot lahen al yede acher. vetzarich lehodiam sheen mearvin lo laadam eruve techumin ella ledato shemma eno rotze learev beotah haruach sheratza ze. veim hodio mibbeod yom af al pi shello ratza ella mishshettechshach hare ze eruv. veim lo hodio ad shechashecha eno yotze bo sheen mearvin mishshettechshach:
Kol hazzoche beeruve chatzerot mezakkin al yado beeruve techumin. vechol mi sheen mezakkin al yado eruve chatzerot en mezakkin al yado eruve techumin:

Noten adam maa levaal habbayit kede sheyyikkach lo pat viarev lo bah eruve techumin. aval im natan lechenvani o lenachtom veamar lo zeche li bemaa zo eno eruv. veim amar lo arev alay bemaa zo hare ze lokeach bah pat o ochel min hoochalin umearev alav. veim natan lo keli veamar lo ten li baze ochel uzeche li bo hare ze lokeach ochel umearev alav bo:

Mearev adam eruve techumin al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veal yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim ben middatan ben shello middatan. lefichach im erev alehen veervu leatzman yotzin beshel rabban. aval eno mearev lo al yede beno uvitto haggedolim velo al yede avdo veshifchato haivrim velo al yede ishto ella middatan. veaf al pi shehen ochlin etzlo al shulchano. veim erev alehen veshamu veshatku velo michu yotzin beeruvo. erev al echad mehen veervu hen leatzman en lecha mechaa gedola mizzo veyotzin beeruv atzman. katan ben shesh shanim o pachot yotze beeruv immo veen tzarich lehanniach alav mezon shete seuddot leatzmo:

Harotze leshalleach eruvo beyad acher lehannicho lo bemakom shehu rotze likboa shevitato sham harshut beyado. ucheshehu meshallecho eno meshallecho beyad cheresh shote vekatan velo beyad mi sheeno mode bemitzvat eruv. veim shalach eno eruv. veim shelacho beyad echad meellu happesulin leholicho leadam kasher kede sheyyolicho hakkasher veyannicho bimkom haeruv hare ze kasher. vaafillu shelacho al hakkof o al happil. vehu sheyyihye omed merachok ad sheyyire ze happasul o habbehema shehiggiu etzel hakkasher sheamar lo leholich et haeruv. vechen rabbim shennishtattefu beeruve techumin veratzu lishloach eruvan beyad acher hare ellu meshallechin:

Echad o rabbim sheamru leechad tze vaarev alenu veerev alehen bee ze ruach sheratza hare ze eruv veyotzin bo shehare lo yichadu lo ruach. haomer lachavero arev alay bitmarim veerev alav bigrogarot. bigrogarot veerev alav bitmarim. amar lo hanniach eruvi bemigdal vehinnicho beshovach. beshovach vehinnicho bemigdal. babbayit vehinnicho baaliyya baaliyya vehinnicho babbayit eno eruv. aval im amar lo arev alay setam veerev alav ben bigrogarot ben bitmarim ben babbayit ben baaliyya hare ze eruv:

Keshem shemmevarchin al eruve chatzerot veshittufe mevoot kach mevarchin al eruve techumin. veomer beze haeruv yihye muttar li lehallech lemakom ze alpayim amma lechol ruach. veim haya echad mearev al yede rabbim omer beze haeruv yihye muttar lifloni o livne makom peloni o livne ir zo lehallech mimmakom ze alpayim amma lechol ruach:
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 7:
Mi sheyyatza meerev shabbat chutz lammedina veamad bemakom yadua betoch hattechum o besofo veamar shevitati bemakom ze vechazar leiro velan sham. yesh lo lehallech lemachar meoto makom alpayim amma lechol ruach. veze hu ikkar eruve techumin learev beraglav. velo amru learev behannachat mezon shete seuddot bilvad bammakom af al pi shello yatza velo amad sham ella lehakel al heashir shello yetze ella yishlach eruvo beyad acher veyannichu lo: 
Vechen im nitkavven likboa shevitato bemakom yadua etzlo kegon ilan o bayit o gader shehu makkir mekomo veyesh beno uveno keshechashcha alpayim amma o pachot vehechezik badderech vehalach kede sheyyaggia leoto makom veyikne bo shevita af al pi shello higgia velo amad sham ella hechziro chavero lalun etzlo o shechazar meatzmo lalun o nitakkev. lemachar yesh lo lehallech ad makom shennitkavven lo umeoto hammakom alpayim amma lechol ruach. shekkevan sheggamar belibbo likboa sham shevitato vehechezik badderech naasa kemi sheamad sham o shehinniach eruvo sham: 
Bamme devarim amurim beani sheen matrichin oto lehanniach eruv o berachok kegon mi shehaya ba badderech vehaya yare shemma techshach. vehu sheyyishshaer min hayyom kede lehaggia leoto makom shekkana bo shevita kodem shettechshach im ratz bechol kocho vehaya beno uven oto makom keshettechshach alpayim amma o pachot. aval im lo haya rachok velo ani o shello nishar min hayyom kede sheyyaggia afillu ratz bechol kocho o shehaya ben hammakom shennitkavven lishbot bo uven hammakom shehu omed bo keshechashcha yeter mealpayim amma o shello kivven hammakom shekkana bo shevita. hare ze lo kana shevita berichuk makom veen lo ella alpayim amma lechol ruach mimmakom shehu omed bo keshechashcha: 
Mi sheamad mibbeod yom birshut hayyachid vekana sham shevita o shehaya ba badderech venitkavven lishbot birshut hayyachid hayyadua etzlo vekana sham shevitato hare ze mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechol ruach. veim hayta reshut hayyachid zo makom shello hukkaf ledira o tel o bika im haya bah bet satayim o pachot mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechol ruach. veim hayta yoter al bayit satayim en lo bah ella arba ammot vechutza mehen alpayim amma lechol ruach. vechen im hinniach eruvo bemakom shello hukkaf ledira: 
Hakkone shevita berichuk makom velo siyyem mekom shevitato lo kana shevita sham. ketzad. haya ba badderech veamar shevitati bemakom peloni o besade pelonit o bevika pelonit o berichuk elef amma o alpayim mimmekomi ze hare ze lo kana shevita berachok veen lo ella alpayim amma lechol ruach mimmakom shehu omed bo keshechashcha: 
Amar shevitati tachat ilan peloni o tachat sela peloni im yesh tachat oto ilan o oto sela shemone ammot o yater lo kana shevita shehare lo kivven mekom shevitato. sheim ba lishbot betoch arba ammot ellu shemma bearba ammot haacherot hu shekkana shevita: 
Lefichach tzarich lehitkavven lishbot beikkaro o bearba ammot shebbidromo o shebbitzfono. veim haya tachtav pachot mishshemone ammot venitkavven lishbot tachtav kana shehare en sham shiur shene mekomot vahare miktzat mekomo mesuyyam. hayu shenayim baim badderech echad mehen makkir ilan o gader o makom shehu kovea bo shevita vehashsheni eno makkir. ze sheeno makkir moser shevitato lammakkir vehammakkir mitkavven lishbot hu vachavero bammakom shehu makkir: 
Anshe hair sheshshalchu echad mehen leholich lahen eruvan lemakom yadua vehechezik badderech vehechziro chavero velo holich eruvan. hen lo kanu shevita beoto makom shehare lo hunnach sham eruvan veen lahen lehallech mimmedinatan ella alpayim amma lechol ruach. vehu kana sham eruv shehare hu ba badderech venitkavven lishbot sham vehechezik badderech. lefichach yesh lo lehallech leoto makom lemachar ulehallech mimmennu alpayim amma lechol ruach: 
Ze sheamarnu shetztzarich hakkone shevita berichuk makom sheyyachazik badderech. lo sheyyetze veyelech bassade ella afillu yered min haaliyya lelech leoto makom vekodem sheyyetze mippetach hechatzer hechziro chavero hare ze hechezik vekana shevita. vechol hakkone shevita berichuk makom eno tzarich lomar shevitati bemakom peloni ella kevan sheggamar belibbo vehechezik bederech kol shehu kana sham shevita. veen tzarich lomar mi sheyyatza beraglav veamad bemakom shekkone bo shevita sheeno tzarich lomar kelum ella kevan sheggamar belibbo kana: 
Hattalmidim sheholchin veochlin belele shabbat bassadot uvakkeramim etzel baale habbattim sheppittan metzuya leovre derachim habbaim sham uvaim velanim bevet hammidrash. mehallechin alpayim amma lechol ruach mibbet hammidrash lo mimmekom haachila. sheillu matzu seuddatan bevet hammidrash lo hayu yotzin lassade veen datan somechet laddira ella al bet midrasham:
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 8:
En mannichin shene eruvin echad bammizrach veechad bammaarav kede sheyyehallech bemiktzat hayyom al echad mishni haeruvin uvishar hayyom al haeruv hashsheni. sheen mearvin shene eruvin leyom echad. taa veerev lishte ruchot kimdumme hu shemmearvin lishte ruchot. o sheamar lishnayim tzeu vearvu alay echad erev alav latztzafon veechad erev alav laddarom mehallech keragle shenehem: 
Ketzad mehallech keragle shenehem. sheeno yachol lehallech ella bemakom sheyyesh lishnehem lehallech bo. natan haechad eruv berichuk elef amma leruach mizrach vehinniach hashsheni mehen eruvo berichuk chamesh meot amma leruach maarav. en ze sheervu alav mehallech bammaarav ella elef amma keragle mi sheerev alav bammizrach. velo yehallech bammizrach ella elef vachamesh meot amma keragle mi sheerev alav bammaarav. lefichach im erev o ervu alav shene eruvin ellu echad berichuk alpayim amma lammizrach veechad berichuk alpayim amma lammaarav hare ze lo yazuz mimmekomo: 
Mearev adam shene eruvin bishte ruchot umatne veomer im era li devar mitzva o nilchatzti lemachar venitzrachti leruach zo ze haeruv hu sheani somech alav vehaeruv shebbaruach hashshenit eno kelum. veim nitzrachti leruach zo hashshenit ze haeruv hu sheani somech alav veshebbaruach harishona eno kelum. veim nitzrachti lishte haruchot yesh li lismoch al eze eruv sheertze uleeze sheertze elech. veim lo era li davar velo nitzrachti leruach mehen en shene haeruvin haellu eruv veeni somech al echad mehen ella hareni kivne iri sheyyesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach michutz lachoma: 
Keshem sheasur latzet chutz lattechum beshabbat kach asur latzet beyom tov uveyom hakkippurim. ucheshem shehammotzi mershut lirshut beshabbat chayyav kach hammotzi mershut lirshut beyom hakkippurim chayyav. aval beyom tov muttar lehotzi mershut lirshut. lefichach mearvin eruve chatzerot umishtattefin bammevoot leyom hakkippurim keshabbat. umearvin eruve techumin leyom hakkippurim uleyamim tovim kederech shemmearvin leshabbat: 
Yom tov shechal lihyot samuch leshabbat ben millefaneha ben milleachareha o shene yamim tovim shel galuyyot yesh lo learev shene eruvin lishte ruchot vesomech al e ze mehen sheyyirtze layyom harishon veal haeruv shebbaruach hashsheniyya layyom hashsheni. o mearev eruv echad leruach achat vesomech alav leechad mishshene yamim uvayyom hashsheni yihye kivne hair ucheillu lo asa eruv veyesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach. bamme devarim amurim bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot aval bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana hare hen keyom echad veeno mearev lishne yamim ella leruach achat: 
Vechen matne adam al eruvo veomer eruvi leshabbat zo aval lo leshabbat acheret. o leshabbat acheret aval lo leshabbat zo. leshabbatot velo leyamim tovim leyamim tovim velo leshabbatot: 
Amar lachamishsha hareni mearev al eze mikkem sheertze ratziti elech lo ratziti lo elech. af al pi sheratza mishshechashcha yelech. davar shehu middivre sofrim yesh bo berera. vechen hamearev leshabbatot shel kol hashshana veamar ratziti elech lo ratziti lo elech ella ehye kivne iri kol shabbat sheyyirtze yelech af al pi sheratza mishshettechshach: 
Hamearev lishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot o leshabbat veyom tov af al pi shehu eruv echad leruach achat lishne hayyamim tzarich sheyyihye haeruv bimkomo matzuy belayil harishon uvelel sheni kol ben hashshemashot. ketzad hu ose. molicho beerev yom tov o beerev shabbat umachshich alav venotlo beyado uva lo im haya lel yom tov. ulemachar molicho leoto makom umannicho sham ad shettechshach veochlo im haya lel shabbat o mevio im haya lel yom tov. mippene shehen shete kedushshot veenan keyom echad kede shennomar millel rishon kana haeruv lishne yamim: 
Neechal haeruv barishon kana haeruv larishon veen lo eruv lashsheni. erev beraglav barishon tzarich learev beraglav bashsheni vehu sheyyelech veyaamod beoto makom veyachashov belibbo sheyyikne sham shevita. erev befat barishon im ratza learev beraglav bashsheni hare ze eruv. veim ratza learev befat tzarich learev beotah happat atzmah sheerev bah barishon: 
Yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot erev shabbat o leachar shabbat bizman shemmekaddeshin al pi hariyya yerae li shehen keyom echad ukedushsha achat hem: 
Ze sheamarnu sheyyesh lo learev shene eruvin bishte ruchot lishne hayyamim vehu sheyyihye efshar lo lehaggia lechol echad mishshene haeruvin bayyom harishon. aval im i efshar lo lehaggia laeruv shel yom hashsheni bayyom harishon en eruv hashsheni eruv. shehaeruv mitzvato sheyyihye basseudda haruya mibbeod yom veze hoil veeno yachol lehaggia leze haeruv bayyom harishon hare zo enah reuya mibbeod yom: 
Ketzad. hare shehinniach eruvo berichuk alpayim amma mibbeto leruach mizrach vesamach alav leyom rishon vehinniach eruv sheni berichuk amma achat o mea o elef beruach maarav vesamach alav leyom sheni en ze hashsheni eruv. shehare bayyom harishon en ze haeruv hashsheni rauy lo mibbeod yom lefi sheeno yachol lehaggia elav shehare lo nishar lo beruach maarav kelum: 
Aval im hinniach eruvo berichuk elef vachamesh meot amma mibbeto beruach mizrach vesamach alav leyom rishon vehinniach eruv sheni rachok mibbeto leruach maarav betoch chamesh meot amma vesamach alav leyom sheni hare ze eruv. shehare efshar lo sheyyaggia lo bayyom harishon: 
Yom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat eno ose eruv beyom tov lo eruve chatzerot velo eruve techumin ella mearev hu beyom chamishi shehu erev yom tov. veim chalu shene yamim tovim shel galuyyot bachamishi veerev shabbat meerev miyyom revii eruve techumin veeruve chatzerot. veim shachach velo erev hare ze mearev eruve chatzerot bachamishi uveerev shabbat umatne aval lo eruve techumin: 
Ketzad matne. omer bachamishi im hayyom yom tov en bidvaray kelum veim lav hare ze eruv. ulemachar chozer umearev veomer im hayyom yom tov kevar eravti meemesh veen bidvaray hayyom kelum veim emesh haya yom tov hare ze eruv. bamme devarim amurim bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot aval bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana hare hen keyom echad veeno mearev lahen ella meerev yom tov: salik hilchot oruvin
Mishneh Torah, Fasts 1: Mitzvat ase min hattora lizok uleharia bachatzotzrot al kol tzara shettavo al hatztzibbur. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 10 9)</small> "al hatztzar hatztzorer etchem vahareotem bachatzotzrot". kelomar kol davar sheyyatzer lachem kegon batztzoret vedever vearbe vechayyotze bahen zaaku alehen vehariu:

Vedavar ze middarche hatteshuva hu. shebbizman shettavo tzara veyizaku aleha veyariu yedu hakkol shebbiglal maasehem haraim hura lahen kakkatuv <small>(yirmeya 5 25)</small> "avonotechem hittu" vegomer. veze hu sheyyigrom lahem lehasir hatztzara mealehem:

Aval im lo yizaku velo yariu ella yomru davar ze mimminhag haolam era lanu vetzara zo nikra nikret. hare zo derech achzariyyut vegoremet lahem lehiddabbek bemaasehem haraim. vetosif hatztzara tzarot acherot. hu shekkatuv battora <small>(Vayikra 26 27)</small> "vahalachtem immi bekeri" <small>(Vayikra 26 28)</small> "vehalachti gam ani immachem bachamat keri". kelomar kesheavi alechem tzara kede shettashuvu im tomru shehi keri osif lachem chamat oto keri:

Umiddivre sofrim lehitannot al kol tzara shettavo al hatztzibbur ad sheyyeruchamu min hashshamayim. uvime hattaaniyyot haellu zoakin bitfillot umitchannenim umeriin bachatzotzrot bilvad. veim hayu bammikdash meriin bachatzotzrot uveshofar. hashshofar mekatztzer vehachatzotzrot maarichot. shemmitzvat hayyom bachatzotzrot. veen tokin bachatzotzrot veshofar keechad ella bammikdash shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 98 6)</small> "bachatzotzrot vekol shofar hariu lifne hammelech Adonai":

Taaniyyot ellu sheggozrin al hatztzibbur mippene hatztzarot enan yom achar yom. sheen rov hatztzibbur yecholim laamod bedavar ze. veen gozrin battechilla taanit ella besheni beshabbat uvachamishi shelleacharav uvesheni shelleacharav vechen al hasseder hazze sheni vachamishi vesheni ad sheyyeruchamu:

En gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur lo beshabbatot velo beyamim tovim. vechen en tokin bahen lo beshofar velo bachatzotzrot velo zoakim umitchannenim bahem battefilla. ella im ken hayta ir shehikkifuha akkum o nahar o sefina hammittarefet bayyam. afillu yachid hannirdaf mippene akkum mippene listim umippene ruach raa (mitannin alehem beshabbat v) zoakin umitchannenim alehem battefilla. aval en tokin ella im ken taku lekabbetz et haam laazor otam ulehatztzilan:

Vechen en gozrin taanit battechilla berashe chodashim o bachanukka ufurim o bechullo shel moed. veim hitchilu lehitannot al hatztzara afillu yom echad ufaga bahen yom meellu mitannin umashlimin hayyom betaanit:

Taaniyyot ellu shemmitannin al hatztzarot en mitannin bahen lo ubbarot velo menikot velo ketannim. umuttarin leechol ballayla af al pi shemmitannin lemachar chutz mittaaniyyot hammatar kemo sheyyitbaer. vechol taanit sheochlin bah ballayla ben tzibbur ben yachid hare ze ochel veshote ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. vehu shello yashen aval im yashen eno chozer veochel:

Keshem shehatztzibbur mitannim al tzaratan kach hayyachid mitanne al tzarato. ketzad. hare shehaya lo chole o toe bammidbar o asur bevet haasurin. yesh lo lehitannot alav ulevakkesh rachamim bitfillato. veomer anenu vechulei bechol tefilla shemmitpallel. velo yitanne beshabbatot velo bemoadot velo berashe chodashim velo bachanukka ufurim:

Kol taanit shello kibbelah alav hayyachid mibbeod yom eno taanit. ketzad mekabbelah. kesheyyitpallel tefillat mincha omer achar hattefilla machar ehe betaanit vegomer belibbo lehitannot lemachar. veaf al pi shehu ochel ballayla lo hifsid kelum. vechen im gamar belibbo vekibbel alav lehitannot shelosha o arbaa yamim ze achar ze af al pi shehu ochel kol layla velayla lo hifsid taanito. veeno tzarich kavvana lechol yom vayom mibbeodo:

Kibbel alav mibbeod yom lehitannot lemachar bilvad vehitanna. uvallayla nimlach lehitannot beyom sheni. af al pi shellan betaanito enah taanit mippene shello kibbelah alav mibbeod yom. veen tzarich lomar shehaya ochel veshote ballayla vehishkim babboker venimlach lehitannot sheen zo taanit kelal:

Haroe chalom ra tzarich lehitannot lemachar. kede sheyyashuv veyeor bemaasav vichappes bahen veyachazor bitshuva. umitanne vaafillu beshabbat. umitpallel anenu bechol tefilla af al pi shello kibbelah mibbeod yom. vehammitanne beshabbat mitanne yom acher mippene shebbittel oneg shabbat:

Mitanne adam shaot vehu shello yochal kelum shear hayyom. ketzad. hare shehaya tarud bachafatzav vmitassek bitzrachav velo achal ad chatzot o ad tesha shaot venimlach lehitannot bashshaot shennisharu min hayyom. hare ze mitanne otan shaot umitpallel bahen anenu. shehare kibbel alav hattaanit kodem sheot hattaanit. vechen im achal veshata veachar kach hitchil lehitannot shear hayyom hare ze taanit shaot:

Kol hashsharuy betaanit. ben shehaya mitanne al tzarato o al chalomo ben shehaya mitanne im hatztzibbur al tzaratam. hare ze lo yinhog iddunin beatzmo velo yakel rosho velo yihye sameach vetov lev ella doeg veonen kainyan shenneemar <small>(Eicha 3 39)</small> "ma yitonen adam chay gever al chataav". umuttar lo litom et hattavshil vaafillu bichde reviit vehu shello yivla ella toem ufolet. shachach veachal mashlim taanito:

Yachid shehaya mitanne al hachole venitrappe. al tzara veavra. hare ze mashlim taanito. haholech mimmakom shemmitannin lemakom sheen mitannin hare ze mitanne umashlim taanito. halach mimmakom sheen mitannin lemakom shemmitannin hare ze mitanne immahen. shachach veachal veshata al yitrae bifnehem veal yinhog iddunin beatzmo:

Tzibbur shehayu mitannin al haggeshamim veyardu lahen geshamim. im kodem chatzot yardu lo yashlimu ella ochlin veshotin umitkannesin vekorin hallel haggadol. sheen omrin hallel haggadol ella benefesh sevea vecheres melea. veim achar chatzot hoil veavar rov hayyom bikdushsha yashlimu taanitan. vechen im hayu mitannin al tzara veavra o al gezera uvatla. im kodem chatzot lo yashlimu veim achar chatzot yashlimu:

Bechol yom taanit sheggozrin al hatztzibbur mippene hatztzarot. bet din vehazzekenim yoshvin bevet hakkeneset uvodkim al maase anshe hair meachar tefillat shacharit ad chatzot hayyom. umesirin hammichsholot shel averot. umazhirin vedorshin vechokrin al baale chamas vaaverot umafrishin otan. veal baale zeroa umashpilin otan. vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. umechatzi hayyom velaerev revia hayyom korin bivrachot ukelalot shebbattora shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 11)</small> "musar Adonai beni al timas veal takotz betochachto". umaftirin bannavi betochachot meinyan hatztzara. urevia hayyom haacharon mitpallelim mincha umitchannenim vezoakim umitvaddim kefi kocham:
Mishneh Torah, Fasts 2:
Elu hen hatztzarot shel tzibbur shemmitannin umatriin alehem. al hatzarat sone yisrael leyisrael. veal hacherev. veal haddever. veal chayya raa. veal haarbe. veal hechasil. veal hashshiddafon. veal hayyerakon. veal hammappolet. veal hecholaim. veal hammezonot. veal hammatar: 
Kol ir sheyyesh bah tzara mikkol ellu. otah hair mitanna umatraat ad shettaavor hatztzara. vechol sevivoteha mitannot velo matriot aval mevakkeshim alehem rachamim. uvechol makom en tzoakin velo matriin beshabbat kemo sheamarnu. chutz mitztzarat hammezonot shetztzoakin aleha afillu beshabbat. aval en matriin aleha bachatzotzrot beshabbat: 
Al hatzarat sone yisrael leyisrael ketzad. akkum shebbau laaroch milchama im yisrael o littol mehem mas o likkach miyyadam eretz o ligzor alehem gezera afillu bemitzva kalla hare ellu mitannin umatriin ad sheyyeruchamu. vechol hearim shessevivotehem mitannin aval en matriin ella im ken taku lehitkabbetz leezratan: 
Al hacherev ketzad. afillu cherev shel shalom kegon shearchu milchama akkum im akkum veavru bimkom yisrael af al pi sheen benehem uven yisrael milchama hare zo tzara umitannin aleha shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 26 6)</small> "vecherev lo taavor beartzechem" mikkelal sheriyyat hammilchama tzara: 
Veal haddever. e zo hi dever ir sheyyesh bah chamesh meot ragli veyatzu mimmenna shelosha metim bishlosha yamim ze achar ze hare ze dever. yatzu beyom echad o bearbaa yamim en ze dever. hayu bah elef veyatzu mimmenna shishsha metim bishlosha yamim ze achar ze dever. yatzu beyom echad o bearbaa en ze dever. vechen lefi cheshbon ze. veen hannashim vehakketannim vehazzekenim sheshshavtu mimmelacha bichlal minyan anshe hammedina leinyan ze: 
Haya dever beeretz yisrael mitannin shear galuyyot yisrael alehen. haya dever bammedina veshayyarot holchot uvaot mimmenna limdina acheret shetehen mitannot af al pi shehen rechokot zo mizzo: 
En mitannin al chayya raa ella bizman shehi meshullachat. ketzad. nirata bair bayyom hare zo meshullachat. nirata bassade bayyom im raata shene bene adam velo barcha mippenehem hare zo meshullachat. veim haya sade hassemucha laagam veraata shene bene adam veradfa acharehem hare zo meshullachat. lo radfa acharehem enah meshullachat. veim haya baagam afillu radfa acharehem enah meshullachat ella im ken tarfa shenehem veachla echad mehen. aval im achla shenehem baagam enah meshullachat mippene shezze hu mekomah umippene haravon tarfa lo mippene shehi meshullachat: 
Battim habbenuyim bemidbarot uvaaratzot haneshammot hoil vehen mekom gedude chayya. im alta laggag venatla tinok mearisa hare zo meshullachat. veim lo higgia lemidda zo enah meshullachat. sheellu bene adam hem shessikkenu beatzmam uvau limkom hachayyot: 
Shear mine remes haaretz veremes haof sheshshullechu vehizziku. kegon shilluach nechashim veakrabbim veen tzarich lomar tzerain veyattushin vehaddome lahen en mitannin alehem velo matriin aval zoakin belo terua: 
Al haarbe veal hechasil afillu lo nire mehen ella kanaf echad bechol eretz yisrael mitannin umatriin alehen. veal haggovay bechol shehu. aval al hechagav en mitannin alav velo matriin ella zoakin bilvad: 
Al hashshiddafon veal hayyerakon mishsheyyatchil battevua. vaafillu lo hitchil ella mimmakom katan kimlo pi tannur gozrin alav taanit umatriin: 
Al hammappolet ketzad. hare sheravta bair mappolet ketalim beriim sheenan omdim betzad hannahar hare zo tzara umitannin umatriin aleha. vechen al haraash veal haruchot shehen mappilin et habbinyan vehorgin mitannin umatriin alehen: 
Al hecholayim ketzad. hare sheyyarad choli echad laanashim harebe beotah hair kegon askara o charchur vechayyotze bahen vehayu metim beoto hacholi hare zo tzarat tzibbur vegozrin lah taanit umatriin. vechen chikkuch lach hare hu kishchin poreach. veim pashat berov hatztzibbur mitannin umatriin alav. aval chikkuch yavesh tzoakim alav bilvad: 
Al hammezonot ketzad. hare shehuzelu devarim shel sechora sherov chayye anshe otah hair mehen. kegon kele pishtan bevavel veyayin veshemen beeretz yisrael. venitmaet hammassa vehammattan ad sheyyitztarech hattaggar limkor shevi asara beshishsha veachar kach yimmatze lokeach. hare zo tzarat tzibbur umatriin aleha vezoakin aleha beshabbat: 
Al hammatar ketzad. hare sherabbu alehen geshamim ad sheyyatzeru lahen hare ellu mitpallelin alehen. sheen lecha tzara yetera mizzo shehabbattim noflin venimtzeu battehen kivrehen. uveeretz yisrael en mitpallelin al rov haggeshamim mippene shehi eretz harim uvattehem benuyim baavanim verov haggeshamim tova lahen veen mitannin lehaavir hattova: 
Tevua shetztzamcha venimna hammatar vehitchilu tzemachin livash hare ellu mitannin vezoakin ad sheyyerdu geshamim o ad sheyyivshu hatztzemachim. vechen im higgia zeman happesach o karov lo beeretz yisrael shehu zeman perichat hailanot sham velo yardu geshamim hare ellu mitannin vezoakin ad sheyyerdu geshamim haruyin leilanot o ad sheyyaavor zemannam: 
Vechen im higgia zeman chag hassukkot velo yardu geshamim harebe kede lemalleot mehem habborot hashshichin vehammearot hare ellu mitannin ad sheyyered geshem harauy levorot. veim en lahem mayim lishtot mitannim al haggeshamim bechol et shello yihye lahem mayim lishtot vaafillu bimot hachamma: 
Pasku haggeshamim ben geshem legeshem arbaim yom bimot haggeshamim hare zo makkat batztzoret umitannim vezoakim ad sheyyerdu haggeshamim o ad sheyyaavor zemannam:
Mishneh Torah, Fasts 3: Hare shello yardu lahem geshamim kol ikkar mittechillat yemot haggeshamim. im higgia shiva asar bemarcheshvan velo yardu geshamim matchilin talmide chachamim bilvad lehitannot sheni vachamishi vesheni. vechol hattalmidim reuyin lechach:

Higgia rosh chodesh kislev velo yardu geshamim bet din gozrin shalosh taaniyyot al hatztzibbur sheni vachamishi vesheni. umuttarin bahen leechol velishtot ballayla. veanshe mishmar en mitannin immahen mippene shehen asukin baavoda. vechol haam nichnasim levatte kenesiyyot umitpallelin vezoakin umitchannenin kederech sheosin bechol hattaaniyyot:

Avru ellu velo naanu bet din gozrin shalosh taaniyyot acherot al hatztzibbur sheni vachamishi vesheni. uveshalosh ellu ochlin veshotin mibbeod yom kemo sheosin betzom kippur. veanshe mishmar mitannin miktzat hayyom velo mashlimin. veanshe bet av vehem haoskin baavoda beoto hayyom lo yihyu mitannim kol ikkar. vechol taanit sheochlin bah mibbeod yom im achal ufasak vegamar shello leechol eno chozer veochel af al pi sheyyesh shehut bayyom:

Beshalosh taaniyyot ellu kol haam asurin baasiyyat melacha bayyom umuttarin ballayla. vaasurin birchitzat kol hagguf bechammin aval panav yadav veraglav muttar. lefichach noalin et hammerchatzaot. vaasurin besicha. veim lehaavir et hazzuhama muttar. vaasurin betashmish hammitta. uvinilat hassandal bair aval badderech muttar linol. umitpallelin bevatte kenesiyyot vezoakin umitchannenin kishar taaniyyot:

Avru ellu velo naanu bet din gozrin sheva taaniyyot acherot al hatztzibbur sheni vachamishi vesheni vachamishi vesheni vachamishi vesheni. uveellu hashsheva bilvad ebbarot umenikot mitannot aval bishar hattaaniyyot en ebbarot umenikot mitannot. veaf al pi sheenan mitannot en meannegot atzman betafnukim ella ochlot veshotot kede kiyyum havvalad:
Uvesheva taaniyyot ellu anshe mishmar mitannin umashlimin. veanshe bet av mitannin miktzat hayyom velo mashlimin. vechol davar shehu asur beshalosh emtzaiyyot asur beellu hashsheva haacharonot:

Viterot ellu. shebbahen bilvad matriin umitpallelin birchov hair. umoridin zaken lehochiach laam kede sheyyashuvu middarkam. umosifin shesh berachot bitfillat shacharit uvitfillat mincha venimtzeu mitpallelin 24 berachot. venoalin et hachanuyyot. uvashsheni mattin leet erev ufotchin et hachanuyyot. aval bachamishi potchin kol hayyom mippene kevod hashshabbat. veim yesh lachanut shene petachim poteach echad venoel echad veim yesh lachanut itztabba poteach kedarko bachamishi veeno choshesh:

Avru ellu velo naanu. memaatin bemassa umattan uvevinyan shel simcha kegon tziyyur vechiyyur. uvintia shel simcha kegon mine hadas umine ahalim. umemaatin beerusin venissuin ella im ken lo kiyyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya. vechol mi shekkiyyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya asur lo leshammesh mittato bishne reavon. umemaatin bishelat shalom ben adam lachavero. vetalmide chachamim lo yishalu shalom ella kinzufin uchimnuddin lammakom. veam haaretz shennatan lahem shalom machzirin lo besafa rafa vechoved rosh:

Talmide chachamim chozrin levaddam umitannim sheni vachamishi vesheni ad sheyyetze nisan shel tekufa aval lo hatztzibbur. sheen gozrin al hatztzibbur bishvil geshamim shello yardu yeter mishshelosh esre taaniyyot ellu. ucheshemmitannin hayechidim ad sheyyatza nisan muttarin leechol ballayla umuttarin baasiyyat melacha uvirchitza uvesicha vetashmish hammitta uneilat hassandal kishar kol hattaaniyyot. umafsikin lerashe chodashim ufurim. yatza nisan shel tekufa vehu keshehiggia hashshemesh litchillat mazzal shor en mitannim. sheen haggeshamim bazzeman hazze ella siman kelala hoil velo yardu kol ikkar mittechillat hashshana:

Bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael vechol haddome lah. aval mekomot sheonat haggeshamim shellahen kodem 17 bemarcheshvan o achar zeman ze kesheyyaggia zemannam velo yardu geshamim yechidim mitannim sheni vachamishi vesheni. umafsikin berashe chodashim uvachanukka uvefurim. veshohin achare chen kemo shiva yamim. im lo yardu geshamim bet din gozrin al hatztzibbur shelosh esre taaniyyot al hasseder sheamarnu:

Kol taaniyyot sheggozrin hatztzibbur bechutza laaretz ochlim bahem ballayla vedinehem kedin shear hattaaniyyot. sheen gozrin al hatztzibbur taanit kegon tzom kippur ella beeretz yisrael bilvad uviglal hammatar. uveotan eser taaniyyot shehen shalosh emtzaiyyot vesheva acharonot:
Mishneh Torah, Fasts 4:
Vechol yom vayom mishsheva taaniyyot haacharonot shel matar mitpallelin al seder ze. motziin et hatteva lirchovah shel ir vechol haam mitkabbetzim umitkassim besakkim. venotnin efer makle al gabbe hatteva veal gabbe sefer tora kede lehagedil et habbechiyya ulehachnia libbam. veechad min haam notel min haefer venoten berosh hannasi uverosh av bet din bemakom hanachat tefillin kede sheyyikkalmu veyashuvu. vechol echad veechad notel venoten berosho: 
Veachar kach maamidin benehen zaken chacham vehen yoshvin. lo haya sham zaken chacham maamidin chacham. lo haya sham lo zaken velo chacham maamidin adam shel tzura. veomer lifnehem divre kibbushin. achenu lo sak velo taanit gormin ella teshuva umaasim tovim. shekken matzinu beninve shello neemar beanshe ninve vayyar haelohim et sakkam veet taanitam ella <small>(Yona 3 10)</small> "vayyar haelohim et maasehem". uvekabbala hu omer <small>(Yoel 2 13)</small> "kiru levavchem veal bigdechem". umosif beinyanot ellu kefi kocho ad sheyyachnia libbam veyashuvu teshuva gemura: 
Veachar sheggomer ze divre kibbushin omdin bitfilla umaamidin sheliach tzibbur harauy lehitpallel betaaniyyot ellu. veim haya oto sheomer divre hakkibbushin rauy lehitpallel mitpallel veim lav moridin acher: 
Vee ze hu harauy lehitpallel betaaniyyot ellu. ish shehu ragil bitfilla. veragil likrot battora neviim uchetuvim. umetuppal veen lo. veyesh lo yegia bassade. velo yihye bevanav uvivne beto vechol kerovav hannilvim alav baal avera. ella yihye beto rekan min haaverot. velo yatza alav shem ra beyalduto. shefal berech. umerutztze laam. veyesh lo neima vekolo arev. veim haya zaken im kol hammiddot haellu hare ze mefoar. veim eno zaken hoil veyesh bo kol hammiddot haellu yitpallel: 
Usheliach tzibbur matchil umitpallel ad birkat goel yisrael. veomer zichronot veshofarot meen hatztzara. veomer <small>(Tehillim 120 1)</small> "el Adonai batztzarata li karati vayyaaneni". <small>(Tehillim 121 1)</small> "essa enay el heharim" vegomer. <small>(Tehillim 130 1)</small> "mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai". <small>(Tehillim 102 1)</small> "tefilla leani chi yaatof" vegomer: 
Veomer divre tachanunim kefi kocho. veomer ree na veanyenu veriva rivenu umaher legoolenu. umitchannen veomer besof tachanunav mi sheana et avraham avinu behar hammoriyya hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze. baruch atta Adonai goel yisrael: 
Umatchil lehosif shesh berachot shehu mosif zo achar zo. umitchannen bechol achat mehen bedivre tachanunim ufesukim middivre kabbala umikkitve hakkodesh kefi shehu ragil vechotem bechol achat mehen bachatimot ellu: 
Barishona hu chotem mi sheana et moshe vaavotenu al yam suf hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze. baruch atta Adonai zocher hannishkachot:
