Bashsheniyya hu chotem mi sheana et yehoshua baggilgal hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze. baruch atta Adonai shomea terua: 
Bashshelishit hu chotem mi sheana et shemuel bammitzpa hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze. baruch atta Adonai shomea tzeaka: 
Barviit hu chotem mi sheana et eliyyahu behar hakkarmel hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze. baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla: 
Bachamishit hu chotem mi sheana et yona bime haddaga hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze. baruch atta Adonai haone beet tzara: 
Bashshishshit hu chotem mi sheana et david ushelomo beno birushalayim hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze. baruch atta Adonai hamerachem al haaretz. vechol haam onin amen achar kol beracha uveracha kederech sheonin achar kol habberachot: 
Bashsheviit omer refaenu Adonai venerafe vechulei. vegomer hattefilla al hasseder vetokin bachatzotzrot. vechasseder hazze osin bechol makom: 
Keshehayu mitpallelin al hasseder hazze birushalayim hayu mitkannesin lehar habbayit keneged shaar hammizrach umitpallelin kasseder hazze. ucheshemmaggia sheliach tzibbur lomar mi sheana et avraham omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu elohay yisrael min haolam vead haolam baruch atta Adonai goel yisrael. vehen onin acharav baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. vechazzan hakkeneset omer lattokim tiku bene aharon tiku. vechozer hammitpallel veomer mi sheana et avraham behar hammoriyya hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze veachar kach tokin hakkohanim umeriin vetokin: 
Vechen babberacha hashsheniyya lazo shehi rishona min hashshesh shemmosif chotem bah baruch Adonai elohim elohe yisrael min haolam vead haolam baruch atta Adonai zocher hannishkachot. vehen onin baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. vechazzan hakkeneset omer lahen hariu bene aharon hariu. vechozer sheliach tzibbur veomer mi sheana et moshe vaavotenu al yam suf hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze. veachar kach meriin vetokin umeriin: 
Vechen al kol beracha uveracha beachat omer tiku uveachat omer hariu ad sheyyigmor kol sheva habberachot. venimtzeu hakkohanim paam tokin umeriin vetokin. ufaam meriin vetokin umeriin sheva peamim. veen osim hasseder ze ella behar habbayit bilvad. ucheshehen tokin umeriin sham tokin bachatzotzrot uveshofar keechad kemo sheamarnu: 
Sheva taaniyyot haellu kol makom sheggozrin otam sham achar shemmitpallelin yotzin kol haam levet hakkevarot uvochin umitchannenim sham. kelomar hare attem metim keellu im lo tashuvu middarchechem. uvechol taanit mittaaniyyot hatztzarot sheggozrin al hatztzibbur mitpallelin tefillat neila bechol makom: 
Yardu lahem geshamim ad matay yihyu yordin veyifseku hatztzibbur min hattaanit. mishsheyyerdu beomek haaretz hachareva tefach. uvabbenonit tefachayim. uvaavuda ad sheyyerdu beomek shelosha tefachim:
Mishneh Torah, Fasts 5: Yesh sham yamim shekkol yisrael mitannim bahem mippene hatztzarot sheeru bahen kede leorer hallevavot liftoach darche hatteshuva veyihye ze zikkaron lemaasenu haraim umaase avotenu shehaya kemaasenu atta ad sheggaram lahem velanu otan hatztzarot. shebbezichron devarim ellu nashuv lehetiv shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 26, 40)</small> "vehitvaddu et avonam veet avon avotam" vegomer:

Veellu hen yom shelishi betishre shebbo neherag gedalya ben achikam venichbat gachelet yisrael hannishara vesibbev lehatam galutan. vaasiri betevet shebbo samach melech bavel nevuchadnetztzar harasha al yerushalayim veheviah bematzor uvematzok. veyz betammuz chamishsha devarim eru bo. nishtabberu halluchot. uvatel hattamid mibbayit rishon. vehuvkea yerushalayim bechurban sheni. vesaraf appostomos harasha et hattora. veheemid tzelem bahechol:

Vetisha beav chamishsha devarim eru bo. nigzar al yisrael bammidbar shello yikkansu laaretz. vecharav habbayit barishona uvashsheniyya. venilkeda ir gedola uvetar shemah vehayu bah alafim urevavot miyyisrael vehaya lahem melech gadol vedimmu kol yisrael ugedole hachachamim shehu hammelech hammashiach. venafal beyad haromiyyim venehergu kullam vehayta tzara gedola kemo churban bet hammikdash. uvo bayyom hammuchan lefuranut charash turenuserufus harasha et hahechol veet sevivav lekayyem ma shenneemar<small>(yirmeya 26 18)</small> <small>(Micha 3 12)</small> "tziyyon sade techaresh":

Vearbaa yeme hatztzomot haellu hare hen meforashin bakkabbala <small>(Zecharya 8 19)</small> "tzom harvii vetzom hachamishi" vegomer. tzom harvii ze shiva asar betammuz shehu bachodesh harvii. vetzom hachamishi ze tisha beav shehu bachodesh hachamishi. vetzom hashshevii ze shelosha betishre shehu bachodesh hashshevii. vetzom haasiri ze asara betevet shehu bachodesh haasiri:

Venahagu kol yisrael bizmannim ellu lehitannot. uveyg baadar zecher lattaanit shehitannu bime haman shenneemar <small>(Ester 9 lo)</small> "divre hatztzomot vezaakatam". veim chal 13 baadar lihyot beshabbat makdimin umitannin bachamishi shehu 11. aval echad mearbaa yeme hatztzomot shechal lihyot beshabbat dochin oto leachar hashshabbat. chal lihyot beerev shabbat mitannin beerev shabbat. uvechol hatztzomot haellu en matriin velo mitpallelin bahen tefillat neila. aval korin battora shacharit umincha b<small>(Shemot 32 11)</small> "vaychal mshe". uvechullan ochlim veshotin ballayla chutz mittisha beav:

Mishsheyyikkanes av memaatin besimcha. veshabbat shechal tisha beav lihyot betochah asur lesapper ulechabbes velilbosh keli megohatz afillu keli pishtan ad sheyyaavor hattaanit. vaafillu lechabbes ulehanniach leachar hattaanit asur. uchevar nahagu yisrael shello leechol basar beshabbat zo velo yikkansu lammerchatz ad sheyyaavor hattaanit. veyesh mekomot shennahagu levattel hashshechita merosh hachodesh ad hattaanit:

Tisha beav lelo keyomo lechol davar. veen ochlin ella mibbeod yom. uven hashshemashot shello asur keyom hakkippurim. velo yochal basar velo yishte yayin basseudda hammafsik bah. aval shote hu yayin miggitto sheyyesh lo shelosha yamim o pachot. veochel basar maliach sheyyesh lo shelosha yamim o yeter. velo yochal shene tavshilin:

Bamme devarim amurim sheachal erev tisha beav achar chatzot. aval im saad kodem chatzot af al pi shehu mafsik bah ochel kol ma sheyyirtze. veerev tisha beav shechal lihyot beshabbat ochel veshote kol tzarko umaale al shulchano afillu kisuddat shelomo. vechen tisha beav atzmo shechal lihyot beshabbat eno mechasser kelum:

Zo hi middat kol haam sheenan yecholin lisbol yeter midday. aval chasidim harishonim kach hayta middatan. erev tisha beav hayu meviin lo laadam levaddo pat chareva bemelach veshore bemayim veyoshev ben tannur vechirayim veochlah veshote aleha kiton shel mayim bidaga uveshimmamon uvechiyya kemi shemmeto muttal lefanav. kaze rauy lachachamim laasot o karov mizze. umiyyamenu lo achalnu erev tisha beav tavshil afillu shel adashim ella im ken haya beshabbat:

Ubbarot umenikot mitannot umashlimot betisha beav. veasur birchitza ben bechammin ben betzonen vaafillu lehoshit etzbao bemayim. veasur besicha shel taanug uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta keyom hakkippurim. umakom shennahagu laasot bo melacha osin. umakom shennahagu shello laasot en osin. uvechol makom talmide chachamim betelin. veamru chachamim shehaose bo melacha eno roe siman beracha leolam:

Talmide chachamim en notnin ze laze shalom betisha beav. ella yoshvim davim veneenachim kaavelim. veim natan lahem am haaretz shalom machazirim lo besafa rafa vechoved rosh. veasur likrot betisha beav battora o banneviim o bakketuvim uvemishna uvahalachot uvigmara uvehaggadot. veeno kore ella beiyyov uvekinot uvaddevarim haraim shebbeyirmeyahu. vetinokot shel bet rabban betelin bo. umiktzat hachachamim nohagin shello lehanniach bo tefillin shel rosh:

Mishshecharav bet hammikdash tikkenu chachamim shehayu beoto haddor sheen bonin leolam binyan mesuyyad umechuyyar kevinyan hammelachim. ella tach beto betit vesad besid umeshayyer makom amma al amma keneged happetach belo sid. vehallokeach chatzer mesuyyedet umechuyyeret hare zo bechezkatah veen mechayyevim oto liklof hakketalim:

Vechen hitkinu shehaorech shulchan laasot seudda laorchim mechasser mimmennu meat umanniach makom panuy belo keara min hakkearot haruyot latet sham. ucheshehaishsha osa tachshite hakkesef vehazzahav meshayyeret min mimmine hattachshit shennoheget bahen kede shello yihye tachshit shalem. ucheshehechatan nose ishsha lokeach efer makle venoten berosho mekom hanachat hattefillin. vechol ellu haddevarim kede lizkor yerushalayim shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 137 5)</small> "im eshkachech yerushalami tishkach yemini" <small>(Tehillim 137 6)</small> "tidbak leshoni lechikki im lo ezkerechi im lo aale et yerushalami al rosh simchati":

Vechen gazru shello lenaggen bichle shir. vechol mine zemer vechol mashmie kol shel shir asur lismoach bahen veasur leshaman mippene hachurban. vaafillu shira bappe al hayyayin asura shenneemar <small>(yeshaya kad 9)</small> "bashshir lo yishtu yayin". uchevar nahagu kol yisrael lomar divre tushbachot o shir shel hodaot lael vechayyotze bahen al hayyayin:

Veachar kach gazru al atrot chatanim shello lehannicham kelal. veshello yanniach hechatan berosho shum kalil shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 21 lo)</small> "haser hammitznefet veharem haatara". vechen gazru al atrot kallot im haya shel kesef o zahav aval shel gedil muttar lechalla:

Mi sheraa are yehuda bechurbanam omer <small>(yeshaya sad 9)</small> "are kadshecha hayu midbar" vekorea. raa yerushalayim bechurbanah omer <small>(yeshaya sad 9)</small> "yerushalayim midbar" vegomer. bet hammikdash bechurbano omer <small>(yeshaya sad 10)</small> "bet kadshenu vetifartenu" vegomer vekorea. umehechan chayyav likroa min hatztzofim. uchesheyyaggia lammikdash korea kera acher. veim paga bammikdash techilla keshsheyyavo midderech hammidbar korea al hammikdash umosif al yerushalayim:

Kol hakkeraim haellu kullam korea beyado meemmad vekorea kol kesut shealav ad sheyyegalle et libbo. veeno meache keraim ellu leolam. aval rashshay hu leshallan lemallan lelakketan uletafran kemin sullamot:
Haya holech uva lirushalayim holech uva toch sheloshim yom eno korea kera acher. veim leachar sheloshim yom chozer vekorea:

Kol hatztzomot haellu atidim libbatel limot hammashiach. velo od ella shehem atidim lihyot yom tov vime sason vesimcha shenneemar <small>(Zecharya 8 19)</small> "ko amar Adonai tzevaot tzom harvii vetzom hachamishi vetzom hashshevii vetzom haasiri yihye levet yehuda lesason ulesimcha ulemoadim tovim vehaemet vehashshalom ehavu": salik hilchot taoniot
Mishneh Torah, Festival Offering 1: Shalosh mitzvot ase nitztauu yisrael bechol regel mishshalosh regalim veellu hen. hariyya shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 17)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 23)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 16)</small> "yerae kol zechurecha". vehachagiga shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 15)</small> "tachog laAdonai elohecha". vehassimcha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 14)</small> "vesamachta bechaggecha". hariyya haamura battora hi shennira panav baazara beyom tov harishon shel chag veyavi immo karban ola ben min haof ben min habbehema. umi shebba laazara beyom rishon velo hevi ola lo dayyo shello asa mitzvat ase ella over al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 15)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "lo yerau fanay rekam". veeno loke al lav ze shehare lo asa maase. hachagiga haamura battora hi sheyyakriv shelamim beyom tov harishon shel chag bevoo leheraot. vehaddavar yadua sheen hashshelamim baim ella min habbehema. ushete mitzvot ellu shehen hariyya vehachagiga en hannashim chayyavot bahen. vehassimcha haamura bargalim hi sheyyakriv shelamim yeter al shalme chagiga. veellu hem hannikraim shalme simchat chagiga shenneemar <small>(Devarim 27 7)</small> "vezavachta shelamim veachalta sham vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha". venashim chayyavot bemitzva zo:

Hariyya vehachagiga en lahen shiur min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 17)</small> "ish kemattenat yado" vegomer. aval middivre sofrim shello yehe karban olat reiyya pachot mishsheve maa kesef velo shalme chagiga pachot mishsheve shete kesef. umitzva lehavi kefi ashro shenneemar kemattenat yado:

Shalme simcha lo natnu bahen chachamim shiur. beet sheyyaale adam lirushalayim lachog im hayu beyado karbenot hariyya yeviem o yaale immo kesef liknot bo hakkarban. veim en beyado kesef lo yavi sheve kesef afillu haya beyado sheve kamma zehuvim asur lo laalot rekam belo kesef velo karban. velamma asru sheyyaale beyado sheve kesef gezera shemma lo yimtza limkor o shemma yimmatzu hammaot sigim:

Mi shello hikriv beyom tov harishon olat reiyyato veshallemi chagigato hare ze makrivan bishar yemot haregel shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 15)</small> "shivat yamim tachog laAdonai elohecha" melammed shekkullan reuyin lachagiga vechullan tashlume rishon hem:
Umitzva lehakedim ulehakriv barishon. lo hikriv barishon ben shogeg ben mezid yakriv bashsheni. vechol hammeacher hare ze megunne vealav neemar <small>(Tzefanya 3 18)</small> "nuge mimmoed asafti":
Avar haregel velo chag eno chayyav beacharayuto veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar <small>(Kohelet 1 15)</small> "meuvvat lo yuchal litkon":

Mi shello chag beyom tov harishon shel chag hassukkot chogeg et kol haregel uvayyom tov haacharon shehu shemini veaf hashshemini tashlume rishon hu. vechen mi shello chag beyom chag hashshavuot chogeg kol shiva veyesh lo tashlumin kol sheshet yamim shelleachar chag hashshavuot. vedavar ze mippi hashshemua neemar shechag hashshavuot kechag hammatztzot letashlumin:

Olat reiyya veshalme chagiga enan dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma lefi sheen lahen zeman kavua kekarbenot hatztzibbur. sheim eno chogeg hayyom chogeg lemachar kemo shebbearnu. aval dochin et yom tov veaf al pi sheen makrivin beyom tov nedarim unedavot makrivin olat reiyya veshalme chagiga veshalme simcha sheen ellu nedarim unedavot ella chovot:

Keshemmakriv hammakriv olat reiyyato veshalme chagigato vesimchato beyom tov. somech alehen bechol kocho kederech sheose bishar hayyamim. af al pi shessemicha enah meakkevet kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot lo gazru aleha mishshum shevut:

Hammafrish olat reiyyato umet. hayyorshin chayyavin lahaviah. muttar lehakeriv bechullo shel moed nedarim unedavot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 29 39)</small> "elle taasu laAdonai bemoadechem levad minnidrechem venidvotechem" mikkelal shekkerevin baregel. <small>(Bamidbar 29 39)</small> "leolotechem" kemo olat metzora veolat yoledet. <small>(Bamidbar 29 39)</small> "uleminchotechem" lehavi minchat chote uminchat kenaot. <small>(Bamidbar 29 39)</small> "uleshalmechem" lerabbot shalme nazir hakkol kerevin bammoed veen kerevin beyom tov:

Umi shehaya lo ochlim merubbim unechasim muatin mevi shalme chagiga merubbin veolot reiyya muatin. hayu lo ochlin muatin unechasim merubbin mevi olot reiyya merubbot veshalme chagiga muatot. hayu ze veze muat al ze amru lo yifchot mimmaa leola ushete kesef lishlamim. ze veze merubbe al ze neemar <small>(Devarim 16 17)</small> "kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach":
Mishneh Torah, Festival Offering 2: Nashim vaavadim peturin min hariyya. vechol haanashim chayyavim biriyya chutz mecheresh veillem veshote vekatan vesuma vechigger vetame vearel. vechen hazzaken vehachole veharach veheanog meod sheenam yecholim laalot al raglehen kol ellu haachad asar peturin. ushear kol haanashim chayyavin biriyya. hacheresh af al pi shehu medabber afillu cheresh beazno achat patur min hariyya. vechen hassuma beeno achat. o chigger beraglo achat patur. haillem af al pi shehu shomea patur. tumtum veanderoginus peturin mippene shehen sefek ishsha. mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin patur mippene tzad avdut shebbo. uminnayin shekkol ellu peturin min hariyya. hare hu omer <small>(Shemot 23 17)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 23)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 16)</small> "yerae kol zechurecha" lehotzi et hannashim. umitzvat ase sheen hannashim chayyavot bah en haavadim chayyavim bah. veod hare neemar bevo chol yisrael lehotzi haavadim. veneemar <small>(Devarim lo 11)</small> "bevo chol yisrael leraot". keshem shehen bain leheraot lifne Adonai kach hem baim lirot hadar kadsho uvet shechinato. lehotzi suma sheeno roe. afillu nismet eno achat shehare en reiyyato shelema. vesham neemar <small>(Devarim lo 12)</small> "lemaan yishmeu". lehotzi mi sheen lo shemia gemura. <small>(Devarim lo 12)</small> "ulemaan yilmedu". lehotzi mi sheeno medabber. shekkol hametzuvve lilmod metzuvve lelammed. veneemar <small>(Shemot 34 24)</small> "baalotcha leraot et pene Adonai" mi sheyyachol laalot beraglav lehotzi chigger vechole vezaken veanog. uchevar bearnu behilchot biat hammikdash sheen hattame rauy levia vechen hearel maus ketame:

Hamekammetz vehu shemmelachto lekabbetz tzoat kelavim vechayyotze bahen leabbed haorot o lirfua. vechen hametzaref nechoshet bemachtzav shello vehaabbedanin. af al pi shehen meusin mippene melachtan hare ellu metaharin gufan umalbushan veolin bichlal yisrael leraot:

Kol katan sheyyachol leechoz beyado shel aviv velaalot miyyerushalayim lehar habbayit aviv chayyav lehaaloto uleheraot bo kede lechannecho bemitzvot shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 17)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 23)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 16)</small> "yerae kol zechurecha". veim haya hakkatan chigger o suma o cheresh afillu beachat eno chayyav lechannecho af al pi shehu rauy lirfua sheillu haya gadol vehu kach haya patur kemo shebbearnu:

Kol hachayyav biriyya chayyav bachagiga vechol happatur min hariyya patur min hachagiga. vechullan chayyavin besimcha. chutz mecheresh shote vekatan vearel vetame. cheresh shote vekatan mippene sheenan bene chiyyuv hare hen peturin mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora. vearel vetame mippene sheenan ochlim bekadashim veenan reuyin levia kemo shebbearnu behilchot biat hammikdash uvehilchot maase hakkarbanot:

Mi shehaya chigger o suma beyom rishon venitrappe bashsheni. patur min hariyya umin hachagiga. shebbeyom chovato haya patur. shekkol yemot hechag tashlume rishon hen kemo shebbearnu. vechen im nitma belele yom tov harishon af al pi shettahar lemachar patur. aval im nitma beyom rishon hare ze chayyav lehavi chagigato ureiyyato betoch yeme haregel kesheyyithar:

Mi shebba laazara betoch yeme hechag eno chayyav lehavi ola beyado bechol et sheyyikkanes. shezze shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 15)</small> "velo yerau fanay rekam" eno ella beikkar haregel bilvad shehu yom rishon o tashlume rishon. veim hevi bechol et sheyyavi mekabbelin mimmennu umakrivin otah leshem olat reiyya. shehariyya en lah shiur:

Hifrish eser behemot lachagigato vehikriv mehen miktzatan barishon ufasak. shuv eno chozer umakriv hashshear shehare shiyyer otam. veim lo pasak ella dechako hayyom velo yachol lehakeriv hayyom makriv hashshear lemachar:

Olat reiyya enah baa ella min hachullin kishar hakkarbanot sheadam chayyav bahen. aval shalme chagiga baot mimmeot maaser sheni hameoravot im meot chullin. lokeach min hattaarovet behema umakrivah shalme chagiga. vehu sheyyihye shiur achila rishona min hachullin. mippene sheshshalme chagiga chova vechol shehu chova eno ba ella min hachullin:
Veyotze adam yede chovat shalme chagiga bemaasar behema. veen meviin oto beyom tov gezera shemma yeasser beyom tov:

Yotzin yisrael yede chovat shalme simcha bindarim unedavot uvemaasar behema. vehakkohanim bechattat uveasham uvivchor uvechaze veshok. shemmitzva zo hi lismoach baachilat basar lifne Adonai vahare achlu. aval en yotzin yede chovatan lo beofot velo bimnachot sheenan basar hamesammeach. kevar bearnu bifsachim shechagigat arbaa asar reshut. lefichach en adam yotze bah yede chovat chagiga ella yotze bah chovat simcha:
Mi shehayu lo shalme neder o nedava ushechatan meerev yom tov af al pi sheachalan beyom tov eno yotze bah yede chovat chagiga sheenah baa ella min hachullin aval yatza bah yede chovat simcha:
Af al pi sheshshechatan kodem haregel. hoil veochel mehen baregel yatza yede chovato sheeno tzarich lishchot shalme simcha bishat simcha:
Lo yavi adam toda beyom arbaa asar mippene hechametz shebbah sheen meviin kadashim levet happesul. veim hevi yotze bah yede chovat simcha kemo shebbearnu:

Haomer hare alay toda sheetze bah yede chovati leshem chagiga. chayyav lehavi toda veeno yotze bah yede chagiga sheen chagiga baa ella min hachullin. kesheyyizbach adam shalme chagiga veshalme simcha lo yihye ochel hu uvanav veishto bilvad vidamme sheyyaase mitzva gemura. ella chayyav lesammeach haaniyyim vehaumlalim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 14)</small> "vehallevi vehagger vehayyatom vehaalmana". maachil hakkol umashkan kefi ashro. umi sheachal zevachav velo simmeach ellu immo alav neemar <small>(Hoshea 9 4)</small> "zivchehem kelechem onim lahem kol ochlav yittammau ki lachmam lenafsham". umitzva belevi yoter min hakkol lefi sheen lo lo chelek velo nachala veen lo mattanot babbasar lefichach tzarich lezammen leviyyim al shulchano ulesammecham o yitten lahem mattenot basar im maaser shellahem kede sheyyimtzeu bo tzarchehem. vechol haozev et hallevi millesammecho veshohe mimmennu maasrotav bargalim over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 19)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen taazov et hallevi":
Mishneh Torah, Festival Offering 3:
Mitzvat ase lehakehil kol yisrael anashim venashim vetaf bechol motzae shemitta baalotam laregel velikrot beaznehem min hattora parashiyyot shehen mezarzot otan bemitzvot umechazzekot yedehem bedat haemet. shenneemar <small>(Devarim lo 10)</small> "mikketz sheva shanim bemoed shenat hashshemitta bechag hassukkot" <small>(Devarim lo 11)</small> "bevo chol yisrael leraot" vegomer <small>(Devarim lo 12)</small> "hakehel et haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf vegercha asher bisharecha" vegomer:
Kol happatur min hariyya patur mimmitzvat hakehel chutz min hannashim vehattaf vehearel. aval hattame patur mimmitzvat hakehel shenneemar <small>(Devarim lo 11)</small> "bevo chol yisrael" veze eno rauy levia. vehaddavar barur shehattumtum vehaanderoginus chayyavin shehare hannashim chayyavot:
Ematay hayu korin. bemotzae yom tov harishon shel chag hassukkot shehu techillat yeme chullo shel moed shel shana sheminit. vehammelech hu sheyyikra beaznehem. uveezrat hannashim hayu korin. vekore keshehu yoshev veim kara meummad hare ze meshubbach. mehechan hu kore mittechillat chummash elle haddevarim ad sof parashat shema umedalleg li<small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" vegomer umedalleg leasser teasser vekore me <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "asser teasser" al hasseder ad sof berachot ukelalot ad <small>(Devarim 28 69)</small> "millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev" ufosek: 
Ketzad hu kore. tokin bachatzotzrot bechol yerushalayim kede lehakehil et haam. umeviin bima gedola veshel etz hayta umaamidin otah beemtza ezrat nashim vehammelech ole veyoshev aleha kede sheyyishmeu keriato vechol yisrael haolim lachog mitkabbetzin sevivav. vechazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotno lerosh hakkeneset verosh hakkeneset notno lassegan usegan lechohen gadol vechohen gadol lammelech kede lehaddero berov bene adam. vehammelech mekabbelo keshehu omed veim ratza yeshev ufoteach veroe umevarech kederech shemmevarech kol kore battora bevet hakkeneset. vekore happarashiyyot sheamarnu ad shehu gomer vegolel umevarech leachareha kederech shemmevarchin bevatte kenesiyyot umosif sheva berachot veellu hen. retze Adonai elohenu beammecha yisrael vechulei. modim anachnu lach vechulei. atta bechartanu mikkol haammim vechulei ad mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim kederech shemmevarchin battefilla. hare shalosh berachot kematbean. reviit mitpallel al hammikdash sheyyaamod vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai hashshochen betziyyon. chamishit mitpallel al yisrael shettaamod malchutam vechotem bah habbocher beyisrael. shishshit mitpallel al hakkohanim sheyyirtze hael avodatam vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hakkohanim. sheviit mitchannen umitpallel bah kefi ma shehu yachol vechotem bah hosha Adonai et ammecha yisrael sheammecha tzerichin lehivvasha baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla:
Hakkeria vehabberachot bilshon hakkodesh. shenneemar <small>(Devarim lo 11)</small> "tikra et hattora hazzot" bilshonah af al pi sheyyesh sham loazot:
Vegerim sheenan makkirin chayyavin lehachin libbam ulehakshiv aznam lishmoa beema veyira vegila birada keyom shennittena bo besinay. afillu chachamim gedolim sheyyodim kol hattora kullah chayyavin lishmoa bechavvana gedola yetera. umi sheeno yachol lishmoa mechavven libbo likria zo shello kevaah hakkatuv ella lechazzek dat haemet veyire atzmo keillu atta nitztavva bah umippi haggevura shomah. shehammelech shaliach hu lehashemia divre hael:
Yom hakehel shechal lihyot beshabbat meacharin oto leachar hashshabbat. mippene tekiat hachatzotzrot vehattechinnot sheenan dochin et hashshabbat:
Mishneh Torah, First Fruits and other Gi:
Esrim vearba mattanot nittenu lakkohanim vechullan meforashin battora. veal kullan nichreta berit leaharon. vechol kohen sheeno mode bahen en lo chelek bakkohanim veen notnin lo mattana mehen: 
Vechol haochel mattana sheyyesh bah kedushsha mevarech asher kiddeshanu bikdushshato shel aharon vetzivvanu leechol kach vechach: 
Shemone mattanot mehem en ochlim otan hakkohanim ella bammikdash lefanim mechomat haazara. vechamesh mattanot en ochlin otan ella birushalayim lefanim mechomat hair. vechamesh mattanot en zochin bahen min hattora ella beeretz yisrael bilvad. vechamesh mattanot zochin bahen ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. umattana achat zochin bah min hammikdash: 
Ma hen hashshemone sheen neechalin ella bammikdash. besar hachattat echad chattat haof veechad chattat habbehema. uvesar haasham ben taluy ben vadday. vezivche shalme tzibbur. umotar haomer. usheyare menachot yisrael. ushete hallechem. velechem happanim. velog shemen shel metzora. ellu enan neechalin ella bammikdash: 
Uma hen hechamesh sheenan neechalin ella birushalayim. chaze veshok shel shelamim. vehammuram min hattoda. vehammuram meel nazir. uvechor behema tehora. vehabbikkurim. ellu enan neechalin ella birushalayim: 
Uma hen hechamesh shebbeeretz yisrael. hatteruma. uterumat maaser. vehachalla. ushelashtan kodesh. vereshit haggez. usede achuzza. ushenehen chullin. ellu enan zochin bahen min hattora ella beeretz yisrael. veen ochlin terumot vechallot shel eretz yisrael ella beeretz yisrael: 
Uma hen hechamesh shezzochin bahen hakkohanim bechol makom. hammattanot. ufidyon habben. ufeter chamor. vegezel hagger. vehacharamim. vachamishshetan chullin lechol davar: 
Vehammattana shezzochin bah min hammikdash hi orot haolot. vehu haddin lishar orot kadshe hakkadashim kullan lakkohanim: 
Hashshemone mattanot sheenan neechalin ella bammikdash kullan kadshe kadashim hen veenan neechalim ella lezichre kehunna kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. uvahen neemar <small>(Vayikra 6 22)</small> "kol zachar bakkohanim yochal oto" vegomer: 
Hechamesh shebbirushalayim hen kadashim kallim veneechalin lizcharim velinkevot uvahen neemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 11)</small> "lecha netattim ulevanecha velivnotecha ittecha lechak olam". veaf al pi chen en nittanin ella lezichre kehunna shehare leanshe mishmar hen. vehabbechor makrivin chelbo vedamo veen makrivo ella ish. vechen orot kadshe hakkadashim. usede achuzza. vehacharamim. vegezel hagger. en zochin bahen ella anshe mishmar kemo sheyyitbaer. vechen pidyon habben lezichre kehunna shekken neemar bo <small>(Bamidbar 3 48)</small> "venatatta hakkesef leaharon ulevanav". ufeter chamor lezichre kehunna. sheddin habbechorot kullan shave lizcharim velo linkevot: 
Hinne lamadta shehammattanot shennittanin linkevot kizcharim chamesh mattanot. teruma. uterumat maaser. vechalla. umattenot behema. vereshit haggez. uminnayin atta omer shereshit haggez nittenet lakkohanot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "reshit degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha vereshit gez tzoncha titten lo". ma reshit dagan nittenet linkevot kizcharim af reshit haggez: 
Manu chachamim mattanot ellu al derech acheret veamru esrim vearba mattenot kehunna nittenu leaharon veellu hen. eser bammikdash. arba birushalayim. veeser baggevulin: 
Eser bammikdash. chattat behema. vechattat haof. asham. veasham taluy. zivche shalme tzibbur. velog shemen shel metzora. shete hallechem. velechem happanim. sheyare menachot. umotar haomer: 
Arba birushalayim. habbechor. vehabbikkurim. umuram mittoda veel nazir. veorot kadashim: 
Eser baggevulin. teruma. uterumat maaser. vechalla. vereshit haggez. vehammattanot. ufidyon habben. ufidyon peter chamor. sede charamim. usede achuzza. vegezel hagger. ulefi cheshbon ze chashshev kol hammuram mikkadashim kallim mattana achat. vehen chaze veshok hammuram mikkol zevach shelamim im hallechem hammuram immahem [im haya toda. im hazzeroa hammuremet meel nazir im hallechem hammuram immah] im chaze veshok. hoil ushelashtan shelamim hen chashov hammuram mehem mattana achat: 
Kol hammattanot shehen teluyot bakkarbanot titbaer kol achat veachat bimkomah behilchot karbanot. vechen gezel hagger yitbaer behilchot gezela. uchevar bearnu din sede achuzza vedin hacharamim behilchot erchin. vedin teruma uterumat maaser behilchot terumot. uvahalachot ellu avaer mishpete hammattanot sheen teluyin bekarbanot. vehen: habbikkurim. vehachalla. vehammattanot. vereshit haggez. ufidyon habben. ufeter chamor:

Mitzvat ase lehavi bikkurim lammikdash. veenam nohagin ella bifne habbayit uveeretz yisrael bilvad shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 26)</small> "reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai elohecha". umeviin bikkurim shel divrehem meare sichon veog umissureya. shehakkone besureya kakkone birushalayim. [aval ammon umoav uvavel] af al pi shehen chayyavin bitruma uvemaasrot middivrehem en meviin mehen bikkurim. veim hevi bikkurim michutz laaretz enan bikkurim: 
En meviin bikkurim ella mishshivat hamminin haamurim beshevach haaretz. vehem hachittim vehasseorim vehaanavim vehatteenim veharimmonim vehazzetim vehattemarim. veim hevi chutz mishshivat hamminin lo nitkaddeshu: 
En meviin lo mittemarim shebbeharim. velo mipperot shebbaamakim. velo mizzete shemen sheenan min hammuvchar. ella mittemarim shebbaamakim umipperot shebbeharim lefi shehen min hammuvchar [veim hevi shello min hammuvchar] kegon temarim shebbeharim uteenim surot umerukkavot vaanavim meubbakot umeushshanot lo nitkaddeshu: 
En meviin bikkurim mashkin chutz mizzetim vaanavim bilvad shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 2)</small> <small>(Devarim 26 10)</small> "peri haadama" [velo mashke]. veim hevi mashkin en mekabbelin mimmennu: 
Hakkerovim lirushalayim meviin teenim vaanavim lachim. veharchokin meviin otan gerogarot vetzimmukin: 
En meviin bikkurim kodem laatzeret shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 16)</small> "vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha". veim hevi en mekabbelin mimmennu ella yannichem sham ad shettavo atzeret veyikra alehen. vechen en meviin bikkurim achar chanukka. shehabbikkurim shebbikkeru achar chanukka hen chashuvin mishshana habbaa. veyannichem ad achar atzeret: 
En meviin bikkurim lo min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash. ketzad. lo yavi mipperot shechantu kodem chamishsha asar bishvat al perot shechantu achar chamishsha asar bo. echad hannatua veechad haole meelav shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 13)</small> "bikkure kol asher beartzam": 
Happerot shel shuttafin chayyavim bevikkurim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 13)</small> "bikkure kol asher beartzecha" [asher yaviu]: 
Haggadel beatzitz af al pi shehu nakuv vehaggadel bisfina eno mevi mimmennu kol ikkar shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 13)</small> "beartzam". aval mevi min haggadel baggag o bachurba: 
Hannotea ilan betoch sadehu vehivricho letoch sede chavero o lirshut harabbim. o shehaya notea bisde chavero o birshut harabbim vehivricho betoch sadehu. o shehaya ikkaro betoch sadehu vehivrich ketzato betoch sadehu vederech harabbim o derech hayyachid mafseket baemtza ben haikkar vehatztzad hammuvrach. eno mevi bikkurim lo mimma shehotzi birshut zo velo min hatztzad shebbirshut haacharon shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 26)</small> "bikkure admatcha" ad sheyyihyu kol haggiddulin meadmatcha: 
Natan lo chavero reshut lehaverich betoch shello afillu leshaa hare ze mevi bikkurim. veim haya hailan samuch lemetzar chavero o note lisde chavero af al pi shechayyav leharechik hare ze mevi mimmennu vekore sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua et haaretz: 
Haarisin vehachachirin uvaale zeroa sheonsin et habbealim velokchin mehen artzotam befachot vehaggazlanin enan meviin bikkurim. vaafillu nityaashu habbealim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 26)</small> "bikkure admatcha": 
Hakkone ilan betoch sede chavero eno mevi lefi sheen lo karka. shelosha yesh lo karka veaf al pi sheen lo ella ilanot bilvad hare hu kemi shekkana karka. kana ilan echad vekarkao hare ze mevi: 
Hallokeach perot telushin velakach hakkarka hare ze mevi bikkurim shehare yesh lo karka uferoteha. machar lo perot chutz min hakkarka afillu mechubbarim. mocher eno mevi shehare en lo perot velokeach eno mevi shehare en lo karka. chazar hammocher velakach happerot min hallokeach hare ze mevi shehare yesh lo karka uferoteha: 
Hammocher sadehu leakkum vechazar ulekachah mimmennu hare ze mevi mimmenna bikkurim min hattora. sheenah nifkaat min hammitzva bekinyan haakkum kemo shebbearnu: 
Ashera shebbittelah en meviin mimmenna bikkurim shehabbikkurim kekadshe mikdash hen: 
Habbikkurim en lahem shiur min hattora aval middivrehem tzarich lehaferish echad mishshishshim. veharotze laasot kol sadehu bikkurim osehu: 
Hifrish bikkurav vechazar vehosif alehen o itteran hare hattosefet kevikkurim. bamme devarim amurim keshehevi meeretz yisrael. aval im hevi meever hayyarden o missureya enah kevikkurim. veaf al pi sheenah kevikkurim enah neechelet ella betohora. veen meatterin et habbikkurim bechol makom ella mishshivat hamminim: 
Ketzad mafrishin habbikkurim. yored adam letoch sadehu veroe teena shebbikkera eshkol anavim shebbikkeru rimmon shebbikker koshran begemi veomer hare ellu bikkurim. vehem naasim bikkurim bimchubbar mishshekkara lahen shem. veaf al pi sheadayin lo bashlu kol tzarkan. umishsheyyiggamru veyitleshem min hakkarka eno tzarich lachazor velikrot lahem shem. lo hifrishan bimchubbar velo kara lahem shem utelasham hare ze mafrisham achar shennitleshu. veim nitmeu happerot kullan eno mafrish bikkurim betuma. ella mafrish min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla. veim en lo perot acherot lehaferish mehen yerae li sheeno mafrish betuma sheen mafrishin leibbud. vechen yerae li shehabbikkurim shennitmeu eno massik bahen hattannur kitruma temea mippene shehen kekadshe mikdash: 
Hammafrish bikkurav venamakku o nivzezu o avdu o shennignevu o shennitmeu chayyav lehaferish acherim tachtehem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 26)</small> "tavi bet Adonai elohecha" melammed shehu chayyav beachrayutan ad sheyyeviem lehar habbayit: 
Hammafrish bikkurav lehaalotan beyado lirushalayim lo yishlachem beyad shaliach. veim likketan mittechilla al menat leshallecham beyad shaliach hare ze muttar leshallecham:

Habbikkurim notnin [otan] leanshe mishmar vehen mechallekim otan benehen kekadshe hammikdash. uchevar bearnu shehen keruyin teruma. ulefichach zar sheachal bikkurim bechol makom chayyav mita bide shamayim. vehu sheyyochlem meachar shennichnesu lechomat yerushalayim: 
Hayu miktzatan bifnim umiktzatan bachutz. ze shebbifnim chayyavin alav mita vahare hu hekdesh lechol devarav. veze shebbachutz hare hu chullin lechol devarav: 
Kohen sheachal bikkurim chutz lirushalayim meachar shennichnesu lefanim min hachoma loke min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "uterumat yadecha" vehem habbikkurim kemo shebbearnu behilchot teruma. vechen im achalan hakkohen birushalayim kodem hannacha baazara loke min hattora kemi sheachalan bachutz lefi shehen teunin hannacha baazara shenneemar vehinnachto lifne mizbach Adonai elohecha: 
Umishsheyyanichem hammeviam baazara hutteru lakkohen veaf al pi sheadayin lo hitvadda alehen sheen hakkeria meakkevet achilatan. vbikkurim sheyyatzu chutz limchitztzatan vechazru muttarin baachila: 
Achilat bikkurim kaachilat teruma lechol devarav. yeter bevikkurim shehen asurin leonen uteunin havaat makom. vechohen tahor sheachal bikkurim temeim loke keshem shelloke yisrael tahor sheachal maaser sheni shennitma ma sheen ken bitruma: 
Uminnayin shehabbikkurim asurin leonen shehare neemar bahen <small>(Devarim 26 11)</small> "vesamachta bechol hattov" mikkelal shehu chayyav leachlan besimcha lo baaninut. vehaochlan baaninut makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Habbikkurim teunin keli shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 2)</small> "vesamta vattene". umitzva min hammuvchar lehavi kol min umin bichli bifne atzmo. veim heviam bichli echad yatza. velo yeviem beirbuv ella seorim millematta vechittim al gabbehen vezetim al gabbehen utemarim al gabbehen verimmonim al gabbehen uteenim lemala min hakkeli. veyihye davar echad mafsik ben min vamin kegon hutzin vechelef o alin vechayyotze bahen. umakkif latteenim eshkolot shel anavim mibbachutz: 
Heviam bichle mattachot notel hakkohen habbikkurim vechozer hakkeli livalav. veim heviam bichle arava vechelef vechayyotze bahen hare habbikkurim vehassallim lakkohanim. veim nitmeu habbikkurim en hassallim lakkohanim: 
Keshehayu meviin et habbikkurim hayu meviin beyadam torin uvene yona. vechen hayu tolin mitztzidde hassallim torin uvene yona kede leatter et habbikkurim. ellu sheim hassallim hayu kerevim olot veellu shebbidehen hayu nittanin lakkohanim: 
Mitzvat ase lehitvaddot bammikdash al habbikkurim beshaa shemmeviam. matchil vekore <small>(Devarim 26 3)</small> "higgadti hayyom laAdonai elohecha ki vati el haaretz" vegomer <small>(Devarim 26 5)</small> "arammi oved avi" ad sheyyigmor kol happarasha ad <small>(Devarim 26 10)</small> "asher natatta li Adonai". veen korin otah ella bilshon hakkodesh shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 5)</small> "veanita veamarta". ballashon hazzot: 
Barishona kol mi shehaya yodea likrot kore vechol mi sheeno yodea likrot makrin oto. nimneu ellu sheen yodin likrot millehavi kede shello yikkalmu. hitkinu bet din sheyyihyu makrin et mi shehu yodea kemi sheeno yodea: 
Hammevi et habbikkurim yesh lo reshut littenem leavdo ukerovo bechol hadderech ad shemmaggia lehar habbayit. higgia lehar habbayit notel hassal al ketefo hu beatzmo. vaafillu haya melech gadol shebbeyisrael. venichnas ad shemmaggia laazara vekore veodehu hassal al ketefo <small>(Devarim 26 3)</small> "higgadti hayyom laAdonai elohecha" vegomer. umorid hassal meal ketefo veochazo bisfatav vehakkohen manniach yado tachtav umenif vekore <small>(Devarim 26 5)</small> "arammi oved avi vayyered mitzrayma" vegomer ad sheggomer kol happarasha umannicho betzad hammizbeach bekeren deromit maaravit bidromah shel keren veyishtachave veyetze. uminnayin shehen teunin tenufa shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 4)</small> "velakach hakkohen hattene" miyyadecha lerabbot et habbikkurim litnufa. ucheshem shetteunin tenufa kach teunin karban shelamim [veshir] shenneemar bahen <small>(Devarim 26 11)</small> "vesamachta bechol hattov" uvargalim omer <small>(Devarim 16 14)</small> "vesamachta bechaggecha" ma simchat hechag bishlamim af kan bishlamim. veen hakkarban meakkevet: 
Veematay korin beshir alehen. mishsheyyaggiu laazara haleviyyim hayu matchilin vekorin <small>(Tehillim 30 2)</small> "aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani": 
Habbikkurim tiunim lina. ketzad. hevi bikkurav lammikdash vekara vehikriv shelamav lo yetze beoto hayyom mirushalayim lachazor limkomo ella yalin sham veyachazor lemachar leiro shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 7)</small> "ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha". kol ponot sheatta pone min hammikdash lichshettavo lo lo yihyu ella babboker. nimtzeta omer shehabbikkurim teunin shiva devarim. havaat makom. ucheli. keria. vekarban. veshir. utenufa. velina:
Kol hammevi bikkurim taun karban veshir utenufa velina. aval havvidduy eno shave bakkol. lefi sheyyesh shechayyavin lehavi bikkurim veenan korin alehem:

Veellu meviin velo korin. haishsha vehattumtum vehaanderoginus lefi shehen sefek ishsha veenan yecholin lomar asher natatta li Adonai. vechen haappotroppin vehaeved vehashshaliach lefi sheenan yecholin lomar <small>(Devarim 26 10)</small> "asher natatta li Adonai":

Hagger mevi vekore shenneemar leavraham <small>(Bereshit 17 5)</small> "av hamon goyim netatticha" hare hu av kol haolam kullo shennichnasin tachat kanfe shechina. uleavraham hayta hashshevua techilla sheyyirshu banav et haaretz. vechen kohanim uleviyyim meviin vekorin mippene sheyyesh lahen are migrash:

Hakkone shene ilanot betoch [sade] shel chavero mevi veeno kore lefi shehaddavar safek im yesh lo karka o en lo. vechetzad ose. makdish otam techilla levedek habbayit mippene shehen sefek chullin veen machnisin chullin laazara vehakkohen pode otan miyyad hahekdesh veachar kach ochlan. umafrish mehen teruma umaaser mippene shehen sefek chullin venoten hammaasrot shellahen lakkohanim shemma bikkurim hem vaasurin lezarim. veeno mevi otan beatzmo ella meshallechan beyad shaliach kede shello teakkev otan hakkeria milleachlan. shekkol sheeno rauy likria mippene hassafek hakkeria meakkevet bo:

Hifrish bikkurav umachar sadehu mevi veeno kore. sheeno yachol lomar <small>(Devarim 26 10)</small> "asher natatta li Adonai" shehare en lo. vehallokeach eno chayyav lehaferish bikkurim acherim meoto hammin shekkevar hifrish mimmennu hammocher. veim hifrish mevi veeno kore. aval mimmin acher mafrish umevi vekore:

Hammocher sadehu leferot hallokeach mevi veeno kore shekkinyan perot eno kekinyan hagguf. aval mevi adam minnichse ishto bikkurim vekore af al pi sheen lo guf hakkarka shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 11)</small> "asher natan lecha Adonai elohecha ulevetecha". af al pi shemmeta ishto achar shehifrish vehu badderech mevi vekore:

Hammocher sadehu o shemmachar ilanot vekarkaan bizman shehayyovel noheg hare ze mevi vekore beyovel rishon bilvad sheadayin lo samcha dato shel mocher shettachazor lo hakkarka. aval im chazar umecharah beyovel sheni hare ze mevi veeno kore shehare samcha dato sheen lo ella happerot vekinyan perot eno kekinyan hagguf:

Hifrish bikkurim vechalla vahare hu mesukkan. ze sherauy leyarsho mevi veeno kore. hifrish bikkurav veshillechan beyad acher umet hashshaliach badderech af al pi shechazar hu vehevian eno kore shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 2)</small> "velakachta" <small>(Devarim 26 3)</small> "uvata" ad shettihye lekicha vahavaa keachat:

Hifrish bikkurav veavdu kodem sheyyaggia lehar habbayit vehifrish acherim tachtehen mevi hashsheniyyim veeno kore. lefi sheeno yachol lomar et <small>(Devarim 26 2)</small> "reshit kol peri haadama" lefi sheenan reshit. veellu hashsheniyyim en chayyavim alehen chomesh kevikkurim:
Hevi bikkurav venitmeu baazara noftzam sham veeno kore:
Hevi bikkurav meechad min hamminim vekara vechazar vehevi bikkurim mimmin acher eno kore alehen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 3)</small> "higgadti hayyom" paam achat beshana hu maggid velo shetayim:
Hifrish bikkurav veyavash hammayan o shenniktzatz hailan mevi veeno kore lefi shezze kemi sheen lo karka shehare avda:

Hammevi bikkurim meachar chag hassukkot vead chanukka af al pi shehifrishan kodem hechag mevi veeno kore shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 11)</small> "vesamachta vechol hattov" veen keria ella bishat simcha mechag hashshavuot ad sof hechag. ushear hammeviin chutz meellu meviin vekorin:

Habbikkurim vehatterumot vehachalla vehakkeren vehachomesh umattenot behema hem nichse kohen. yesh lo liknot mehen avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea uvaal chov notlan bechovo vehaishsha bichtubbatah. vekone bahen sefer tora:

Af al pi shehabbikkurim vehatterumot asur leheachel lezarim veaf al pi shehabbikkurim olin beechad umea kitruma im nitarvu bechullin birushalayim asurin bechol shehen beminam kemaaser sheni. mippene shehu mekom achilatan asaum kedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin. veaf al pi shehabbikkurim asurim lezarim af birushalayim hare hen osrin bechol shehen. afillu zara habbikkurim achar shennichnesu lirushalayim hare haggiddulin asurin veosrin bechol shehen im nitarvu birushalayim. aval hazzorea bikkurim kodem sheyyikkansu lirushalayim haggiddulin chullin:

Ketzad maalin et habbikkurim. kol haayarot shebbammaamad mitkannesot leiro shel maamad kede shello yaalu yechidim shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 14 28)</small> "berav am haderat melech". uvaim velanim birchovah shel ir. velo yikkansu labbattim mippene ohel hattuma. uvashshachar hamemunne omer <small>(yirmeya lo 5)</small> "kumu venaale tziyyon el Adonai elohenu". vehashshor holech lifnehem vekarnav metzuppin zahav vaatara shel zayit berosho lehodia shehabbikkurim mishshivat hamminin. vehechalil makke lifnehem ad shehem maggiin karov lirushalayim vehem holchin bechol hadderech vekorin <small>(Tehillim 122 1)</small> "samachti beomrim li bet Adonai nelech". velo hayu mehallechin bayyom ella shete yadot bilvad. higgiu karov lirushalayim shalchu lifnehem sheluchin lehodia leanshe yerushalayim veitteru et bikkurehem ufirkesu otan. veim haya lahem lach veyavesh marin et hallach millemala. vehappachot vehasseganim vehaggizbarim yotzin likratan mirushalayim. lefi habbaim hem yotzin im bau anashim harebe yotzin likratan rabbim. veim meat meat. umishsheyyikkansu kullan beshaare yerushalayim yatchilu likrot <small>(Tehillim 122 2)</small> "omdot hayu raglenu bisharayich yerushalayim":

Kol baale ummanuyyot shebbirushalayim omdin mippenehem veshoalin bishloman. achenu anshe mekom peloni boachem beshalom. vehem mehallechin betoch yerushalayim vehechalil makke lifnehem ad shehem maggiim lehar habbayit. higgiu lehar habbayit notel kol echad veechad sallo al ketefo veomrin <small>(Tehillim 150 1)</small> "haleluyah halelu el bekadsho" vechulei ad <small>(Tehillim 150 6)</small> "kl hanneshama tehallel yah haleluyah". vehem mehallechim behar habbayit vekorin ad shemmaggiin laazara. higgiu laazara dibberu haleviyyim beshir <small>(Tehillim 30 2)</small> "aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani" vegomer:
